prs.title: fix(core): recheck transcript file type on the opened fd (TOCTOU hardening)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Hardens the usage-dashboard transcript replay against a check-then-use race on the file type, and takes explicit ownership of the transcript file descriptor. The replay opens each transcript through the shared `openNoFollow(filePath, { nonBlocking: true })` helper — the same open-and-revalidate helper ten other production sites use — and rechecks `isFile()` on the opened fd before streaming, rejecting a non-regular file at the point of use instead of relying only on the earlier enumeration-time stat (kept as a cheap prefilter). The open-revalidate-stream block is wrapped in `try { … } finally { await handle.close() }` with `createReadStream({ autoClose: false })`, so the descriptor is closed on every exit — non-regular fd, a rejecting `stat()`, a mid-read error, or success. Adopting the helper settles the symlink policy to **no-follow**: a transcript whose final path component is a symlink is refused (`ELOOP`) and skipped, matching the other transcript readers; a new test pins that posture. The read-error, cache-hit, and concurrency tests spy on the open path; a real-FIFO regression test is added and strengthened to pin the rejection, and two companions cover a read error after a successful open and a rejecting `stat()`.

## Why it's needed

Follow-up to #17239 (review finding R4-1, a non-blocking hardening item). That change moved the non-regular-file guard into Phase 1's enumeration while the actual open happens in Phase 2's concurrent workers, so the check-then-use window widened from a few synchronous statements to the whole directory walk. A transcript that is a regular file when enumerated but is swapped to a writerless FIFO before its worker opens it would block `open(O_RDONLY)` in the libuv threadpool, never settle the scan, and park `GET /usage/dashboard` (and the dialog prefetch) until the daemon restarts; a few such entries exhaust the default threadpool. `O_NONBLOCK` makes the open return immediately and the fd-level recheck refuses the FIFO, so the load settles and skips that session.

The fd-ownership half addresses the review of this PR: the function opened its own `FileHandle` but closed it only on the non-regular branch, so a `stat()` that rejects before any stream exists leaked the fd outright — re-leaked on every later load, since a failed scan is deliberately not memoized. The block now takes explicit ownership (`autoClose: false` + `finally { await handle.close() }`) so the descriptor is closed on every exit, matching every other handle-owning `createReadStream()` site in the repo (`sessionService.ts`, `skill-archive-input.ts`, `managed-runtime-skill-source.ts`). To be precise about the mechanism: the stream's default `autoClose` does close safely through the `FileHandle` on the success/read paths (measured on Node 22/24, `handle.fd` becomes -1, so no stale descriptor is left for a finalizer); the leak was specific to the pre-stream `stat()`-failure path, and explicit ownership also keeps this reader consistent with its siblings.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the core usage-history suite. The case `settles and skips a FIFO swapped in after the Phase-1 stat` creates a real FIFO, fools the enumeration stat once, and now asserts both that the load settles/skips and that the fd-level recheck's `non-regular transcript` message is logged — so deleting the `isFile()` branch turns it red (previously it stayed green, because `O_NONBLOCK` alone lets a writerless FIFO read as an empty stream). Removing `O_NONBLOCK` still makes it time out.
- Two new companions pin the branches the open-path migration had left uncovered: a read error after a successful open (the `for await` catch → rethrow path) and a rejecting `stat()` (the handle must still be closed). Each asserts the session is omitted on the first load, recovered on the next, and the handle closed exactly once. Changing `throw e` to `return null`, or removing the `finally { await handle.close() }`, turns the respective case red.
- Confirm the existing replay behavior is unchanged: cache hit/invalidation/pruning, read-error recovery, bounded concurrency, and the read-only invariant all still pass.

```bash
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/services/usageHistoryService.test.ts
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI hardening; no visual change. Real temp-`QWEN_HOME` filesystem + real loader + real FIFO + real symlink probe: cold/warm/growth/read-only intact, a FIFO swapped in after the enumeration stat settles in ~2 ms and is skipped, and a real chats symlink to an out-of-enumeration target is refused (target not replayed). fd-liveness: 25 cold loads and 25 `stat()`-reject loads (a real fd whose `stat()` rejects but whose `close()` closes the real descriptor) leave the open-fd count unchanged. Mutation witness in that real environment: removing `finally { await handle.close() }` makes Node emit DEP0137 "Closing a FileHandle object on garbage collection" and the fd count grow; with the fix there is neither. Unit mutation witnesses: delete `isFile()` branch → FIFO case red; `throw e` → `return null` → read-error companion red; remove `handle.close()` → stat-reject case red; replace `openNoFollow` with a symlink-following open → symlink case red (the target session is replayed).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local unit tests on Node 24 plus a real temp-filesystem + real-loader + real-FIFO + real-symlink + real-fd-count probe. The FIFO, symlink, and two fake-handle fd companions are POSIX-only (`skipIf(win32)`): `mkfifo` is unavailable on Windows, and `openNoFollow`'s Windows fallback inserts an lstat/fstat identity step a bare fake handle cannot satisfy (the helper's own tests cover that path). On Windows the helper degrades to its documented no-follow fallback rather than the POSIX `O_NOFOLLOW` flag.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the fd is now closed explicitly on every path (one `fstat` + one `close` per transcript open), negligible next to the read itself. This replaces the earlier reliance on the stream's implicit `autoClose`; the previous draft's note that a failing `stat()` would be covered by the stream's `autoClose` was incorrect — no stream exists yet on that path — and is superseded by the explicit `finally`.
- Symlink policy is now **no-follow**, settled by adopting `openNoFollow` (round-2 review R2-1): a transcript whose final path component is a symlink is refused with `ELOOP` and skipped, the same posture as the other transcript readers, and a new test pins it (removing the guard replays the symlink target and reds the test). Phase 1 still enumerates with a symlink-following `statSync` as a cheap prefilter, so a symlinked transcript is accepted there and refused at the open — the authoritative guard is the fd-level one. Behavior change vs. before: a symlinked transcript's usage is no longer replayed; this is the intended hardening, chosen explicitly rather than inherited.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS / Windows not run locally (the FIFO case is POSIX-only). No change to the replay's aggregation, cache key, or dedup order; no signature, export, or public-API change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; read-only behavior preserved.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17239 (review R4-1); addresses the fd-ownership and test-coverage findings in this PR's review.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

对用量面板的 transcript 回放做文件类型 check-then-use 竞态加固，并显式持有 transcript 文件描述符。回放通过共享的 `openNoFollow(filePath, { nonBlocking: true })` helper 打开每个 transcript——正是另外十处生产调用点用于同一 open-复核形状的 helper——在流式读取前对已打开的 fd 复核 `isFile()`，在使用点拒绝非普通文件，而不只依赖枚举期的 stat（保留为廉价预筛）。open-复核-流式读取这段用 `try { … } finally { await handle.close() }` 包住，并对 `createReadStream` 传 `autoClose: false`，于是每条出口（非普通 fd、`stat()` reject、读取中途出错、成功）都关闭描述符。采用该 helper 把符号链接策略定为 **no-follow**：最后一段路径是符号链接的 transcript 会被拒（`ELOOP`）并跳过，与其他 transcript 读取方一致；新增一个测试钉住该姿态。读错恢复、缓存命中、并发三个测试对 open 路径打桩；新增并强化了一个真实 FIFO 回归用例（钉住「拒绝」），另加两个伴生用例分别覆盖「open 成功后读取中途失败」与「`stat()` reject」。

## 为什么需要

#17239 的 follow-up（评审 R4-1，非阻断加固项）。该改动把非普通文件守卫挪进 Phase 1 枚举，而真正的 open 发生在 Phase 2 并发 worker，check-then-use 窗口从几条同步语句拉长到整个目录遍历。一个枚举时还是普通文件、在其 worker 打开前被换成无写者 FIFO 的 transcript，会让 `open(O_RDONLY)` 阻塞在 libuv 线程池、扫描永不落定，把 `GET /usage/dashboard`（及对话框预取）挂住直到 daemon 重启；几个这样的条目就耗尽默认线程池。`O_NONBLOCK` 使 open 立即返回，fd 级复核拒绝 FIFO，于是加载落定并跳过该会话。

fd 所有权这一半回应本 PR 的评审：函数自己打开了 `FileHandle`，却只在非普通文件分支关闭它，因此在任何流存在之前 `stat()` 就 reject 的路径会直接泄漏 fd——由于失败扫描按设计不缓存，之后每次加载都会再泄漏一次。现在这段显式持有 fd（`autoClose: false` + `finally { await handle.close() }`），每条出口都关闭描述符，与仓库里其他所有自己持有 handle 的 `createReadStream()` 调用点（`sessionService.ts`、`skill-archive-input.ts`、`managed-runtime-skill-source.ts`）一致。机制上说准确：流的默认 `autoClose` 在成功/读取路径上确实会通过 `FileHandle` 安全关闭（Node 22/24 实测 `handle.fd` 变为 -1，不会留下给 finalizer 的过期描述符）；泄漏特指流存在之前的 `stat()` 失败路径，显式持有也让本读取方与兄弟调用点保持一致。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 跑 core 用量历史套件。用例 `settles and skips a FIFO swapped in after the Phase-1 stat` 建真实 FIFO、骗过枚举 stat 一次，现在同时断言「加载落定并跳过」与「fd 级复核的 `non-regular transcript` 消息被记录」——因此删掉 `isFile()` 分支会变红（此前仍绿，因为单靠 `O_NONBLOCK` 就能让无写者 FIFO 读成空流）。去掉 `O_NONBLOCK` 仍会超时。
- 两个新伴生用例钉住 open 路径迁移后失去覆盖的分支：open 成功后的读取中途错误（`for await` catch → rethrow 路径）与 `stat()` reject（handle 仍必须被关闭）。各自断言第一次加载跳过该会话、第二次恢复、handle 恰好关闭一次。把 `throw e` 改成 `return null`、或删掉 `finally { await handle.close() }`，对应用例变红。
- 确认既有回放行为不变：缓存命中/失效/剔除、读错恢复、有界并发、只读不变量均仍通过。

```bash
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/services/usageHistoryService.test.ts
```

### 证据（改动前后）

非 UI 加固，无视觉变化。真实临时 `QWEN_HOME` 文件系统 + 真实 loader + 真实 FIFO + 真实符号链接探针：冷/热/增长/只读不变，枚举 stat 之后换入的 FIFO 约 2ms 落定并被跳过，种进 chats、指向枚举之外目标的真实符号链接被拒（目标不被回放）。fd 活性：25 次冷加载与 25 次 `stat()`-reject 加载（一个真实 fd，其 `stat()` reject 但 `close()` 关闭真实描述符）后，打开的 fd 数不变。真实环境变异见证：删掉 `finally { await handle.close() }` 会让 Node 打出 DEP0137「Closing a FileHandle object on garbage collection」且 fd 数增长；修复后两者皆无。单测变异见证：删 `isFile()` 分支 → FIFO 用例红；`throw e` → `return null` → 读错伴生用例红；删 `handle.close()` → stat-reject 用例红；把 `openNoFollow` 换成跟随符号链接的 open → 符号链接用例红（目标会话被回放）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

Node 24 本地单测 + 真实临时文件系统 + 真实 loader + 真实 FIFO + 真实符号链接 + 真实 fd 计数探针。FIFO、符号链接与两个假 handle fd 伴生用例均仅 POSIX（`skipIf(win32)`）：Windows 无 mkfifo，且 `openNoFollow` 的 Windows 回退会插入 lstat/fstat 身份校验，裸假 handle 无法满足（该路径由 helper 自身测试覆盖）。Windows 上 helper 走其文档化的 no-follow 回退，而非 POSIX 的 `O_NOFOLLOW` flag。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险 / 权衡：fd 现在在每条路径上显式关闭（每次打开多一次 `fstat` + 一次 `close`），相对读取本身可忽略。这取代了早先对流隐式 `autoClose` 的依赖；上一版正文里「`stat()` 失败会由流的 `autoClose` 兜底」的说法不正确——那条路径上流还不存在——已被显式 `finally` 取代。
- 符号链接策略现为 **no-follow**，由采用 `openNoFollow` 定案（第二轮评审 R2-1）：最后一段路径是符号链接的 transcript 被拒（`ELOOP`）并跳过，与其他 transcript 读取方姿态一致；新增测试钉住它（去掉守卫会回放符号链接目标并变红）。Phase 1 仍用跟随符号链接的 `statSync` 作廉价预筛，因此符号链接 transcript 在 Phase 1 被接受、在 open 处被拒——权威守卫是 fd 级那道。相对之前的行为变化：符号链接 transcript 的用量不再被回放；这是有意的加固，是显式选择而非继承。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：macOS / Windows 未本地跑（FIFO 用例仅 POSIX）。不改回放的聚合、缓存键、去重顺序；无签名、导出或公开 API 变化。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无；只读行为保持。

## 关联 Issue

#17239 的 follow-up（评审 R4-1）；并回应本 PR 评审中的 fd 所有权与测试覆盖发现。

</details>

prs.title: feat(verify-pr): require a boundary declaration and own the watch state
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the isolation boundary of a local deep-verification round a machine-enforced declaration: every round must ship a boundary artifact recording either a credential-free container or a maintainer's explicitly recorded waiver, and the consistency checker refuses a round without it. The CI publish job writes the CI lane's own declaration before running the checker, so rounds whose base-pinned skill predates this change still pass. The shared head-dedup state that manual and watch-triggered rounds register in moves from hand-written JSON into a small atomic helper with UTC timestamps and a duplicate-head exit code. The skill also gains the measured rig-reuse traps (a masking pipe eating the setup exit code, comparing before restoring a mutant, fresh worktrees missing built entry points) and an event-driven waiting rule, plus a bilingual design document for the Java container recipe that removes the reason Java-heavy rounds fall back to the host.

## Why it's needed

Two consecutive local rounds on PR #16866 executed the entire Java battery, mutation matrix and JS suites on the maintainer's host with no isolation gate, no waiver, and no boundary line in either report — the isolation rule existed only as prose and did not stop the silent fallback. The same PR's watch state was left two heads stale because the completion write was a manual JSON edit that busy rounds skipped, and one manual start write stamped local time with a `Z` suffix. One round also spent nine foreground sleeps (~14 minutes) polling background matrices whose completion notifications all arrived on time, and two rounds each rediscovered and re-patched the same rig failure because the first fix was never fed back into the inherited recipe. Each of these is now either enforced by a script, owned by a helper, or written down as a measured rule with a pin.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the affected suites from the repository root: `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/verify-pr-check.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-watch-state.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-prepare.test.js scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-model-proxy.test.js` — 368 tests pass. The checker tests cover a missing declaration, malformed shapes, a container declaration without a detail, and a waiver missing the approver or the reason; each is refused, and a consistent round with either valid shape is accepted.
- The workflow meta-test replays the real publish step with the real checker: confirm the CI lane declaration is written before the checker runs and the verdict stays trusted even though the fixture never writes a declaration itself — this is the rollout-safety property for rounds whose base-pinned skill predates the artifact.
- Watch-state helper: starting the same head twice exits 3 the second time (verified and in-flight both dedup, at any quoted OID length); completion rotates the previous verified head, records the verdict and comment id, and stamps UTC; a corrupt state file is ignored rather than crashing; no temporary file survives the atomic write.
- The skill text pins assert the new contract strings: the per-round waiver that never carries over unasked, the operator-owned declaration (CI publish job and the local recipe's host check step), the helper commands in both the manual follow-up step and the watch prompt, the rig traps, and the notification-first waiting rule.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change (skill contract, checker, workflow, design docs).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node 24, vitest through the scripts/tests config; the publish-step replay uses a stubbed `gh` and the real checker.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the checker now refuses rounds without the boundary declaration. CI is covered by the workflow-side write landing in the same change; local rounds get the requirement from the updated skill, and old local checkouts keep their old checker until synced, so nothing breaks retroactively.
- Not validated / out of scope: no full end-to-end `/verify-pr` dry-run (hours-long); the Java container recipe is a design proposal, not implemented here; one pre-existing serve-ab workflow test is red on local git 2.43.7 (the workflow it parses is untouched by this PR).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: local rounds must write the boundary artifact before posting; host execution now requires an explicit per-round maintainer approval recorded in the artifact, and the watch state must be written through the helper rather than by hand.

把本地深度验证轮的隔离边界变成机器强制的声明：每个轮次必须携带边界产物，记录无凭据容器或维护者显式记录的豁免，一致性检查器拒绝没有声明的轮次。CI 发布作业在运行检查器之前自行写入 CI 车道的声明，因此 base 钉住的旧 skill 产出的轮次仍能通过。手动轮与 watch 触发轮共同登记的去重状态，从手写 JSON 移入一个原子写入的小助手，带 UTC 时间戳和重复 head 退出码。skill 还写入了实测的 rig 复用陷阱（掩码管道吃掉 setup 退出码、还原前先比对变异体、新 worktree 缺已构建入口）与事件驱动的等待规则，并附一份双语设计文档，描述消除 Java 重轮次回退宿主理由的 Java 容器配方。

prs.title: feat(core): support per-model auto-compaction thresholds
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds optional `generationConfig.autoCompactThreshold` to model provider entries. A valid model-level ratio in `(0, 1]` takes precedence over the global `context.autoCompactThreshold`, with the existing `0.85` default as the final fallback.

The override follows the selected model and endpoint across model switches, child agents, runtime restoration, and request context snapshots. Compaction timing can be configured without reducing the model's real context window or output budget.

## Why it's needed

A single global ratio cannot suit models with substantially different context windows. With a global ratio of `0.85`, a 1M-token model waits until 850K tokens to compact. Lowering its declared context window to compact earlier also reduces the available output budget. A model-specific ratio allows earlier compaction while preserving the real capacity.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Configure a global ratio of `0.85`, a 1M-token model with a model-level ratio of `0.25`, and a 262144-token model without an override. Verify that their auto-compaction thresholds are 250000 and approximately 222822 tokens respectively.
2. Switch between models and use child agents with different models or endpoints. Verify that each uses its own override or the global/default fallback, including same-name models at different endpoints.
3. Verify that missing or invalid model ratios fall back correctly, and that the 1M-token context window and 64000-token output budget at a 250000-token prompt remain unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: the independent acceptance probe failed because the 1M-token model used the global `0.85` ratio despite its configured `0.25` override.
- After: the actual compression service skips compression at 249999 tokens and triggers it at 250000. Switching to the smaller model restores the global ratio; switching back restores `0.25`.
- Docker Linux validation passed 1608 targeted tests, 3 independent acceptance tests, and 8 settings-to-compression service scenarios. The built CLI also passed startup smoke testing.
- Build and bundle passed. Workspace typechecks passed; integration typechecking initially exhausted the default Node heap, then passed when rerun with a 4 GiB heap.

The service scenarios use real settings loading and compression logic with controlled token counts and summary responses.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Docker, ARM64 |

### Environment

macOS with Node.js 22.22.0; Docker Ubuntu 24.04.5 ARM64 with Node.js 22.23.3. Both use pinned pnpm 11.24.0. Linux dependencies were installed independently with the frozen lockfile, and tests ran as a non-root user.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: carrying an override into another model or endpoint. Regression coverage includes model switches, child agents, runtime snapshots, OAuth updates, and same-name endpoint changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: real-provider long conversations, interactive TUI rendering, provider-side truncation, and unrelated context-window inference issues.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Existing configurations retain their global/default behavior, and the existing threshold formulas and safety ceiling remain unchanged.

Design: [English](docs/design/model-auto-compaction-threshold.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/model-auto-compaction-threshold.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Closes #14395

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次变更

为模型提供商条目新增可选的 `generationConfig.autoCompactThreshold`。有效范围为 `(0, 1]`，模型级比例优先于全局 `context.autoCompactThreshold`，最终回退到现有默认值 `0.85`。

覆盖值在模型切换、子代理、运行时恢复及请求上下文快照中跟随实际模型和端点。用户可以独立调整压缩时机，同时保留模型真实的上下文窗口和输出预算。

## 变更原因

单一全局比例无法同时适应上下文窗口差异较大的模型。全局比例为 `0.85` 时，100 万 token 的模型需要等到 85 万 token 才压缩。通过调小声明的上下文窗口提前压缩，又会减少可用输出预算。模型级比例允许提前压缩，同时保留真实容量。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证方式

1. 将全局比例设为 `0.85`，为 100 万 token 的模型配置模型级比例 `0.25`，另配置一个窗口为 262144 token、没有模型级覆盖的模型。确认自动压缩阈值分别为 250000 和约 222822 token。
2. 在模型之间切换，并让子代理使用不同模型或端点。确认各自使用自己的覆盖值或全局／默认回退值，包括名称相同但端点不同的模型。
3. 确认模型比例缺失或无效时正确回退，并确认 100 万 token 的窗口以及输入为 250000 token 时的 64000 token 输出预算保持不变。

### 修改前后证据

- 修改前：独立验收用例失败，100 万 token 的模型虽然配置了 `0.25`，实际仍使用全局 `0.85`。
- 修改后：真实压缩服务在 249999 token 时不压缩，在 250000 token 时触发压缩。切换到较小模型后恢复全局比例，切回后恢复 `0.25`。
- Docker Linux 验证通过了 1608 项定向测试、3 项独立验收测试和 8 个从配置加载到压缩服务的场景。构建后的 CLI 启动冒烟测试也通过。
- 构建和打包通过。工作区类型检查通过；集成测试类型检查首次耗尽 Node 默认堆内存，改用 4 GiB 堆内存重跑后通过。

服务场景使用真实配置加载和压缩逻辑，token 数和摘要响应采用受控输入。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--- | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Docker，ARM64 |

### 环境

macOS 使用 Node.js 22.22.0；Docker Ubuntu 24.04.5 ARM64 使用 Node.js 22.23.3。两者均使用项目锁定的 pnpm 11.24.0。Linux 按冻结锁文件独立安装依赖，并以非 root 用户运行测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：覆盖值被带入其他模型或端点。回归测试覆盖模型切换、子代理、运行时快照、OAuth 更新及同名模型端点变化。
- 未验证／范围外：真实提供商长对话、交互式 TUI 渲染、提供商侧截断及其他上下文窗口推导问题。
- 破坏性变更／迁移说明：无。现有配置保留全局／默认行为，现有阈值公式和安全上限保持不变。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/model-auto-compaction-threshold.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/model-auto-compaction-threshold.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

关闭 #14395。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): keep --disable-mcp-server exclusions across settings reload and ACP workspace reload
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the `--disable-mcp-server` exclusions durable at runtime. The flag itself landed in #14003, but the settings hot-reload and the ACP `workspaceMcpReload` path rebuild the MCP exclude set from settings alone, so any `settings.json` edit during a run re-enables a server the flag disabled (tracked in #14009).

This replaces #14030, reduced to the #14009 delta as requested in its review:

- The startup flag names are kept on `Config` and unioned into the settings-derived `mcp.excluded` on every runtime recompute: the settings hot-reload and the ACP `workspaceMcpReload`, including their bare/safe branches.
- A gated server the effective exclusion list already rules out no longer triggers the MCP approval prompt, at startup or after a reload, since approving it could not connect it.
- The "tool unavailable" message for an excluded server now also names `--disable-mcp-server` and the restart needed to clear it.
- Small follow-ups to the flag: one value per occurrence (`nargs: 1`) so a trailing positional prompt is not read as a server name, de-duplicated names, glob wording in the option description, and a `--disable-mcp-server` row in `docs/users/configuration/settings.md`.

With the flag absent, behavior is unchanged.

## Why it's needed

`--disable-mcp-server` is meant to keep a server out of a run, for example so a spawned `qwen --acp` child does not re-launch the bridge that spawned it. Today the exclusion lasts only until the first settings reload, after which the server connects anyway (#14009).

## Reviewer Test Plan

```
pnpm -C packages/cli exec vitest run src/config/config.test.ts src/config/hot-reload.test.ts src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts
pnpm -C packages/core exec vitest run src/core/coreToolScheduler.test.ts
```

### How to verify

- `hot-reload.test.ts`: a reload keeps the flag exclusions unioned with `mcp.excluded`; a reload that drops `mcp.excluded` does not re-enable the flagged server; a name present in both lists is de-duplicated and does not reconcile; safe and bare branches keep the exclusions; an unrelated settings edit does not reconcile; a gated server excluded by the flag does not emit `McpPendingApprovalChanged`, while one that is not excluded still does.
- `acpAgent.test.ts`: `workspaceMcpReload` keeps the flag exclusions on both the agent Config and the workspace discovery Config, in normal and safe mode.
- `config.test.ts`: de-duplicated names on `Config`, undefined when the flag is absent, trailing positional prompt not swallowed.
- `coreToolScheduler.test.ts`: the excluded-server message names `--disable-mcp-server`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for screenshots or logs: no UI change, and I did not reproduce the bug in a live interactive session. The before/after is the unit tests above: the reload contract test was a characterization of the old behavior (exclusion dropped on reload) and now asserts it is kept.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Windows 11, Node 26, unit tests only. One Windows-only failure is not from this PR: `acpAgent.test.ts` "fans out a workspace-scoped grant across a different path spelling" fails with `EPERM` on symlink creation, and also fails on clean `main`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the flag is re-applied on every runtime recompute, so enabling a flag-disabled server from `/mcp` lasts only until the next settings reload. Documented in the CLI arguments table. `nargs: 1` is deliberately limited to this flag, so `--disable-mcp-server a b` (space-separated) is no longer accepted; the other array options keep their variadic parsing.
- Not validated / out of scope: the `/mcp` interactive toggle, a new settings key, SDK passthrough, and `qwen mcp reconnect`. The MCP approval queue skips servers the effective exclusion list rules out, both at the startup mount and on the reload nudge, so a flag-disabled server is never offered for approval.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `recomputeMcpGating` (internal, two callers) gains a parameter.

## Linked Issues

Closes #14009
Supersedes #14030


<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

让 `--disable-mcp-server` 的排除项在运行期保持有效。该 flag 本身已在 #14003 合入，但 settings 热重载和 ACP `workspaceMcpReload` 路径只用 settings 重建 MCP 排除集合，因此运行期间任何 `settings.json` 的修改都会让被 flag 禁用的 server 重新启用（见 #14009）。

本 PR 取代 #14030，并按其评审意见收缩为只处理 #14009：

- 启动时的 flag 名称保存在 `Config` 上，并在每次运行期重新计算时与 settings 中的 `mcp.excluded` 取并集：包括 settings 热重载和 ACP `workspaceMcpReload`，以及它们的 bare/safe 分支。
- 已被生效排除列表排除的受限（gated）server，在启动时和重载后都不再触发 MCP 审批提示，因为批准也无法让它连接。
- 被排除 server 的"工具不可用"提示现在同时提到 `--disable-mcp-server`，以及清除它需要重启。
- 对 flag 的小幅跟进：每次出现只取一个值（`nargs: 1`），避免末尾的位置参数 prompt 被当成 server 名；名称去重；选项描述中补充 glob 说明；并在 `docs/users/configuration/settings.md` 中新增 `--disable-mcp-server` 一行。

未使用该 flag 时行为不变。

## Why it's needed

`--disable-mcp-server` 用来让某个 server 不参与本次运行，例如避免被拉起的 `qwen --acp` 子进程再次启动拉起它的 bridge。目前该排除只持续到第一次 settings 重载，之后 server 仍会连接（#14009）。

## Reviewer Test Plan

```
pnpm -C packages/cli exec vitest run src/config/config.test.ts src/config/hot-reload.test.ts src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts
pnpm -C packages/core exec vitest run src/core/coreToolScheduler.test.ts
```

### How to verify

- `hot-reload.test.ts`：重载后 flag 排除项与 `mcp.excluded` 取并集；重载时去掉 `mcp.excluded` 不会重新启用被 flag 禁用的 server；同时出现在两个列表中的名称会去重且不触发 reconcile；safe 和 bare 分支保持排除；无关的 settings 修改不触发 reconcile；被 flag 排除的 gated server 不会发出 `McpPendingApprovalChanged`，未被排除的仍会发出。
- `acpAgent.test.ts`：`workspaceMcpReload` 在普通和 safe 模式下，对 agent Config 和 workspace discovery Config 都保留 flag 排除项。
- `config.test.ts`：`Config` 上的名称已去重，未使用 flag 时为 undefined，末尾位置参数 prompt 不会被吞掉。
- `coreToolScheduler.test.ts`：被排除 server 的提示中包含 `--disable-mcp-server`。

### Evidence (Before & After)

截图/日志部分为 N/A：没有 UI 变化，且我没有在真实的交互会话中复现该 bug。前后对比体现在上述单元测试中：重载契约测试原本是对旧行为（重载时排除项丢失）的特征化记录，现在断言排除项被保留。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Windows 11，Node 26，仅单元测试。有一个仅在 Windows 上出现、与本 PR 无关的失败：`acpAgent.test.ts` 中 "fans out a workspace-scoped grant across a different path spelling" 因创建 symlink 报 `EPERM`，在干净的 `main` 上同样失败。

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff：flag 会在每次运行期重新计算时重新应用，因此从 `/mcp` 启用被 flag 禁用的 server，只会持续到下一次 settings 重载。已记录在 CLI 参数表中。`nargs: 1` 刻意只用于此 flag，因此 `--disable-mcp-server a b`（空格分隔）不再被接受；其他数组选项保持原有的可变参数解析。
- Not validated / out of scope：`/mcp` 交互式开关、新的 settings 键、SDK 透传，以及 `qwen mcp reconnect`。MCP 审批队列在启动 mount 和重载 nudge 两条路径上都会跳过被生效排除列表排除的 server，因此被 flag 禁用的 server 不会再被提供审批。
- Breaking changes / migration notes：无。`recomputeMcpGating`（内部函数，两个调用方）新增一个参数。

prs.title: feat(channels): deliver injected messages into the running turn
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a fourth channel `dispatchMode`, `inject`: a message that arrives while the agent is already working in a channel session is handed to the running turn's mid-turn queue and read by the agent at its next tool-batch boundary, instead of being buffered until the turn ends (`collect`) or queued as a new turn (`followup`).

The queue lives in the bridge (`AcpBridge`), is bounded at 20 messages / 20,000 characters, and is drained in batches the ACP child can actually consume (10 per response; the remainder stays queued for the next drain). A message is reported as injected only when the bridge accepted it. Everything the running turn cannot represent falls back to the existing collect buffer and is replayed as its own turn, in arrival order: a rejected or over-bound message, another chat's/thread's message under a collapsed session scope, an unauthorized member in a shared session, a recognized slash command, an image message (refused visibly — mid-turn injection is text-only), and any message on a bridge without the capability. When a turn ends before the agent drained, its unread messages are taken back at the turn boundary and replayed as a new turn instead of leaking into the next one; `/cancel`, `/clear` and session teardown drop them with the same buffer-drop notification the collect path uses.

The round-1 review's 10 Critical and 9 Suggestion findings are addressed in the same commits: drain batching against the consumer cap, turn-scoped settlement, a collect-replay marker (not `alreadyPrefixed`), the shared-session authorization gate, the per-message `onPromptInjected` hook, arrival-order sequencing once the fallback is open, the aggregate/depth char bound, text-only media handling, the email dispatch-mode guard, and the daemon-bridge fallback diagnostic.

## Why it's needed

Closes #15630. Today a user who sees the bot going the wrong way mid-task has only bad options: `steer` cancels the turn, `collect` makes them wait for it to finish, `followup` queues a new turn that may answer a stale question. `inject` lets the correction reach the work in progress, which is what a mid-task correction is for.

The guarantees above are part of the feature, not polish: the failure mode of a wrong delivery receipt is silently lost user input, and a message accepted for someone else's turn executes work under permissions approved for that turn's owner.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit/integration level with mocked bridge and child; no live channel platform is needed. From the repo root:

```bash
cd packages/channels/base && npx vitest run
cd packages/channels/wecom && npx vitest run
cd packages/channels/email && npx vitest run
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/serve/channel-settings-store.test.ts
npx tsc --build packages/channels/base packages/cli
```

Behaviour to confirm, all named cases in `ChannelBase.test.ts`'s "mid-turn message injection (inject dispatch mode)" block unless noted:

- accepted injection calls `queueMidTurnMessage` only, logs delivered, fires `onPromptInjected` and does not buffer;
- a bridge rejection parks the message in the bounded fallback and every later message of that turn follows it in arrival order;
- both fallback bounds (20 messages / 20,000 chars) refuse visibly and tell the sender rather than dropping;
- a collect-buffer replay is never re-injected (`collectReplay`), so a parked message always becomes its own turn;
- undrained injections are replayed at the turn boundary (`ChannelBase.test.ts` "replays injections the running turn never drained as a new turn"; `AcpBridge.test.ts` "settles undrained mid-turn messages at the turn boundary instead of leaking them");
- a shared-session member who is not an operator is denied and buffered; another chat's message under `sessionScope: 'single'` is not injected;
- an image message is refused in-thread (text-only), a file attachment is buffered so its `saved to:` path reaches a turn (`WeComAdapter.test.ts` too);
- a recognized slash command is buffered, and the group-history backfill is composed into the injected text;
- `AcpBridge.test.ts` "caps one drain response at the ACP consumer batch and keeps the remainder queued" (queue 11 → drain 10 → drain the 11th);
- `/cancel` and `/clear` drop queued injections with a drop notification (`AcpBridge.test.ts` and `ChannelBase.test.ts`);
- the email adapter rejects `inject` (`packages/channels/email/src/config.test.ts`), and a bridge without the capability logs one diagnostic and buffers.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Scenario | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unauthorized member injects into an operator's shared session | text reaches the running turn and executes under the turn owner's permissions | denied, falls through to collect buffering as its own turn |
| Turn ends with 15 queued messages the agent never drained | text stays queued and is injected into whatever turn runs next | taken back at the turn boundary and replayed as a new turn |
| 11 messages queued, one drain | one response carries 11, child keeps 10, the 11th is lost while the channel logged it delivered | first 10 delivered, the 11th delivered by the next drain |
| Collect-buffer replay while another turn registers | replay re-enters the inject arm and folds into someone else's turn | marked `collectReplay`, becomes its own turn |
| Image sent under `inject` | `[Alice] (image)` injected; the picture is invisible to the model | visible in-thread refusal (text-only path) |
| Chat-B message under `sessionScope: 'single'` | injected into chat A's running turn; the answer goes to A | buffered and replayed as its own turn in B |
| Email channel with `dispatchMode: 'inject'` | accepted by config, silently behaved as collect | rejected at config with the durable-claim reason |
| Bounded fallback full | message discarded with one stderr line | sender is told, stderr records the refusal |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit and integration tests with a mocked bridge/child (Node 22).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `inject` widens what a mid-turn message can do. The injected text enters a turn whose tool approvals belong to that turn's owner, so the arm now requires `isAuthorizedForSharedSession` (non-operators buffer instead) and never crosses a chat/thread boundary the running turn does not own. The degradation contract is deliberate: anything the turn cannot represent becomes a normal buffered turn rather than lost input.
- Semantics: nothing is reported delivered unless the bridge accepted it; the queue is settled at the turn boundary; ordering between injected and parked messages follows arrival order; the fallback is bounded (20 messages / 20,000 chars) and refuses visibly.
- Behaviour changes: the adapter-facing `dispatchMode` contract gains `inject` (email now whitelists `followup`/`steer` and rejects the rest), and `inject` on a daemon-managed (`qwen serve`) channel falls back to collect with a one-time operator diagnostic because `DaemonChannelBridge` cannot hand messages to a running turn — promoting them needs a channel-visible promotion contract and is out of scope here.
- Not validated / out of scope: no end-to-end run against a live agent child for drain timing (the tests drive a mocked child and bridge); the daemon promotion path is deliberately not implemented; queue capacity is the operator-facing global 20/20,000 bound, not a per-sender quota; images are refused rather than described to the model.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for existing modes — `collect` stays the default and the new mode is opt-in per channel; no config format change.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15630.

## 这个 PR 做了什么

新增第四个 channel `dispatchMode`：`inject`。当 agent 已在某个 channel 会话中工作时到达的消息，不再等回合结束（`collect`）或排成新回合（`followup`），而是交给正在运行回合的 mid-turn 队列，由 agent 在下一个工具批次边界读到。

上面那些保证属于功能本身而非润色：回执不实的失败模式是用户输入被静默丢失；而替别人回合接受消息，会让工作在「该回合所有者」的权限下执行。

单元/集成层面，桥与子进程都是 mock，不需要真实 channel 平台。在仓库根目录执行：

- 注入被接受时只调用 `queueMidTurnMessage`、记录 delivered、触发 `onPromptInjected`，不进入缓冲；

N/A —— 使用 mock 的桥/子进程的单元与集成测试（Node 22）。

- 主要风险/权衡：`inject` 扩大了中途消息能做的事。注入的文本会进入「工具审批属于该回合所有者」的回合，因此该分支现在要求 `isAuthorizedForSharedSession`（非 operator 一律进入缓冲），且绝不跨越运行中回合不拥有的 chat/thread 边界。降级契约是有意为之：回合无法表示的消息变成普通缓冲回合，而不是丢失。
- 语义：只有桥接层接受才记为 delivered；队列在回合边界结算；注入与 park 消息之间保持到达顺序；fallback 有界（20 条 / 20,000 字符）并明确拒绝。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): resume an interrupted turn when a session loads
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a daemon or environment restart leaves a persisted turn interrupted, the Web Shell used to restore the session idle behind the Continue button, so a task that was running when the machine or container went away stayed stopped until someone opened that session, noticed the banner, and pressed it. Loading a session now resumes an interrupted user prompt through the existing `POST /session/:id/continue` route.

The behavior is opt-in through a new `DaemonSessionProvider` prop, `autoContinueInterruptedTurn`, enabled for the main session and for split-view panes.

The automatic resume is limited to `interrupted_prompt`, the kind the daemon produces when a user prompt was cut off. `interrupted_turn` — a turn cut off mid-tool-call — is deliberately left to the banner: its repair synthesizes the missing tool results and hands control back to the model, which is why the recovery plan marks it `canAutoContinue: false` / `requiresUserConfirmation: true`. A turn the user stopped is never resumed either: the daemon reports it as `clean`, or, when the cancellation reason could not be persisted, attaches a `cancellationConfirmationId`.

The resume is also fenced to the recovery snapshot the load itself published, so a `turn_error` that arrives later and refreshes that snapshot with `canContinue: true` does not re-run the turn the user just watched fail. Each load snapshot is claimed at most once, which keeps a rerender or a StrictMode double-invoke from enqueueing two turns.

## Why it's needed

#6695 records the gap: PR #5030 added `POST /session/:id/continue`, which classifies persisted history and continues an interrupted prompt or dangling tool turn without inserting a synthetic "continue" user message, but `DaemonSessionProvider` never called it. The reporter reproduced both shapes against a deterministic OpenAI-compatible fake model — a SIGKILL during an active prompt, and a model stream that ends with empty text — and both returned `accepted: true` with `interruption: "interrupted_prompt"` once the route was called manually. Only the Web Shell orchestration was missing.

The issue also states the boundary this change keeps: explicit user cancellation must remain terminal, incremental SSE reconnection must not invoke continuation, and completed or already-active sessions must not produce a new model request.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The change is provider-level, so the tests are the reproduction. Run the new suite and confirm the positive case resumes and the four negative cases do not:

```
cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/daemon/session/DaemonSessionProvider.test.tsx -t "autoContinueInterruptedTurn"
```

Expected: 7 passed. Each negative case shares the same `replay_complete`-then-idle event stream as the positive case, so a "not called" assertion cannot pass merely because the load never finished catching up. I checked that by deleting each guard in turn and confirming the matching test fails:

- remove `recovery.kind !== 'interrupted_prompt'` → `leaves a dangling tool call to the Continue button` fails
- remove `connection.catchingUp` → `does not claim a session whose load never finishes replaying` fails
- remove `recovery !== autoContinueLoadRecoveryRef.current` → `does not resume a turn that fails after the load` fails

For a manual check on a running daemon: start `qwen serve` with a persistent runtime directory, submit a long prompt, `SIGKILL` the daemon, restart it, and load the same session in the Web Shell. Without this change the session comes back idle behind the Continue button; with it the turn resumes and reaches a normal terminal state.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Provider-level only, as a transcript of the same command against the commit before and after the fix.

Before, with the effect disabled (the behaviour of the base commit for `interrupted_prompt`):

```
× continues an interrupted prompt once, without a user click
✓ leaves a dangling tool call to the Continue button
✓ leaves the turn to the Continue button when the user cancelled it
✓ does nothing when the turn finished cleanly
✓ stays opt-in
✓ does not resume a turn that fails after the load
✓ does not claim a session whose load never finishes replaying
Tests  1 failed | 6 passed | 529 skipped (536)
```

After:

```
✓ daemon/session/DaemonSessionProvider.test.tsx (536 tests | 529 skipped)
Tests  7 passed | 529 skipped (536)
```

No screenshots: I did not run the Web Shell against a real daemon restart, so I have no captured before/after UI state. That reproduction is listed under "Not validated" below.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests under Node with jsdom; `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` for `packages/web-shell` run with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=16384` (the default heap OOMs on this package).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an automatic continuation spends a model request the user did not explicitly ask for. That is the point of the feature, and it is bounded to one attempt per session load, to `interrupted_prompt` only, and to a snapshot the load itself produced. It is also opt-in per provider.
- Not validated / out of scope: no real daemon-restart reproduction against `qwen serve`, no Web Shell Playwright run, and no full `npm run build`. Whether `interrupted_turn` should ever be auto-continued is left open; the design doc currently says it should not.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The prop defaults to `false`; the two in-repo call sites opt in.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #6695

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

守护进程或环境重启后，被打断的会话在 Web Shell 里原本会停在 Continue 按钮后面等人点，于是机器或容器掉线时正在跑的任务就一直停着，直到有人打开这个会话、看到提示条、按下按钮。现在加载会话时会通过已有的 `POST /session/:id/continue` 路由自动续跑被中断的用户 prompt。

该行为通过 `DaemonSessionProvider` 新增的 `autoContinueInterruptedTurn` 属性选择性开启，主会话和分屏面板都已启用。

自动续跑只针对 `interrupted_prompt`，也就是用户 prompt 被截断时守护进程给出的那一类。`interrupted_turn`——在 tool call 中途被切断的一轮——刻意留给提示条：修复它会合成缺失的 tool 结果再把控制权交回模型，所以恢复计划把它标记为 `canAutoContinue: false` / `requiresUserConfirmation: true`。用户主动停止的一轮同样永远不会被续跑：守护进程会把它报成 `clean`，或者在取消原因没能持久化时附带 `cancellationConfirmationId`。

续跑还被限定在「本次加载自己发布的恢复快照」上，因此之后到达、并把该快照刷新成 `canContinue: true` 的 `turn_error` 不会把用户刚看着失败的那一轮重新跑一遍。每个加载快照最多被认领一次，重渲染或 StrictMode 双调用也就不会排出两轮。

## 为什么需要

#6695 记录了这个缺口：PR #5030 加了 `POST /session/:id/continue`，它能对持久化历史分类并续跑被中断的 prompt 或悬挂的 tool 轮次，且不插入合成的 "continue" 用户消息，但 `DaemonSessionProvider` 从未调用它。提报者用一个确定性的 OpenAI 兼容假模型复现了两种形态——活跃 prompt 期间 SIGKILL，以及模型流以空文本结束——只要手动调用该路由，两种都返回 `accepted: true` 与 `interruption: "interrupted_prompt"`。缺的只是 Web Shell 这一层编排。

该 issue 也写明了本次改动保持的边界：用户显式的取消必须是终态，增量 SSE 重连不能触发续跑，已完成或仍在活跃的会话不能产生新的模型请求。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

改动位于 provider 层，测试即是复现。运行新增的测试套件，确认正向用例会续跑、四个反向用例不会：

```
cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/daemon/session/DaemonSessionProvider.test.tsx -t "autoContinueInterruptedTurn"
```

预期：7 个通过。每个反向用例都与正向用例共用同一条「先 `replay_complete` 再空闲」的事件流，因此「未被调用」的断言不会仅仅因为加载还没追平而通过。我逐个删除守卫验证过这一点：

- 删掉 `recovery.kind !== 'interrupted_prompt'` → `leaves a dangling tool call to the Continue button` 失败
- 删掉 `connection.catchingUp` → `does not claim a session whose load never finishes replaying` 失败
- 删掉 `recovery !== autoContinueLoadRecoveryRef.current` → `does not resume a turn that fails after the load` 失败

在运行中的守护进程上手工检查：用持久化运行目录启动 `qwen serve`，提交一个长 prompt，`SIGKILL` 守护进程，重启之，再在 Web Shell 里加载同一个会话。没有本改动时会话会停在 Continue 按钮后空闲；有了本改动，该轮会续跑并走到正常终态。

### 证据（前后对比）

仅在 provider 层，下面是同一条命令在修复前与修复后的输出。

修复前，把该 effect 禁用（即基线提交对 `interrupted_prompt` 的行为）：

```
× continues an interrupted prompt once, without a user click
✓ leaves a dangling tool call to the Continue button
✓ leaves the turn to the Continue button when the user cancelled it
✓ does nothing when the turn finished cleanly
✓ stays opt-in
✓ does not resume a turn that fails after the load
✓ does not claim a session whose load never finishes replaying
Tests  1 failed | 6 passed | 529 skipped (536)
```

修复后：

prs.title: fix(web-shell): clear Goals multi-workspace post-merge review items
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Follow-up to #17230 (merged as `8161b9f91f`), clearing the six suggestions the review bot posted at the merge head — all in one PR, no deferrals.

The workspace-qualified goals listing now runs inside the Conversations activity gate when it resolves a live-conversation runtime, exactly like the qualified scheduled-tasks surface: a drain's `sealAndWait()` counts the in-flight listing, a sealed gate answers the declared 503 `daemon_draining` instead of a partial probe page, and a daemon that wired no gate answers 503 `conversation_runtime_unavailable`. The create form's workspace picker is reconciled with the set the create path actually accepts: options and default come from the trusted subset of the operable workspaces (the untrusted primary stays in the fan-out so its listing failure remains loud, but is never a create target), and a selection that a capabilities refresh removes or untrusts falls back to the default for both the rendered control and the submitted cwd. The E2E mock daemon now allocates a distinct session per requested non-primary cwd — mirroring the real daemon — so picker-targeted creation and stranded-retry flows prove where a goal landed, and the specs assert the resulting card and listings, not just the allocation body. The Russian skipped-workspace notice uses an impersonal construction grammatical for every count, the two new zh-CN strings use the catalog's existing 不受信任 terminology, and both design docs are synchronized with the shipped predicates and the new behavior (their status lines now record the merge).

## Why it's needed

Each item was a concrete gap disclosed by the round-3 review at the merge head: a drain could shut the bridge down under an in-flight goals probe fan-out; the picker could open on a dead default every retry refused, or show the first option while still submitting a vanished cwd; the mock's fixed primary session id made the creation E2E unable to distinguish workspaces; the ru notice was ungrammatical for a count of one; the zh strings clipped a term the rest of the catalog spells in full; and the design docs still described the pre-fix aggregation predicate — the dangerous half, since implementing it would reintroduce the SSH 501-per-poll loop.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Daemon drain behavior: the new route-level case seeds a live-conversation runtime, seals a `ConversationRuntimeActivityGate`, and asserts 503 `daemon_draining`; removing the `gate.run()` wrap reds it (mutation-verified). A second case pins 503 `conversation_runtime_unavailable` when no gate is wired, and the existing read-only listing case now passes an open gate and still asserts 200.
2. Picker reconciliation: with an untrusted primary plus a trusted secondary, the form opens on the secondary and the options are exactly the trusted set; with the form open on a secondary, a capabilities refresh that removes it falls the select and the submit back to the primary. Both cases red when their guard is removed (mutation-verified for the reconciliation).
3. Creation landing: the picker-creation E2E now asserts the new card is badged secondary, the secondary's qualified listing carries the goal, and the primary's does not; the stranded-retry E2E asserts the retried goal is badged primary and the stranded secondary session stays goal-free.
4. Catalog wording: full-string pins for the ru notice at count 1 and 5, and for both zh strings; the count-1 pin reds against the previous wording.
5. Regression: the full web-shell chromium E2E suite runs green with the mock's per-cwd session allocation (the primary keeps one snapshot on both surfaces, so no scenario gains a second primary copy).

Automated coverage: 3 new daemon route cases plus 1 rewrite (32 total in goals.test.ts), 4 new dialog cases (67 total), 1 new app-level wiring case in workspace-qualified-rest.test.ts, 1 new App-level guard case (CI-executed; the jsdom suite is locally unrunnable on this machine), strengthened i18n pins, and 4 @smoke-tagged E2E cases (aggregation, creation landing, stranded retry, stale-selection reconciliation) so all of them run in the PR-time smoke lane.

### Evidence

Mutation witnesses: removing the gate wrap reds the sealed-gate case with `expected 200 to be 503`; reverting the effective-target reconciliation reds the vanished-selection case with the submitted-cwd assertion. Real-daemon + real-browser verification (isolated runtime, zero mocks) re-ran the aggregation/control/degradation, single-workspace, stranded/picker, and stale-selection suites on the bundled CLI.

## Post-verification follow-up

The deep-verification report (68/69 assertions, A/B-proven central claim) left one Low finding, two suggestions and two description corrections — all addressed in the second commit of this PR:

- **Low — silent submit with no creatable workspace:** whenever the daemon advertises workspaces but none is creatable — including the single-workspace deployment whose trust was revoked — the create form surfaces the translated `goals.error.workspaceUnavailable` refusal instead of submitting `undefined` into the App's silent no-target path; a daemon advertising NO workspace list keeps the legacy shape. Two dialog cases; removing the guard reds the first, narrowing it back to `isMultiWorkspace` reds the second (mutation-verified).
- **Gate wiring unpinned:** a new createServeApp-level case injects a live-conversation runtime, asserts the open-gate listing is 200, then seals `app.locals.conversationRuntimeActivity` and asserts 503 `daemon_draining` (this pins that the route CONSULTS the gate; the wrap itself is pinned by the in-flight case). Dropping `conversationRuntimeActivity` from the server.ts registration reds it with `expected 503 to be 200` (mutation-verified — the report's surviving M4).
- **In-flight drain cell:** a new route case blocks the probe, calls `sealAndWait()` mid-listing and asserts the seal stays pending until the listing completes with a full page (the report's R3 cell, which the sealed-before case did not reach). Removing the gate wrap reds both drain cases (mutation-verified).
- **PR-time E2E coverage:** the retry and stale-reconciliation cases now carry `@smoke`; the smoke lane collects 4 cases from this spec.
- **Corrections applied:** the control falls back to its first option (it does not render blank) — the defect is the display/submit divergence; the daemon case count is 2 net-new + 1 rewrite at the first commit, now 4 new + 1 rewrite. The design docs and the code comment carry the corrected wording.

The report's other surviving mutation (M8, `disabled` counting operable vs creatable) is inert by construction: with one creatable option there is nothing to select, so the predicate cannot change the submitted value; `disabled` already uses the creatable count.

## Round-2 review follow-up

The /review bot's three suggestions at `4193f8ce4b` are addressed in the third commit:

- **R1-1:** the no-creatable refusal is widened from `isMultiWorkspace` to `workspaceList.length > 0`, closing the single-untrusted-workspace silent no-op while preserving the legacy no-list daemon shape; new acceptance case, mutation-verified (narrowing reds it). The existing single-workspace and legacy create cases stay green.
- **R1-2:** the App-level guard case now asserts the refusal toast via `renderApp({ onToast })` — removing the `reportError` call reds it (mutation-verified locally under Node 22, which runs the jsdom App suite on this machine; the full goal group is 49 green).
- **R1-3:** the Goals acceptance criterion in both design docs now states the shipped contract (trusted local targets; the untrusted primary stays listable but is never a create target), removing the self-contradiction.

The merge-ready verification report's three description corrections are accepted: the daemon case count is 3 new + 1 rewrite (29→32); the sealed-gate assertion pins gate consultation while the in-flight case pins the wrap; and the single-workspace silent no-op was pre-existing — now closed by R1-1 rather than left as disclosed residue.

## Risk & Scope

The gate wrap only changes the live-conversation arm of the qualified route; ordinary workspaces keep the exact listing path. The picker reconciliation only narrows the create target set and adds a fallback — the fan-out, badges, and controls are untouched. The mock change is test-only; the primary's single-snapshot invariant is preserved. No daemon wire contract changes.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17230; tracking issue #17275 (closed as completed by the merge).

prs.title: fix(web-shell): finalize voice dictation before sending a message
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a message is sent while voice dictation is still active, the composer now finalizes the dictation first: it stops the capture, waits for the server's final transcript, inserts that transcript into the draft, and only then submits. Both the Send button and the Enter key go through this finalization; programmatic submits (queued-message flush, host-driven input, history search) keep their existing behavior. While finalization is in flight the send button shows a loading state and repeated send attempts are ignored, while the buttons that stop a running agent stay usable. If the transcript cannot be finalized — server error, disconnect, capture abort, session or workspace switch, unmount, or a one-minute bound — the send is canceled cleanly when the composer context changed, or proceeds with the content already in the draft when the capture simply failed, instead of hanging or silently dropping the draft. When no dictation is active, sends remain synchronous exactly as before.

## Why it's needed

The dictated text used to enter the composer only after the user explicitly stopped dictation and the final transcript arrived from the server. Clicking Send right after speaking — without pressing Stop — submitted only what was already typed: the spoken words never made it into the message. On the first message of a new session it was worse: assigning the session id changed the voice target, which aborted the in-progress capture outright, so the dictation was lost entirely. Users who speak and then hit Send lost their input.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run a daemon with voice transcription enabled and open the Web Shell against it.
2. Click the microphone, speak a sentence, and — without clicking Stop — click Send (or press Enter). Expected: the sent message contains the full dictated sentence (plus anything typed before it), the microphone returns to idle, and the composer clears. Before this change the message contained only the typed prefix and the recording kept running or was aborted.
3. Repeat as the very first message of a brand-new session. Expected: same outcome; previously the dictation was aborted when the session id was assigned.
4. While a turn is running on mobile/simple layout, start dictation and click Send (queued path). Expected: the Stop button for the running agent remains clickable during finalization.
5. Failure path: disable the voice model or cut the connection mid-dictation, then click Send. Expected: the send completes with the existing composer content and the voice error is surfaced; nothing hangs.

Regression coverage: capture-level finalization (stop frame, transcript delivery, idle/error/close/abort/unmount/timeout settlement, concurrent flush, connecting-state deferral), the submit gate (wait-then-submit, reentrancy drop, session/workspace switch cancel, unmount cancel, finalizer rejection cancel, follow-up recomputation), the composer wiring (trim + insert, empty transcript no-op, loading state, stop-button availability), and the button's imperative handle. Each guard was mutation-verified: removing it turns the corresponding test red.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: with a recording active, clicking Send submitted only the typed prefix — the dictated sentence was absent from the transcript (and aborted on first-message session creation). The three reproduction tests added with this PR fail on the base commit.

After: browser-level run against a real daemon ASR model, with a fake microphone fed a TTS recording of "我们今天去公园散步，顺便买一杯咖啡". Clicking Send without Stop produced the user message "语音发送测试： 我们今天去公园散步，顺便买一杯咖啡。…" — the full dictation included, composer cleared, microphone back to idle, no page errors:

![After: the sent user message contains the full dictated sentence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets-pr17331/pr17331-r1/voice-send-after.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

`npm run dev` (Vite) proxying a local daemon with the qwen3-asr-flash voice model; headless Chromium with `--use-fake-device-for-media-stream --use-file-for-fake-audio-capture=<TTS wav>` for the browser-level run; vitest + jsdom for the component/hook suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: user-initiated submits become asynchronous whenever a host finalizer is present. The window is bounded (one-minute finalization cap) and guarded: reentrant submits are dropped, a session/workspace switch or unmount cancels the submit, and a rejecting finalizer cancels it without an unhandled rejection. Hosts without a finalizer keep the previous synchronous path byte-for-byte.
- Not validated / out of scope: manual Windows/Linux runs (CI covers them); real microphone hardware (the browser run used a fake audio device feeding recorded speech through the real ASR path). Programmatic submit paths intentionally do not wait for dictation.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The composer hook is optional and the voice button's new ref handle is additive.

## Linked Issues

None — reported directly by a maintainer.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

当语音听写仍在进行时发送消息，输入框现在会先完成听写：停止捕获、等待服务端的最终转写、把转写文本插入草稿，然后才提交。发送按钮与 Enter 键都走这条完成化路径；程序化提交（排队消息刷出、宿主驱动输入、历史搜索）保持原有行为。完成化进行期间，发送按钮显示加载态并忽略重复发送，而停止运行中 agent 的按钮始终可用。若转写无法完成——服务端错误、断连、捕获中止、会话/工作区切换、卸载、或一分钟上限——上下文已变化时干净地取消提交，捕获单纯失败时则带着输入框已有内容继续发送，而不是挂起或静默丢弃草稿。没有活动听写时，发送与之前完全一样保持同步。

## 为什么需要

听写文本过去只有在用户明确点「停止」、服务端最终转写到达后才进入输入框。说完后不点停止直接点发送，只会提交已输入的内容：说出的话根本进不了消息。新会话的第一条消息更糟：分配会话 id 会改变语音目标，直接中止进行中的捕获，听写内容彻底丢失。说完就按发送的用户会丢失输入。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 起一个开启语音转写的 daemon，用 Web Shell 连上。
2. 点麦克风说一句话，不点停止直接点发送（或按 Enter）。预期：已发送消息包含完整听写句子（加上之前输入的内容），麦克风回到 idle，输入框清空。改动前消息只含已输入的前缀，录音继续或被中止。
3. 在全新会话的第一条消息重复。预期：结果相同；此前分配会话 id 时听写会被中止。
4. 移动端/simple 布局下运行中回合里开始听写并点发送（排队路径）。预期：完成化期间运行中 agent 的停止按钮仍可点击。
5. 失败路径：听写中途禁用语音模型或断连，再点发送。预期：发送带着已有内容完成，语音错误可见，不挂起。

回归覆盖：捕获级完成化（stop 帧、转写交付、idle/错误/关闭/中止/卸载/超时落定、并发 flush、connecting 延迟）、提交门控（等待后提交、重入丢弃、会话/工作区切换取消、卸载取消、finalizer reject 取消、follow-up 重算）、输入框接线（trim+插入、空转写无操作、加载态、停止按钮可用性）、按钮命令式句柄。每个守卫都做了变异验证：摘除即对应用例转红。

### 证据（前后对比）

前：录音中点发送只提交已输入前缀——听写句子不在消息里（首条消息建会话时更被直接中止）。本 PR 新增的三条复现测试在基线提交上失败。

后：对真实 daemon ASR 模型的浏览器级运行，假麦克风喂入 TTS 录音「我们今天去公园散步，顺便买一杯咖啡」。不点停止直接发送，产生用户消息「语音发送测试： 我们今天去公园散步，顺便买一杯咖啡。…」——完整听写在列、输入框清空、麦克风回 idle、无页面错误：

![后：已发送用户消息包含完整听写句子](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets-pr17331/pr17331-r1/voice-send-after.png)

### 测试平台

🍏 macOS ✅（单元 + 浏览器级）；🪟 Windows ⚠️ 未手测（CI 覆盖）；🐧 Linux ⚠️ 未手测（CI 覆盖）。

### 环境

`npm run dev`（Vite）代理本机开启 qwen3-asr-flash 语音模型的 daemon；无头 Chromium 以 `--use-fake-device-for-media-stream --use-file-for-fake-audio-capture=<TTS wav>` 做浏览器级运行；vitest + jsdom 跑组件/hook 套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：只要宿主提供了完成化器，用户发起的提交就变为异步。窗口有界（一分钟完成化上限）且有守卫：重入提交被丢弃，会话/工作区切换或卸载取消提交，finalizer reject 按取消处理且不产生 unhandled rejection。未提供完成化器的宿主逐字保留原同步路径。
- 未验证/范围外：Windows/Linux 手测（CI 覆盖）；真实麦克风硬件（浏览器运行用假音频设备喂录音，走真实 ASR 链路）。程序化提交路径有意不等待听写。
- 破坏性变更/迁移：无。composer 钩子可选，语音按钮新增的 ref 句柄是增量。

## 关联 Issue

无——维护者直接报告。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): open inline rename on single click of a session title
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In the Web Shell, the session title shown at the top of the session window (the pane header) is display-only plain text: clicking it does nothing, and the only inline rename is a double-click on the session row in the left sidebar. This change makes the pane title its own click target: a single click on the title (or Enter when it is focused) opens an inline rename input in place of the title text — prefilled with the current name, auto-focused and selected; Enter saves the new name through the same session-scoped rename API the sidebar's double-click and the `/rename` command use (for standalone sessions, the workspace client's standalone rename), Escape or blur cancels, and an empty name simply closes the editor. Submitting the name unchanged (Enter without editing) also just closes the editor without any daemon write, so a no-op submission cannot persist the id-prefix placeholder on sessions without a displayName. The header input works in both the single-session view and split view — each pane's header renames that pane's session. A click that finishes a text selection on the title, a pane without a session, or a rename already in flight leaves the click inert. The title click is not stopped on its way to document, so already-open Radix surfaces (session details, context usage, branch picker) still receive the native click for deferred outside-press dismissal.

## Why it's needed

Issue #14327: the pane header is where the user identifies — and wants to act on — the session in front of them, but the title was display-only, so renaming required finding the session in the sidebar and a hard-to-discover double-click. Making the header title a direct entry point to rename matches the "click a title to edit it" affordance the issue asks for. Note: the issue was originally scoped to the sidebar; on 2026-10-17 the scope was clarified to the pane header, and this PR was reworked accordingly (the sidebar's double-click rename is unchanged). The branch was also rebased onto the then-current `main` tip (`f9de111a13`, 2026-10-20) so it applies on today's tree.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

I extended `packages/web-shell/client/components/ChatPane.test.tsx` with a 12-case suite (`ChatPane pane title single-click rename`) covering: single-click opens the inline rename input prefilled and focused; Enter saves the trimmed name and reconciles the session catalog; a split pane's title (supplied via the `title` prop) renames; standalone sessions save through the workspace client; Escape cancels without saving; blur cancels without saving; an empty name closes without saving; a click that follows a text selection does not open rename; the title is inert without a session id; a failed save is reported and the editor closes; a single title click dismisses an already-open Radix popover while starting the rename (real `@radix-ui` popover, deferred outside-press path); and submitting the name unchanged (Enter without editing) closes the editor without any daemon write. The same path is covered for the header component itself: `packages/web-shell/client/components/ChatContextHeader.test.tsx` gained a 7-case suite (`ChatContextHeader session title single-click rename`) — open/prefill/focus, Enter save with catalog reconcile, no-change bail, standalone save through the workspace client, Escape cancel, empty-name close, and inert titles (no session id, non-string content).

- Run the new tests: from the repo root, `pnpm install && pnpm --filter @qwen-code/web-shell exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/ChatPane.test.tsx client/components/ChatContextHeader.test.tsx` — ChatPane.test.tsx 192/192 and ChatContextHeader.test.tsx 25/25 (217/217, 0 failures; both numbers include the pre-existing cases in those files, including upstream's new `pane approval mode allowlist` cases).
- Post-rebase note: upstream's new `ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx` shell-slot tests render the pane header, which imports the `useConnection`/`useActions` SDK hooks; the file gained mocks for those hooks (the rename UI is inert there — a managed session row has no session of its own).
- Manual check: start a daemon with the Web Shell (`node packages/cli/dist/index.js serve --workspace <dir>`), open the Web Shell, then: (1) single-click the session title in the header → the inline rename input appears prefilled with the current name; (2) type a new name and press Enter → the header (and the sidebar) show the new name; (3) single-click the title again and press Escape → the input closes, the name is unchanged; (4) in split view, single-click the second pane's title → its pane's session is renamed; (5) single-click the title, type nothing, press Enter → the input closes, the name is unchanged, and no rename request reaches the daemon (visible in the network tab).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (upstream behavior): the pane header title was display-only; renaming required a double-click on the session row in the sidebar (see issue #14327).

After: a single click on the pane title opens the inline rename input prefilled with the current name; saving updates the header and the sidebar in the same run. The live end-to-end run (real Chrome against a daemon built from this branch, steps S0–S5) is described under "Tested on" / macOS; no screenshots are attached — the behavior is described here and in the issue.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⏳ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

Machine evidence (2026-10-19, run on head `b90270059bfa6750f939ee0d89a684ffcda59bff` — a previous head of this PR, force-pushed to the current head `64e3423758a29bcbd151537030208f8d7f8fcda8`):

On the current head (2026-10-20, Docker `node:22-bookworm`): targeted re-run — ChatPane.test.tsx 192/192, ChatContextHeader.test.tsx 25/25, ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx 105/105 (322/322, 0 failures). The full-suite rows below are on the head above; CI re-runs the full suite on the current head.

- 🍏 macOS — Docker `node:22-bookworm` (aarch64) on the macOS host (host node v26.5.0 cannot run vitest-jsdom — `window.localStorage` undefined in jsdom, established environment limitation): fresh container, copy of the branch tree, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` + root build — full web-shell client suite `vitest run --config vitest.config.ts` — 450 files / 12188 tests, all passed (12188/12188, 0 failures, 256.5s); `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` — clean (0 errors); `eslint` on the changed files — 0 errors; `prettier --check` on the changed files — clean. Live E2E: 6-step CDP run (real user Chrome, daemon built from the branch) — S0–S5 PASS; this E2E ran on the previous head `68117bc7e5` (same feature, built before the rebase onto the current `main` tip). The machine evidence above was run on `b90270059b` (2026-10-19), a previous head of this PR; the force-push to the current head rebased the branch onto a newer `main` tip, and within this PR's own changes the only web-shell file that differs between the two heads is `ChatPane.test.tsx` (a test-only mock identity fix, covered by the targeted re-run on the current head above). The S5 scenario was additionally verified on the current head — see the Linux e2e line below.
- 🐧 Linux — same recipe (Docker `node:22-bookworm` (aarch64), fresh container, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`) — single fresh-container run on the macOS host (head `b90270059bfa6750f939ee0d89a684ffcda59bff`) — same numbers as the macOS row: 450 files / 12188 tests, all passed (12188/12188); tsc clean (0 errors); eslint 0 errors; prettier clean.
- 🪟 Windows — ⏳ pending: the UTM Win11 ARM VM was unavailable at publication time (full VM crash on 2026-10-18; power-on is a manual step in the UTM GUI). The earlier Windows run (ChatPane.test.tsx + tsc) was on the superseded head `f96df108d3` and is not cited here; the affected suites plus `tsc --noEmit` will be run on this head with `--pool=forks --poolOptions.forks.singleFork` and this row will be updated with the results.
- 🐧 Linux — S5 (2-pane Split View, rename of the second pane): PASS — separate Linux e2e container, 2026-10-20, PR head `64e3423758a29bcbd151537030208f8d7f8fcda8` (daemon serve built from the branch, real Chrome via CDP). Rename save produced exactly one `PATCH /session/<id>/metadata` in the daemon log with `displayName` persisted (`titleSource=manual`); Esc cancel produced 0 new PATCHes; 6 screenshots kept as local artifacts.

### Environment

macOS: Docker `node:22-bookworm` (aarch64) on macOS 26.6.2, fresh container (branch-tree copy, `--frozen-lockfile`); the live E2E used a daemon built from the branch (`node packages/cli/dist/index.js serve`) driven through real user Chrome via CDP. Linux: same Docker recipe as the macOS row. The S5 e2e used a separate e2e container (daemon built from the branch, `node packages/cli/dist/index.js serve`, real user Chrome driven via CDP). Windows (pending): UTM Win11 ARM VM (WinOnArm x64 emulation), node v22.23.3, pnpm 11.24.0, repo from the codeload archive of the branch base + sha256-verified overlay of the changed files.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a single click on the header title now opens rename — this is the intended behavior change requested in #14327. A click that finishes a text selection keeps its old behavior (the selection guard), a pane without a session has no rename affordance, and the title click does not stop propagation, so Radix deferred outside-press dismissal is preserved (covered by the real-popover regression test).
- Not validated / out of scope: the sidebar's double-click rename and all other sidebar surfaces are untouched; the Session Overview table and the TUI are unaffected. Standalone sessions are covered (they use the workspace client's standalone rename, mirroring the `/rename` command). The Windows machine run is pending (see Tested on).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No API, config, or data changes.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14327

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

在 Web Shell 中，显示在会话窗口顶部（面板标题栏）的会话标题是纯展示文本：点击它没有任何反应，唯一的重命名入口是左侧边栏中会话行的双击。此变更使面板标题本身成为一个独立的点击目标：单击标题（或在标题聚焦时按 Enter）会在标题文本原位打开一个内联重命名输入框——预填当前名称、自动聚焦并全选；按 Enter 通过与会话行双击和 `/rename` 命令相同的会话级重命名 API 保存新名称（对于 standalone 会话，使用 workspace client 的 standalone 重命名），按 Escape 或失焦取消，空名称则直接关闭编辑框。提交与当前名称完全相同的新名称（未编辑直接按 Enter）同样只是关闭编辑框，不产生任何 daemon 写入，因此空操作提交不会为没有 displayName 的会话持久化 id 前缀占位符。该标题输入框同时支持单会话视图和分屏视图——每个面板的标题重命名该面板的会话。结束文本拖选的点击、没有会话的面板、或已有重命名正在进行时，点击保持惰性。标题点击不会 stopPropagation，因此已打开的 Radix 弹层（会话详情、上下文用量、分支选择器）仍能收到原生 document 点击以完成延迟的 outside-press 关闭。

## 为什么需要

Issue #14327：面板标题是用户识别——并想要操作——当前会话的地方，但标题此前是纯展示的，重命名需要到侧边栏找到会话并进行不易发现的双击。将面板标题变成重命名的直接入口符合该 issue 所要求的「点击标题即编辑」交互。说明：该 issue 最初的范围是侧边栏；2026-10-17 明确为面板标题后，本 PR 已按新范围重做（侧边栏的双击重命名保持不变）。分支也已变基到当时的 `main` 顶点（`f9de111a13`，2026-10-20），可以直接应用在今天的代码树上。

- 主要风险或取舍：单击面板标题现在打开重命名——这正是 #14327 请求的预期行为变更。结束文本拖选的点击保持原有行为（selection-guard），没有会话的面板没有重命名入口，标题点击不做 stopPropagation，因此 Radix 延迟 outside-press 关闭保持不变（由真实 popover 回归测试覆盖）。

- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。无 API、配置或数据变更。

prs.title: fix(serve): throttle repeated WebSocket upgrade rejection logs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`qwen serve` now logs repeated WebSocket upgrade rejections at most once per minute per `listener@category@client-address`. Every other rejection still gets its 403 and is still counted — only the duplicate journal line is suppressed.

## Why it's needed

`logReject` in `packages/cli/src/serve/acp-http/index.ts` wrote one stderr line per rejected upgrade with no throttle or dedupe. A client whose upgrade the daemon always refuses — most often the Chrome extension retrying an origin the daemon was never told to allow — reconnects forever, so the journal accumulates thousands of identical lines a day. The issue measured ~4,000–6,000/day for a single extension origin.

This is the server-side third of #13966. The client halves are the extension's reconnect ladder and an autoconnect opt-out; #14022 already covers persisting that ladder across MV3 service-worker restarts.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- One entry per distinct `listener@category@address`, holding the last time it was logged. Inside `UPGRADE_REJECT_LOG_INTERVAL_MS` the line is dropped; the socket is still destroyed with the same 403.
- The key is the rejection category and the listener, not the rendered reason: the reason embeds client-controlled text, so a client that varies it must not mint a fresh key per attempt. Same-category rejections from one address on one listener inside a window are therefore one line, naming the most recent reason, with `suppressed=<n>` and `reasons=<n>` beside it so neither the count nor the quoted reason reads as the whole story.
- The map is re-inserted on each log so it stays in least-recently-logged order, and is capped at `MAX_UPGRADE_REJECT_LOG_KEYS` by evicting the oldest entry. Without the cap, a daemon seeing many distinct rejected clients would grow it without bound.

```sh
npx vitest run packages/cli/src/serve/acp-http/transport.test.ts
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

Eight cases in `transport.test.ts` cover the change: repeated identical rejections log once per window; a client that varies the Origin is still throttled; the same rejection is logged again once the window elapses or the wall clock steps backwards; a client-supplied header cannot forge the count; the count and reason total are flushed on `dispose()`; `reasons=` reports how many distinct reasons a key folded away; and the listener is part of the key, so a LAN pairing-token probe is not folded into a primary-listener line. The file reports 447 passing tests, run locally with `npx vitest run src/serve/acp-http/transport.test.ts`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only; no dev server or sandbox.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a genuine repeat of the same rejection category from the same client on the same listener inside one minute is not journaled, and the distinct reasons behind a multi-reason count are only summarized numerically (`reasons=<n>`), not named. The rejection itself is still refused and counted; only the line is dropped, and the pending count is written at shutdown so a burst that stops is never invisible.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full `npm run build`, and full-suite `npm test`. Neither is needed to validate this change, but I am not claiming they pass.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

### Local checks run

- `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/serve/acp-http/transport.test.ts` — 433 passed.
- `npx eslint` and `npx prettier --check` on both changed files — clean.
- `tsc --noEmit` for `packages/cli` reports 0 errors in the two changed files. The package reports 44 unrelated errors from stale `dist/` artifacts in this fresh worktree (`sdk-typescript`, `acp-bridge` builds not present), so I did not treat the overall run as a gate.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13966
