prs.title: feat(core): carry recent failed tool attempts into the compaction input
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Appends a bounded digest of recent failed tool calls to the compaction side-query's system instruction, with an explicit directive to carry those attempts and their failure reasons into the state snapshot. The digest scans the history being compressed for `functionResponse` parts carrying an error, takes the newest first, caps at 8 entries with 160-character error snippets, dedupes identical entries, and is omitted entirely when there are no recent failures.

## Why it's needed

Failed attempts live in the history being summarized, but whether the summary preserves them is the summarizer's discretion — post-compaction context can lose "what was tried and why it failed" and the model retries blindly (#17314). OpenAI Codex attaches executed-call metadata to compaction prompts (`executed_tool_calls.rs`), which is the design precedent.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/services/chatCompressionService.test.ts` — with a history containing a failed `write_file` response, the side-query's `systemInstruction` contains the digest header, the tool name, and the error snippet; with a clean history, no digest section is added. Full file: 190/190.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅    |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the digest adds up to ~1.5K chars to the compaction system prompt when failures exist; the side-query budget math already treats the system instruction as part of the payload, so the window guard accounts for it.
- Not validated / out of scope: no change to what the summarizer does with the directive (it remains a prompt-level instruction, same as custom/hook instructions); rejections recorded as plain user directives rather than functionResponse errors are already visible in the history.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.
- Design documents: N/A.

## Linked Issues

Closes #17314

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

本 PR 在压缩侧查询的 system instruction 末尾附加一段有界的"近期失败工具调用"摘要（最新在前、最多 8 条、错误截取 160 字符、去重），并明确指示摘要器把这些尝试与失败原因带进状态快照。无近期失败时完全不附加。

动机：失败尝试在被摘要的历史里，但摘要是否保留它们全凭摘要器裁量——压缩后"试过什么、为何失败"可能丢失，模型盲目重试（#17314）。OpenAI Codex 向压缩提示附加已执行调用元数据（executed_tool_calls.rs）是设计先例。

验证：含失败 write_file 响应的历史 → 侧查询 systemInstruction 含摘要头/工具名/错误片段；干净历史不附加。全文件 190/190。风险：失败存在时最多增加约 1.5K 字符，窗口守卫已把 system instruction 计入负载。关闭 #17314。

</details>

prs.title: feat(skills): surface unconfigured MCP dependencies at skill activation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A SKILL.md can now declare the MCP servers it depends on via an `mcp:` frontmatter field (a single name or a list). At activation, the skill tool checks the declared names against the registered MCP config and appends the missing ones to the activation output — with how to add them — so a missing dependency surfaces before the skill's first tool call fails with an opaque "tool not found". This is a presence check only: installing or enabling servers remains a user action.

## Why it's needed

Skills that rely on MCP tools (a skill whose scripts call a specific server) currently discover a missing server only when the tool call fails mid-task (#17317). OpenAI Codex prompts for and installs missing MCP servers a skill declares (`mcp_skill_dependencies.rs`), which is the design precedent; this PR takes the declarative field and the activation-time surfacing, leaving install flows to the existing MCP config UX.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/tools/skill.test.ts src/skills/skill-load.test.ts` — a skill declaring `mcp: [github, missing-server]` with only `github` registered activates with a warning naming `missing-server`; with all declared servers registered, no warning is added. Malformed `mcp:` values are ignored at parse time.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅    |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the warning is prompt-level guidance; a model can still attempt the failing tool call.
- Not validated / out of scope: no automatic install/prompt-to-install flow (deliberately — install UX belongs to the existing MCP config surfaces); no per-tool granularity (server names only, matching the declaration style Codex uses).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — the frontmatter field is optional and ignored when absent.
- Design documents: N/A.

## Linked Issues

Closes #17317

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

SKILL.md 现在可通过 `mcp:` frontmatter 字段（单个名称或列表）声明其 MCP 依赖。激活时 skill 工具将声明名称与已注册 MCP 配置比对，把缺失项连同添加方法附到激活输出——让缺失依赖在技能第一个工具调用以"tool not found"失败之前就暴露。仅做存在性检查：安装/启用服务器仍是用户操作（#17317）。

动机：依赖 MCP 工具的技能目前只能在任务中工具调用失败时才发现服务器缺失。OpenAI Codex 的 mcp_skill_dependencies.rs 是设计先例；本 PR 取其声明字段与激活时暴露，安装流程留给既有 MCP 配置 UX。

验证：声明 [github, missing-server] 而仅注册 github → 警告点名 missing-server；全部注册则无警告；畸形值解析时忽略。风险：警告是提示级，模型仍可能尝试失败调用。无破坏性变更。关闭 #17317。

</details>

prs.title: chore(deps): update vulnerable dependencies
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Updates the transport dependency graph to undici 7.30.2, axios 1.20.0 and @grpc/grpc-js 1.14.5, retaining the existing major versions. Raises the undici declaration floor for the six owned consumers and aligns npm/pnpm overrides. Restores the branch on current main, preserving the already merged security upgrades and current CI/Java layout.

Also updates the independently installed CUA agent example to the established MCP/Zod/HTTP dependency security targets and refreshes its actual local SDK 0.27.0 metadata, while retaining the third-party agent SDK versions. The prerequisite main export-size correction #17153 has merged. This branch includes that main baseline, and the prerequisite is no longer part of this PR's diff.

## Why it's needed

The previous head is behind main, has stale CI failures and retains older security targets. In particular, undici 7.30.0 is affected by later advisories fixed in 7.30.1; 7.30.2 remains on 7.x and satisfies the existing release-age policy. Regenerating the merged lock also removes dangling channel dependency references. The independent example needs its own upgrade because the workspace lock does not control it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm a frozen workspace install and independent example install resolve the intended parents, then exercise ordinary downloads, proxy configuration, channel HTTP clients and telemetry/A2A gRPC initialization. Local real loopback controls verify redirects, POST bodies, channel SDK transport/download behavior and unary gRPC metadata. The independent example should typecheck and complete MCP initialize/listTools/callTool over both in-memory and HTTP transports, reject invalid tool arguments, preserve normal form parsing and enforce its configured parameter limit.

### Evidence (Before & After)

No UI behavior change. Local frozen install, lock/parity checks, full build, bundle, full typecheck with an 8 GiB heap, lint, Core 295 / CLI 74 / channel 1,534 / provider 23 tests pass. Actual-parent integration controls and independent CUA example install/typecheck/MCP/URI/IP controls pass. A separate report records commands, scope and limitations.

Workspace audit comparison against the merged main baseline removes 32 reported items with no new items (99 → 67); no undici/axios/grpc-js advisory remains in that snapshot. This is not an audit-zero claim. The example's remaining unique node-server advisory has stale global metadata: the official 1.19.19 release and repository advisory explicitly include its security backport. The report preserves the raw audit finding and source evidence.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| macOS | Local build/typecheck/tests and loopback integrations; Node 24.19.0, CLI also checked on Node 22.23.2 |
| Windows | Not tested locally; fresh CI required |
| Linux | Not tested locally; fresh CI required |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: transport library behavior and the independent example's peer dependency graph; actual parent resolutions and integration controls cover the local paths described above.
- Not validated: external provider/business credentials, native desktop actions, TLS pinning, streaming gRPC, other operating systems, publication, consumer deployment and the original Snyk rescan.
- Automated coverage: the nested CUA agent example is outside the existing dependency-CVE audit glob; its independent installation/typecheck/protocol checks in this report are manual verification. This PR does not expand that workflow's scope or claim its audit gate certifies the example.
- Migration: consumers do not inherit root overrides. Refresh consumer locks and inspect bundled copies; updating this source tree does not replace an older published bundle. Remaining minimatch/ExcelJS/inflight work stays tracked separately.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/LubabaKhalid/qwen-code/blob/fix/dependency-cve-audit/docs/design/npm-transport-security-restoration.md) / [中文](https://github.com/LubabaKhalid/qwen-code/blob/fix/dependency-cve-audit/docs/design/npm-transport-security-restoration.zh-CN.md), kept complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Related to #17099, #10850 and #16434. Does not close those trackers. Build prerequisite: #17153.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

将传输依赖图升级为 undici 7.30.2、axios 1.20.0、@grpc/grpc-js 1.14.5，保持各自主版本；六个自有消费者提高 undici 声明下限，npm/pnpm overrides 对齐。合入当前 main，保留已合并安全修复以及当前 CI/Java 布局。

独立安装的 CUA agent 示例也升级至已确定的 MCP/Zod/HTTP 安全目标，并刷新真实本地 SDK 0.27.0 元数据，第三方 agent SDK 版本不变。前置的 main 导出体积修复 #17153 已合并；本分支同步了该 main 基线，前置修复已不在本 PR 的差异中。

旧 head 落后 main，CI 失败和安全目标均已过期。特别是 undici 7.30.0 受后续公告影响，7.30.1 已修复；采用仍属 7.x 且满足现有包龄策略的 7.30.2。重新解析合并锁也消除了 channel 悬空引用。独立示例不受工作区锁控制，必须单独升级。

评审应检查冻结工作区安装及独立示例安装的真实父模块版本，并验证普通下载、代理配置、channel HTTP 客户端和遥测/A2A gRPC 初始化。本机真实 loopback 覆盖重定向、POST、channel SDK 传输/下载以及一元 gRPC metadata。示例应通过类型检查，完成内存和 HTTP 两种 MCP initialize/listTools/callTool，拒绝错误参数，保留正常表单解析并遵守参数数量限额。

无 UI 行为变化。本地冻结安装、锁/parity、完整构建、bundle、8 GiB 堆全量类型检查、lint、Core 295 / CLI 74 / channel 1,534 / provider 23 项测试通过。真实父链集成及独立示例安装、类型检查、MCP、URI/IP 对照通过；独立报告保留命令、范围和限制。对照合入的 main，工作区 audit 减少 32 项且无新增（99 → 67），该快照中 undici/axios/grpc-js 无公告命中，不代表 audit 清零。示例唯一剩余 node-server 公告的全局元数据过期，官方 1.19.19 发布及仓库公告明确包含安全回补；报告保留原始 audit 及来源证据。

macOS 下 Node 24.19.0 完成上述验证，CLI 另检查 Node 22.23.2。Windows/Linux 未本地验证，需要新 CI。主要风险是传输行为及示例 peer 图；覆盖限于所述真实父链和本机集成。未验证外部业务/模型凭据、原生桌面操作、TLS pinning、流式 gRPC、其他系统、发布、消费端部署及原始 Snyk 复扫。

嵌套 CUA agent 示例不在现有 dependency-CVE audit glob 覆盖内，报告中的独立安装、类型和协议检查是手动验证；本 PR 不扩展该工作流范围，也不宣称其 audit 门禁验证了示例。消费端不继承根 overrides，需要刷新自己的锁并检查内嵌副本，源码升级不替换旧发布 bundle。剩余 minimatch、ExcelJS/inflight 独立跟踪。英文与中文设计完整同步。关联 #17099、#10850、#16434，不关闭跟踪；前置构建修复为 #17153。

</details>

prs.title: fix(acp): surface failed todo_write calls instead of dropping them
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Failed `todo_write` calls are now reported to the ACP client as a terminal `tool_call_update` with `status: failed`, instead of producing no frame at all. Successes keep the existing plan-only representation, which is what the client renders as the task list.

## Why it's needed

A `todo_write` result is deliberately rendered as a plan update rather than a tool card, and every failure path returned early without emitting anything:

- `ToolCallEmitter.emitResult` returned on `!success`;
- `Session.runTool` skipped the terminal emission for `todo_write`;
- the `earlyErrorResponse` path skipped `TODO_WRITE`;
- a discarded tool-call preparation returned without a frame;
- transcript replay dropped the record the same way.

A failed `todo_write` normally writes no plan, so a failed call was invisible on the wire: no plan frame, no `tool_call` start, no `tool_call_update`. In ACP hosts the plan panel is the *only* progress surface, so the failure was silently swallowed and there was nothing to diagnose from. This was called out as an actionable follow-up in the triage for this issue.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the emitter tests: `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/emitters/tool-call-emitter.test.ts` — the new cases assert that a failed `todo_write` result emits one `tool_call_update` with `status: 'failed'` and the error text, that an execution error message wins over the display text, and that a subagent `todo_write` still emits nothing.

prs.title: feat(web-shell): extend view navigation shortcuts with the remaining hotkey set
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Extends the Web Shell view-navigation shortcuts introduced by #14179 (the first two chords of #13175) with the remaining set of keyboard behaviors, all handled by the same capture-phase `keydown` listener in `App.tsx` (the existing `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+O` and `Cmd/Ctrl+\` chords are untouched, as are the listener's existing guards — open dialog/fullscreen surfaces, web terminal, editable targets, key auto-repeat, IME composition, `Alt`):

- **Number preview (Cmd/Ctrl hold)** — while Cmd (macOS) or Ctrl (Windows/Linux) is held, the first nine targets of the navigation digit cluster are numbered 1..9 with small accent pills, so the next press is visible before it is made (the macOS-menu canon for modifier keys). The badge is a CSS `::after` driven by a `data-web-shell-nav-preview` attribute — no extra DOM nodes, so a React re-render of the rows cannot drop or duplicate it mid-hold. The targets, their priority, and their claim semantics mirror the plain digit press exactly: the approval card wins even with no option group, the Session Overview table even with no rows, a present-but-collapsed Pinned section numbers nothing (the first press would expand it, not navigate), and only a missing or hidden Pinned header falls through to the split panes. The preview re-numbers on every modifier keydown (a list that changes while the modifier is held re-numbers itself) and clears on the modifier's keyup — where "still held" is judged by the *other* modifier, because the keyup of a released modifier still carries its own flag — as well as on window blur and when `Alt` joins (the `Alt`+digit chords are a different family).
- **`Cmd/Ctrl+1..9`** — navigation digit cluster with a priority chain: (1) a visible tool-approval card — focuses the Nth approval option (the pane whose composer holds focus wins over other visible cards); (2) the Session Overview row N when the Overview viewport is visible (row click, same as a mouse click); (3) the Pinned section in the sidebar — collapsed: expands it; expanded: activates the Nth pinned session row; (4) in Split View with more than one pane: focuses the Nth pane's composer. Over-range numbers are swallowed (no error, no fall-through). The chain is evaluated in exactly this order, and a stage that matches consumes the press.
- **`Alt/Option+Shift+1..9`** — toggles the selection checkbox of Overview row N (the Overview viewport must be visible; the press is consumed once a row is found, even when the row has no checkbox).
- **`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Backslash`** — bulk-opens Split View from the Session Overview: the "split" action button of the Overview footer (the same button a mouse user clicks, marked with a stable `data-web-shell-*` attribute) is pressed when the Overview viewport is visible; the Overview's multi-select checkboxes plus this chord give a keyboard path to the "selected sessions → split" flow.
- **`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+F`** — maximizes the focused split pane (restores it when already maximized), when focus is inside a pane.
- **`Cmd/Ctrl+T`** — context-dependent: on a session view (`/session/…`) it presses the New task button (the same button the sidebar renders); on the new-task screen it opens the workspace picker (a synthesized primary-pointerdown/up + click sequence, because Radix triggers only open on pointer events, not bare `click`).
- **Focus ring** — the programmatically focused approval option carries a `data-web-shell-hotkey-focused` mark (removed when the option loses focus) that the card styles match alongside `:focus-visible`; WKWebView does not match `:focus-visible` on the programmatic-focus path.

The new behaviors live in a small module `packages/web-shell/client/utils/viewNavHotkeys.ts` (pure DOM logic, no React) plus stable `data-web-shell-*` attributes on the target elements (session-table viewport, pane maximize button, workspace-select trigger, new-task button, pinned-section header, the Overview "Open in Split" footer button) instead of CSS-module class matching (build-hashed, not a stable selector) or rendered-text matching (locale-fragile). Key matching is by physical key (`event.code`), so all chords work on non-QWERTY layouts without switching to English.

## Why it's needed

#13175 ("Add keyboard shortcuts for Web Shell view navigation") was closed by #14179 with only the first two chords (`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+O`, `Cmd/Ctrl+\`); the issue's local patch defined the rest of the set, and it is the difference between "keyboard can open views" and "keyboard can drive a multi-pane working session": jumping to the Nth approval option / Overview row / pinned session / pane without touching the mouse, selecting Overview rows and bulk-splitting them, maximizing a pane, and starting a new task — plus seeing, while the modifier is held, exactly where the next number will go.

Host note: the digit cluster, `Cmd/Ctrl+T`, and the number preview target the **desktop shell host** (Qwen Code Desktop, Tauri/WKWebView) first — see "Risk & Scope" for the browser-host reservation caveat. The chords bound there produce no printable character in any layout: the digit cluster, maximize, split, and new-task combinations are bound even while the composer holds focus (an explicit composer exemption on the editable-target guard). The `Alt/Option+Shift+1..9` checkbox combination is the deliberate exception — on some layouts (macOS US) it produces a printable character, so it is exempt from the composer: the character types into the focused editor instead of toggling a row checkbox.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- New unit suite `client/utils/viewNavHotkeys.test.ts` (jsdom, 58 cases): the full behavior matrix of the local patch — digit chain priority (approval > Overview > Pinned > pane, incl. pane-with-composer-focus wins), swallow semantics (N > count at every stage), Pinned collapsed/expanded/absent/hidden, RU-layout digit codes, `Cmd/Ctrl+T` session-vs-picker stages and the pointer-sequence it synthesizes, bulk-split footer-button selection, maximize chord, the `Alt+Shift` Overview-checkbox chord, and the number-preview matrix (targets per surface, the nine-target cap, claim-without-targets at every stage, no fall-through from a collapsed/hidden Pinned section, dialog suppression, re-numbering a changed list under a held modifier, single-style-element idempotence, hide).
- Integration tests in `App.test.tsx` (`App view navigation hotkeys — surface chords`, 20 cases: the chord consumption/guard wiring plus 9 new preview cases): wiring through the real App listener — consumption, the shared guards (open modal dialog → not consumed, terminal/editable → not consumed), composer focus → approval option focused, `repeat: true` → not consumed, and the preview wiring — show on the modifier keydown, clear on the released modifier's keyup (sent with the flag the browser actually sets), dual-hold join/release ordering, `Alt`-joins hide, window-blur hide, editable-target suppression, composer-exempt show, dialog suppression, and re-numbering under a held modifier.
- Full web-shell suite in Docker (`node:22-bookworm`, head `d2a8fb220d`): 524 files / 14259 tests pass; `tsc --noEmit` (web-shell) clean; eslint clean on the touched files; prettier clean on the touched files.
- E2E on a live build of this branch (PR-head daemon in Docker + real Chrome over CDP, head `d2a8fb220d`): 8/8 checks pass — served-bundle fingerprint (the page loads the PR-head build), `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+O` opens the Session Overview, and the number preview: modifier keydown → numbered 1..N badges on the Overview rows, modifier keyup → badges cleared, the Pinned-section surface (header present, expanded), dialog open → badges suppressed, window blur → badges cleared, a list change under the held modifier → re-numbered, plus the `Alt/Option+Shift+1` Overview checkbox-chord regression. The earlier 23-check chord matrix ran on this branch's previous heads (see PR comments); the upstream/main merge into `d2a8fb220d` touched the same App listener and the Pinned-header markup, both re-exercised here.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-visual change (keyboard behavior) except the preview badge: covered by the test matrix above and the e2e probe results in the comments.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ e2e on head `d2a8fb220d`: 8/8 CDP checks through real Chrome against the PR-head daemon in Docker (`node:22-bookworm`) — served-bundle fingerprint, chord-open, the full number-preview matrix (badges on hold, cleared on keyup, dialog suppression, blur clear, re-numbering under a held modifier), the `Alt/Option+Shift+1` checkbox-chord regression, with negative controls |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested on a Windows host — the Windows CI matrix never ran on this PR's heads (cancelled/skipped by the workflow); the PR touches web-shell client only, no Windows-specific code; behavior covered by the ubuntu web-shell E2E Smoke and the CDP e2e above. The Ctrl-flavor of every chord is exercised by the unit/integration suites (`ctrlKey: true` variants) |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ Docker `node:22-bookworm` (head `d2a8fb220d`): full web-shell suite 524 files / 14259 tests, `tsc --noEmit`, eslint, prettier clean; CI lanes on the PR head |

### Environment

Docker `node:22-bookworm` for the full suite and the e2e daemon (PR-head build); Chrome (CDP) on macOS for the physical-key e2e matrix.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff — **browser-reserved keys, stated plainly** (per review item B1): `Cmd/Ctrl+1..9` (tab switch) and `Cmd/Ctrl+T` (new tab) are chrome-level reserved shortcuts in real browsers such as Chrome; in a plain browser tab the browser can consume them before any renderer-side handler runs, and `preventDefault` in the page cannot stop a chrome-level action (CDP/jsdom/Playwright inject below that layer, which is why the synthetic-event matrix passes there). **In a real browser tab these specific chords are therefore inert; the number preview shows (the bare modifier press reaches the page) but the numbers it shows are actionable only where the digit cluster fires.** The primary host is Qwen Code Desktop (Tauri/WKWebView), which has no tab switching, and there the chords and the preview work as described. The two pre-existing chords from #14179 (`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+O`, `Cmd/Ctrl+\`) are not browser-reserved and work in both hosts. Direction decision (with the PR author): keep these bindings and document the host limitation rather than rebind to `Shift`-flavored alternatives — the desktop shell is the product surface this shortcut set drives.
- Guard scope: the capture-phase handler only fires inside the Web Shell page and only after the shared guards pass; `Alt` (which would let the browser tab switch win) and `repeat`/IME are excluded; the digit chord is swallowed on over-range instead of falling through. Programmatic focus changes (approval option, pane composer) are additive and do not alter the focused session's data.
- Not validated / out of scope: OS-level browser menu conflicts beyond default Chrome/Edge/Safari/Firefox tab reservations (none of the remaining combinations is a default menu binding in those browsers, except the tab-reserved ones named above, which are page-scoped only and inert in a browser tab); per-browser variance in how early a reserved key is consumed was not measured per release.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — the change is additive; no existing shortcut, guard, or public API changes.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13175 (remaining scope of the local patch; #14179 shipped the first two chords).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

在 #14179（#13175 的前两个组合）引入的 Web Shell 视图导航快捷键基础上，补齐剩余的键盘行为，全部由 `App.tsx` 中同一个捕获阶段 `keydown` 监听器处理（现有的 `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+O` 与 `Cmd/Ctrl+\` 组合及其监听器的既有守卫——打开的对话框/全屏面板、web 终端、可编辑目标、按键自动重复、IME 组合、`Alt`——均未改动）：

- **数字预览（按住 Cmd/Ctrl）** — 按住 Cmd（macOS）或 Ctrl（Windows/Linux）时，数字导航簇的前九个目标以 1..9 的小号强调色胶囊标出数字，让下一次按键落点一目了然（macOS 菜单栏按住修饰键显示数字的惯例）。徽章是 CSS `::after`，由 `data-web-shell-nav-preview` 属性驱动——不增加 DOM 节点，因此行在按住期间被 React 重渲染也不会丢失或重复徽章。目标、优先级与"占位"语义和纯数字按键完全一致：审批卡片即使没有选项组也占位、Session Overview 表格即使没有行也占位、存在但折叠的 Pinned 区块不编号（第一次按键是展开而不是跳转），只有 Pinned 头部缺失或隐藏时才落到 split 面板。预览在每次修饰键 keydown 时重新编号（按住期间列表变化会自动重编号），并在修饰键 keyup 时清除——"是否仍按住"以*另一个*修饰键判断，因为被释放修饰键的 keyup 事件仍携带自身的标志位——窗口失焦或 `Alt` 加入时同样清除（`Alt`+数字是另一族组合）。
- **`Cmd/Ctrl+1..9`** — 数字导航簇，按优先级链处理：(1) 可见的工具审批卡片——聚焦第 N 个审批选项（composer 持焦的面板优先于其他可见卡片）；(2) Session Overview 的第 N 行（Overview 视口可见时，行点击，与鼠标点击相同）；(3) 侧边栏 Pinned 区块——折叠时展开，展开时激活第 N 个置顶会话行；(4) Split View 多面板时：聚焦第 N 个面板的 composer。超界数字被吞掉（无报错、无穿透）。链条严格按此顺序求值，命中的阶段消费该按键。
- **`Alt/Option+Shift+1..9`** — 切换 Overview 第 N 行的选择复选框（Overview 视口须可见；找到行即消费该按键，即使该行没有复选框）。
- **`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Backslash`** — 从 Session Overview 批量打开 Split View：Overview 视口可见时按下 Overview 页脚中的 "Open in Split" 按钮（鼠标用户点击的同一个按钮，带稳定的 `data-web-shell-*` 属性）；Overview 的多选复选框 + 该组合 = "选中会话 → 分屏"流程的键盘路径。
- **`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+F`** — 焦点所在分屏面板的最大化/还原（焦点在面板内时）。
- **`Cmd/Ctrl+T`** — 上下文相关：会话视图（`/session/…`）上按 New task 按钮（即侧边栏渲染的那个按钮）；新建任务屏上打开工作区选择器（合成主指针 pointerdown/up + click 序列，因为 Radix 触发器只响应指针事件，不响应裸 `click`）。
- **焦点环** — 程序化聚焦的审批选项携带 `data-web-shell-hotkey-focused` 标记（选项失焦时移除），卡片样式将其与 `:focus-visible` 并列匹配；WKWebView 在程序化聚焦路径上不匹配 `:focus-visible`。

新行为位于小模块 `packages/web-shell/client/utils/viewNavHotkeys.ts`（纯 DOM 逻辑，无 React）+ 目标元素上的稳定 `data-web-shell-*` 属性（会话表视口、面板最大化按钮、工作区选择触发器、New task 按钮、Pinned 区块头部、Overview 页脚 "Open in Split" 按钮），而不是 CSS-module class 匹配（构建期哈希，非稳定选择器）或渲染文本匹配（受语言环境影响）。按键按物理键（`event.code`）匹配，因此所有组合在非 QWERTY 布局上无需切换英文即可工作。

## 为什么需要

#13175（"为 Web Shell 视图导航添加键盘快捷键"）由 #14179 交付了前两个组合（`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+O`、`Cmd/Ctrl+\`）后关闭；该 issue 的本地补丁定义了剩余全部行为，而这正是"键盘能打开视图"与"键盘能驱动多面板工作会话"之间的差距：不碰鼠标跳到第 N 个审批选项 / Overview 行 / 置顶会话 / 面板，选中 Overview 行并批量分屏，最大化面板，以及新建任务——并且按住修饰键时就能看到下一个数字落在哪里。

宿主说明：数字簇、`Cmd/Ctrl+T` 与数字预览以**桌面壳宿主**（Qwen Code Desktop，Tauri/WKWebView）为首要目标——浏览器宿主的按键保留问题见"风险与范围"。在桌面壳绑定的组合在任何布局下都不产生可打印字符：数字簇、最大化、分屏、新建任务组合即使在 composer 持焦时也可绑定（可编辑目标守卫上有明确的 composer 豁免）。`Alt/Option+Shift+1..9` 复选框组合是有意例外——在部分布局（macOS US）上它产生可打印字符，因此它不适用于 composer：字符会输入到聚焦的编辑器，而不是切换行复选框。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 新增单元测试 `client/utils/viewNavHotkeys.test.ts`（jsdom，58 例）：本地补丁的完整行为矩阵——数字链优先级（审批 > Overview > Pinned > 面板，含 composer 持焦面板优先）、吞掉语义（各阶段 N > 数量）、Pinned 折叠/展开/缺席/隐藏、RU 布局数字码、`Cmd/Ctrl+T` 会话/选择器两阶段及其合成的指针序列、批量分屏页脚按钮选择、最大化组合、`Alt+Shift` Overview 复选框组合，以及数字预览矩阵（各表面的目标、九目标上限、各阶段的"占位但无目标"、折叠/隐藏 Pinned 区块不穿透、对话框抑制、按住期间列表变化重编号、style 元素单例幂等、hide 清除）。
- `App.test.tsx` 集成测试（`App view navigation hotkeys — surface chords`，20 例：chord 消费/守卫接线 + 9 个新预览用例）：经过真实 App 监听器的接线——消费、共享守卫（打开的模态对话框 → 不消费，终端/可编辑 → 不消费）、composer 持焦 → 审批选项获焦、`repeat: true` → 不消费，以及预览接线——修饰键 keydown 显示、被释放修饰键的 keyup 清除（按浏览器实际设置的标志位发送事件）、双修饰键先后加入/释放的顺序、`Alt` 加入隐藏、窗口失焦隐藏、可编辑目标抑制、composer 豁免显示、对话框抑制、按住期间列表变化重编号。
- Docker（`node:22-bookworm`，head `d2a8fb220d`）完整 web-shell 套件：524 个文件 / 14259 个测试通过；`tsc --noEmit`（web-shell）干净；改动文件 eslint 干净；改动文件 prettier 干净。
- 本分支真实构建的 E2E（PR head 守护进程在 Docker 内 + 真实 Chrome 经 CDP，head `d2a8fb220d`）：8/8 项检查通过——served 指纹（页面加载的正是 PR head 构建）、`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+O` 打开 Session Overview、数字预览：修饰键 keydown → Overview 行出现 1..N 编号徽章、keyup → 徽章清除、Pinned 区块表面（头部存在且展开）、对话框打开 → 徽章被抑制、窗口失焦 → 徽章清除、按住期间列表变化 → 重编号，外加 `Alt/Option+Shift+1` Overview 复选框组合回归。此前的 23 项组合键矩阵在本分支早先 head 上运行（见 PR 评论）；upstream/main 合入 `d2a8fb220d` 触及同一 App 监听器与 Pinned 头部标记，均在此复验。

### 证据（前后对比）

除预览徽章外为非视觉变更（键盘行为）：由上述测试矩阵与评论中的 e2e 探针结果覆盖。

### 测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ e2e（head `d2a8fb220d`）：经真实 Chrome（CDP）对 Docker 内（`node:22-bookworm`）PR head 守护进程 8/8 项检查——served 指纹、组合键打开、完整数字预览矩阵（按住出现徽章、keyup 清除、对话框抑制、失焦清除、按住期间重编号）、`Alt/Option+Shift+1` 复选框组合回归，含负向控制 |

|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ Docker `node:22-bookworm`（head `d2a8fb220d`）：完整 web-shell 套件 524 个文件 / 14259 个测试、`tsc --noEmit`、eslint、prettier 干净；PR head 上的 CI lane |

### 环境

Docker `node:22-bookworm` 用于完整套件与 e2e 守护进程（PR head 构建）；macOS 上的 Chrome（CDP）用于物理按键 e2e 矩阵。

- 主要风险与取舍——**浏览器保留键，直说**（按评审意见 B1）：`Cmd/Ctrl+1..9`（切换标签页）与 `Cmd/Ctrl+T`（新标签页）在 Chrome 等真实浏览器中是浏览器层保留快捷键；在普通浏览器标签页中，浏览器可能在任何渲染层处理器运行前就消费掉它们，页面内的 `preventDefault` 无法阻止浏览器层动作（CDP/jsdom/Playwright 注入在该层之下，因此合成事件矩阵在那里能过）。**因此在真实浏览器标签页中这些具体组合是无效的；数字预览仍会显示（裸修饰键按键能到达页面），但它标出的数字只在数字簇生效的地方可行动。** 首要宿主是 Qwen Code Desktop（Tauri/WKWebView），没有标签页切换，组合与预览在那里按描述工作。#14179 的两个既有组合（`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+O`、`Cmd/Ctrl+\`）不被浏览器保留，两个宿主都可用。方向决策（与 PR 作者共同）：保留这些绑定并如实记录宿主限制，而不是改绑 `Shift` 变体——桌面壳正是这套快捷键驱动的产品表面。

- 未验证/范围外：除上述浏览器保留键外，未逐浏览器、逐版本测量保留键被消费时机的差异；其余组合在这些浏览器的默认菜单绑定中均无冲突。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无——变更为增量式；不改动任何既有快捷键、守卫或公共 API。

prs.title: fix(review): propagate explicit run deadlines to the child
prs.body:
## What this PR does

An explicitly supplied review-run timeout now becomes an absolute deadline in the child review's environment. A valid earlier inherited deadline wins. The hard timer and exported cutoff share the same start time, including time spent preparing the child. Unless the operator supplies a valid non-negative reserve override, the child also receives a tail reserve scaled from that effective budget using the existing plan-reserve floor and cap. Blank and malformed overrides receive the scaled reserve; zero remains a valid override.

The option's implicit 120-minute hard timeout is preserved. Leaving the option absent does not introduce an explicit soft clock or change the huge-review round cap.

A short explicit budget now produces a stderr advisory before the child starts, including under `--quiet`, using the default reserve and first-round estimates. Environment overrides can change actual admission, and the hard timeout remains in force. Help qualifies the budget-stop cap as applying to an otherwise-Approve verdict. The review instructions and user documentation consistently include an explicit run timeout among the deadline sources.

## Why it's needed

The process enforcing the timeout and the review's budget checks previously used separate clocks. For example, an explicit ten-hour timeout could leave the child using a sixteen-hour topology default, so it would admit more work with less time remaining than it believed. Exporting the existing deadline variable aligns the live gate and remaining-time consumers with the enclosing run's cutoff. Blank or malformed reserve overrides could still suppress scaling, while a short explicit timeout gave no upfront indication that the default reserve and first round would not fit. The follow-up fixes the invalid-value fallback and exposes that estimate without rejecting the hard-timeout value.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start a review with an explicit 600-minute timeout and inspect the environment passed to its child. Resolve the review deadline from that environment and a captured huge-diff plan; the effective budget should be 600 minutes.
2. Repeat with inherited deadlines 300 and 900 minutes away. The effective deadlines should be 300 and 600 minutes respectively. An expired valid deadline must stay expired; malformed inherited values should not displace the run's valid cutoff.
3. Parse the real command with no timeout option, an explicit 120, and an explicit 0. Absence should keep the existing implicit behavior; with a controlled clock, no process-group termination should occur at 120 minutes minus 1 ms, and the next millisecond should send SIGTERM. Explicit values should publish their effective deadline, including the existing one-minute floor for 0.
4. Delay child preparation, then advance the clock to the original hard deadline. The process-group termination should occur at that deadline rather than granting another full timeout after startup.
5. Run with explicit 120 and 100 minute budgets without a reserve override. Expect reserves of 2,400 and 2,000 seconds. Pass the exported environment to the real reverse-audit gate: a 120-minute run must still admit a round at minute 11. Repeat with an earlier inherited deadline and valid reserve overrides, including zero and whitespace around zero, to verify their precedence. Blank, malformed, non-finite and negative reserve values should instead receive the scaled reserve.
6. Run explicit 45-, 50- and 120-minute budgets. The default-estimate advisory should appear for 45 minutes even under `--quiet`, and should name the 20-minute reserve and 30-minute first-round estimate. It should be absent at the exact 50-minute boundary and at 120 minutes. A valid zero reserve can still admit the 45-minute round; the advisory describes default estimates, not a guaranteed refusal. The 45-minute hard timer must still terminate the process group at its deadline.

Historical validation at reviewed commit `f5a08285854d03543c586e0bfdcc826acc1c32ec` passed 195 CLI tests (85 review-run and 110 deadline tests) and 79 bundled review-skill tests. For that initial reserve-scaling fix, the regressions produced nine failures and thirteen passing controls before the fix and passed afterward. Targeted ESLint, formatting and `git diff --check` also passed at that historical revision.

Historical [hosted validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43402624111) passed for exact commit `f5a08285854d03543c586e0bfdcc826acc1c32ec` on Linux with Node.js 22 and frozen pnpm dependencies. The standard `npm run build` and full workspace/integration `npm run typecheck` both passed. The exact-source regressions passed **195 CLI tests** across the run/deadline suites and **79 bundled review-skill tests** (274 total, 0 failures or skips). This is fork validation; the upstream PR workflow still requires maintainer authorization.

Round-2 exact candidate `7a990a5d0736023f0745620e708eed559fa6fce9`: the standard package configurations passed **206 CLI tests** (96 review-run and 110 deadline tests) and **79 bundled review-skill tests**, 285 total with zero failures or skips. After the counterfactual checks and source restoration, the complete 96-test review-run suite and the separate five-case independent fixture also passed with zero failures or skips. [Hosted validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43422525851): on Linux with Node.js 22.23.4 and pnpm 11.24.0, frozen-lockfile installation, standard `npm run build`, full workspace/integration `npm run typecheck`, `npm run bundle`, targeted ESLint and formatting all passed. The hosted tests retained the original package configurations and global setup; they did not use the local source-function fallback. The [upstream PR CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43424634196) remains at `action_required` pending maintainer authorization.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Historical evidence for the same `f5a08285` commit: an independent fixture invokes the real command handler, captures the environment from its child launch, and passes it to the actual capture and deadline consumers. The fixture controls the child launch and clock; no model run or multi-hour wait is needed.

| Explicit run timeout | Inherited deadline | Effective live deadline before | After |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 600 minutes | None | 960 minutes | 600 minutes |
| 600 minutes | 900 minutes | 900 minutes | 600 minutes |
| 600 minutes | 300 minutes | 300 minutes | 300 minutes |

The unchanged independent fixture passes all three cases after the fix. The captured plan's default duration remains unchanged; its live readers correctly prefer the exported environment deadline during this run.

A second independent fixture sends the actual handler's child environment to the real reverse-audit gate. Before reserve scaling, an explicit 120-minute run was rejected at minute 11, and a 100-minute run was rejected immediately; the inherited-reserve control passed. After the fix, all three cases pass. These checks advance a controlled clock and do not claim a live multi-hour model run.

For the round-2 follow-up, a separate source-function fixture independently observed three failing assertions and two passing controls on `f5a08285`: an empty reserve remained empty and refused the 100-minute round using the 4,800-second fallback; a malformed reserve remained malformed; and a 45-minute default budget emitted no pre-spawn warning. The valid zero-reserve control admitted the 45-minute round, and the ordinary 120-minute control remained admissible. The fixture invokes the real command handler and deadline consumers with a controlled child and clock. Candidate verification: all five original cases passed, with zero failures or skips, against the candidate source. The only fixture adjustment was its portable temporary-directory path; assertions and production imports were unchanged. Empty and malformed values now receive the scaled reserve, zero still admits the 45-minute round, and the new pre-spawn warning explicitly distinguishes the default estimates from environment overrides. Mutation and restoration evidence: on the hosted runner, restoring only the parent run source while retaining the committed regression tests produced eight direct assertion failures and 88 passing controls; the independent fixture produced three failures and two passing controls. Five targeted `-t` mutation selections then produced 6, 2, 1, 1 and 1 direct assertion failures for absent-only reserve handling, no warning, environment-dependent estimates, rejecting the equality boundary and a 90-minute implicit timeout, respectively. The other tests were filtered out in these selections (90, 91, 91, 91 and 93 respectively), not executed. After restoring the exact candidate source, all 96 review-run tests and all five independent cases passed, and the source diff was clean.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| macOS | Not run |
| Windows | Not run |
| Linux | Historical `f5a08285`: command, parser, deadline and process-timer fixtures passed; round-2 candidate: standard build, all workspace/integration types and bundle passed; 206 CLI + 79 skill tests passed; the restored 96-test run suite and independent five-case fixture passed separately |

### Environment

Historical local checks and the round-2 local source-function verification used Node.js 24.22.1 and Vitest 3.2.7, actual command parsing and deadline consumers, controlled clocks and child-process launch. The local source-function fallback retains package source aliases and setup while omitting unrelated workspace build prerequisites; it is reported separately from the unchanged standard hosted package and build gates.

## Risk & Scope

- Main tradeoff: an explicit timeout now engages the existing soft deadline rules, including the huge-review round reduction. An earlier valid CI deadline is never extended, and the parent environment is not mutated. The new advisory uses stderr even under `--quiet`; it preserves the stdout result and hard-timeout contracts.
- Not validated / out of scope: a live multi-hour model review, cross-shell persistence of the operator's timeout, and changes to the default 120-minute hard timeout. A later resume without the exported environment still uses the plan's recorded wall; this addresses the same-run half of the issue, not that separate persistence behavior. The current candidate is checked separately through the round-2 hosted validation linked above. The separate long-timeout huge-review round policy remains deferred, as recorded in the latest review.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no new flag, environment variable, or persisted plan field. Help still describes the 120-minute default, but the parser now preserves absence so that an implicit default and an explicit value remain distinguishable.

## Linked Issues

Refs #12044, same-run deadline alignment.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

显式传入的评审运行超时现在会转换为子评审环境中的绝对截止时间。如果继承环境里已有更早的有效截止时间，就保留更早值。硬超时计时器与导出的截止时刻共用同一起点，包含准备子进程所花的时间。若操作者没有提供有效的非负 reserve 覆盖值，子进程还会收到按实际生效预算缩放的收尾预留时间，沿用已有 plan reserve 的下限和上限。空白或格式错误的覆盖值会替换为缩放值；零仍是有效覆盖值。

省略选项时，既有的 120 分钟硬超时保持不变，不额外引入显式软时钟，也不改变巨大评审的轮次上限。

显式预算过短时，启动子进程前会向 stderr 输出按默认 reserve 与首轮估价计算的提示，`--quiet` 下也会显示。环境覆盖值可能改变实际准入结果，硬超时仍然生效。帮助将预算停止的封顶限定为本会是 Approve 的结论。评审指引与用户文档也一致列出显式运行超时这一截止时间来源。

## 为什么需要

负责强制超时的父进程与评审预算检查原先使用不同的时钟。例如，显式设置十小时超时后，子评审仍可能使用由规模推导的十六小时默认值，在实际剩余时间已经不足时继续接纳工作。导出已有的截止时间变量后，本轮运行中的门控及剩余时间计算会与外层运行的截止时刻对齐。空白或格式错误的 reserve 覆盖值仍可能阻止缩放，而过短的显式超时没有预先说明默认 reserve 与首轮预算无法同时容纳。本次跟进修复无效值的回退并显示该估算，同时继续接受硬超时值。

## 审阅者验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 使用显式 600 分钟超时启动评审，检查传给子进程的环境。将该环境和巨大 diff 的已捕获计划交给实际截止时间解析逻辑，有效预算应为 600 分钟。
2. 分别继承距离现在 300 和 900 分钟的截止时间，有效值应为 300 和 600 分钟。已过期但有效的截止时间必须继续过期；格式错误的继承值不得取代运行本身的有效截止时刻。
3. 用真实命令解析器分别解析省略选项、显式 120 和显式 0。省略时保留原隐式行为；在受控时钟下，120 分钟前 1 毫秒不得终止进程组，再推进 1 毫秒应发送 SIGTERM。显式值会导出有效截止时间，0 仍按已有规则提升至一分钟下限。
4. 延迟子进程准备阶段，再把时钟推进到原始硬截止时刻。此时应终止进程组，而不是在启动完成后重新获得一整个超时周期。
5. 不设 reserve 覆盖值，分别使用显式 120 和 100 分钟预算，应导出 2,400 和 2,000 秒 reserve。把实际子进程环境交给真实审计门控，120 分钟的运行在第 11 分钟仍应允许进入一轮审计。再检查更早的继承截止时间，以及包括零和带空白的零在内的有效 reserve 覆盖值，确认优先级不变。空白、格式错误、非有限数及负值应替换为缩放后的 reserve。
6. 分别运行显式 45、50 和 120 分钟预算。45 分钟时应显示默认估算提示，`--quiet` 下也一样，并点明 20 分钟 reserve 与 30 分钟首轮估价；恰好 50 分钟的边界和 120 分钟则不显示。有效的零 reserve 仍可允许 45 分钟预算进入一轮审计；提示描述默认估算，并非保证一定拒绝。45 分钟硬计时器仍必须在截止时刻终止进程组。

已评审提交 `f5a08285854d03543c586e0bfdcc826acc1c32ec` 的历史验证通过 195 项 CLI 测试（85 项 review-run、110 项 deadline）以及 79 项内置 review skill 测试。该初始 reserve 缩放修复的回归在修复前为九项失败、十三项对照通过，修复后通过。该历史版本的定向 ESLint、格式及 `git diff --check` 也通过。

针对历史精确提交 `f5a08285854d03543c586e0bfdcc826acc1c32ec` 的[托管验证](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43402624111)已通过，环境为 Linux、Node.js 22 和冻结锁文件的 pnpm 依赖。标准 `npm run build`、全工作区及集成代码的 `npm run typecheck` 均通过。同一提交的 run/deadline 套件通过 **195 项 CLI 测试**，内置 review skill 套件通过 **79 项测试**，共 274 项、0 失败、0 跳过。这是 fork 验证；上游 PR 工作流仍需维护者授权。

第二轮精确候选 `7a990a5d0736023f0745620e708eed559fa6fce9`：保持标准包配置，通过 **206 项 CLI 测试**（96 项 review-run、110 项 deadline）及 **79 项内置 review skill 测试**，共 285 项、0 失败、0 跳过。反向验证并恢复源码后，完整的 96 项 review-run 套件与独立五项夹具也分别通过，均为 0 失败、0 跳过。[托管验证](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43422525851)：在 Linux、Node.js 22.23.4、pnpm 11.24.0 环境中，冻结锁文件安装、标准 `npm run build`、全工作区及集成代码的 `npm run typecheck`、`npm run bundle`、定向 ESLint 和格式检查全部通过。托管测试保留原包配置和 global setup，未采用本地源码函数备用配置。[上游 PR CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43424634196) 仍为 `action_required`，等待维护者授权。

### 修改前后证据

以下为同一历史提交 `f5a08285` 的证据：独立夹具调用真实命令处理器，取得实际传给子进程的环境，再交给真实的计划捕获与截止时间消费者。夹具控制子进程启动与时钟，无需模型运行或等待数小时。

| 显式运行超时 | 继承截止时间 | 修改前的本轮有效截止时间 | 修改后 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 600 分钟 | 无 | 960 分钟 | 600 分钟 |
| 600 分钟 | 900 分钟 | 900 分钟 | 600 分钟 |
| 600 分钟 | 300 分钟 | 300 分钟 | 300 分钟 |

原独立夹具无需修改，修复后三项全部通过。捕获计划中的默认时长保持原值，但本轮实时读取方会正确地优先使用导出的环境截止时间。

另一组独立夹具把真实处理器的子进程环境交给真实审计门控：修复 reserve 缩放前，显式 120 分钟运行在第 11 分钟被拒绝，100 分钟运行在启动时即被拒绝，继承 reserve 对照通过；修复后三项全部通过。这里推进的是受控时钟，没有宣称执行多小时真实模型评审。

针对第二轮跟进，另一份源码函数夹具在 `f5a08285` 上独立观察到三项断言失败、两项对照通过：空 reserve 仍为空，门控以 4,800 秒回退值拒绝 100 分钟预算；格式错误的 reserve 仍保持错误值；45 分钟默认预算在启动子进程前没有提示。有效零 reserve 对照允许 45 分钟预算进入审计，普通 120 分钟对照也正常准入。夹具调用真实命令处理器与截止时间消费者，只控制子进程和时钟。候选验证：原五项用例在候选源码上全部通过，0 失败、0 跳过。夹具只调整为可跨环境使用的临时目录路径，断言及生产代码导入保持不变。空白和格式错误的值改用缩放 reserve，零值仍允许 45 分钟预算进入审计，新增的启动前提示明确区分默认估算与环境覆盖值。反向验证与恢复证据：托管运行中，仅将 run 生产源码恢复为父提交，同时保留已提交回归测试，得到八项直接断言失败、88 项对照通过；独立夹具得到三项失败、两项对照通过。五次按 `-t` 筛选的定向变异分别针对只处理缺失 reserve、移除提示、让估算依赖环境、错误拒绝相等边界以及把隐式超时改成 90 分钟，得到 6、2、1、1、1 项直接断言失败。各次未匹配的 90、91、91、91、93 项被过滤，并未执行。恢复精确候选源码后，完整 96 项 review-run 测试与独立五项用例全部通过，源码差异检查干净。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :--- | :--- |
| macOS | 未运行 |
| Windows | 未运行 |
| Linux | 历史提交 `f5a08285`：命令、解析器、截止时间及进程计时器夹具通过；第二轮候选：标准构建、全工作区及集成类型检查和 bundle 通过；206 项 CLI 与 79 项 skill 测试通过；恢复后的 96 项 run 套件及独立五项夹具另行通过 |

### 环境

历史本地检查与第二轮本地源码函数验证使用 Node.js 24.22.1、Vitest 3.2.7、真实命令解析与截止时间消费者、受控时钟及子进程启动。本地源码函数备用配置保留包的源码别名与测试 setup，只省略无关的工作区构建前置检查；其结果与保持原配置的标准托管包测试及构建门禁分别记录。

## 风险与范围

- 主要取舍：显式超时现在会启用已有软截止规则，包括巨大评审的轮次削减。更早的有效 CI 截止时间不会被延长，也不修改父进程环境。新增提示在 `--quiet` 下仍使用 stderr，保留 stdout 结果及硬超时契约。
- 未验证或范围外：真实多小时模型评审、跨 shell 持久化操作者设置的超时，以及默认 120 分钟硬超时的调整。如果以后从没有导出该环境的 shell 恢复评审，仍会使用计划记录的时长；本次处理 issue 中同一轮运行的对齐部分，不处理单独的持久化问题。当前候选另由上方链接的第二轮托管验证检查。更长显式超时下的巨大评审轮次策略保持延后，沿用最新评审记录的范围。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：不新增选项、环境变量或持久化计划字段。帮助仍说明 120 分钟默认值，但解析器现在保留“省略选项”的信息，使隐式默认值与显式值可被区分。

## 关联问题

关联 #12044 中同一轮运行的截止时间对齐部分。

prs.title: fix(cli): dispatch MCP commands with preceding global options
prs.body:
## What this PR does

MCP management commands now accept registered global options between `mcp` and the subcommand while retaining the dedicated MCP parser. The prefix is parsed only up to the first command token, then the remaining arguments are passed intact to the existing MCP command parser.

For example, `qwen mcp --debug add srv docker run -d alpine` adds the intended server and preserves `-d` in its saved arguments. A prefix with only options or help prints MCP help without modifying settings. An explicit separator keeps its existing meaning: `qwen mcp -- list` runs the list operation, while `qwen mcp -- --safe-mode remove victim` prints help without running removal. Default-command options such as `--model` are rejected in this prefix. Global options before `mcp` retain their existing dispatch.

The follow-ups also print MCP usage after a rejected global prefix and preserve unconsumed literal server arguments, including `--args value`, `--args=value` and numeric-shaped values such as `0x10`. Ambiguous server flags that yargs would otherwise consume as undeclared options are rejected before `--`; placing them after `--` preserves them literally. Numeric MCP options such as `--timeout` keep their declared number type before that separator.

## Why it's needed

The original fast path could treat a prefixed command as parent help and exit successfully without performing the operation. Routing the entire invocation through the full parser fixed dispatch but let root aliases consume server arguments: the server's Docker `-d` disappeared because it was interpreted as the CLI's debug flag.

Parsing just the prefix fixes both failures. Management commands accept registered non-help global options in this position for compatibility and ignore them and their values, including `--proxy`, `--insecure` and `--telemetry-*`. The documentation now states that boundary explicitly. The separator follow-up also prevents explicitly positional tokens from being reinterpreted as global options and turning a help invocation into a removal.

## Latest review follow-up (`a391853684a5c4db9f8829c53da0083086621a9b`)

Ordinary `mcp add` validation errors now print the error on stderr and the add usage on stdout, then throw `AlreadyReportedError`. This preserves the explicit abort before settings can be loaded or written, and the existing top-level handler exits with code 1 without an internal-error banner or stack trace. Strict option checks and literal server-argument handling remain in place.

Three new cases enter through the real `runCliEntry(['mcp', ...])` path with the actual add command: a missing executable, an invalid transport, and a debug-prefixed ambiguous server flag. They assert the diagnostic, usage, already-reported exit-code marker, and absence of settings reads/writes. These new tests have not yet completed runtime validation. The [current-head upstream CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43665647732) is queued; the historical counts below apply only to the named earlier commits.

## Prior review follow-up (`0011890a48a2e9d1775453d096a4e5c8a1982076`)

The MCP add parser now rejects ambiguous server flags such as `--env-file`, `--timeout-secs`, `--header-x=y`, `--trust-all`, `--description-x` and `--scope-x` **before `--`**, before its settings handler runs. Put server-only options after `--` to preserve them literally, for example `qwen mcp --debug add srv docker run -- --env-file .env image`. Ordinary unconsumed server arguments retain their existing behavior.

Strict option checking is paired with a throwing failure policy: the parent MCP failure handler reports the error and returns, so strict validation alone could still reach the add handler. The regressions install a returning parent failure handler to pin this boundary. The MCP registration test now expects the actual command signature, and a strict-parent regression verifies that the pre-separator tail and post-separator tail keep their order.

Historical local validation at `0011890a`:

- The two exact command test files pass **57/57** in an isolated Vitest harness. Keeping these tests and restoring the previous add implementation and stale registration expectation produces **8 failures / 49 passes**. Settings and unrelated command imports are test boundaries in this harness.
- An independent harness uses the production fast-path functions extracted from `cli.ts`, the actual MCP command builders, yargs **17.7.2**, the callback-based parse path, and a file-backed settings boundary. Its **48 A/B process cases** cover plain and debug-prefixed invocation: the parent makes 14 incorrect settings writes; the candidate rejects all 14 with exit 1 and unchanged settings. All 10 candidate controls pass, including `-d`, both `--args` spellings, `0x10` plus numeric timeout, and mixed pre/post-`--` arguments.
- All four changed files pass the repository Prettier configuration.

These are historical source-level and isolated command results for `0011890a`, separate from the current-head CI linked above. The hosted results below belong to their explicitly named earlier commits.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run `qwen mcp --debug list` and confirm that the list operation runs instead of parent help.
2. Use an isolated user configuration and run `qwen mcp --debug add --scope user srv docker run -d alpine`. Inspect the saved server: the executable must be `docker` and the arguments must be `["run", "-d", "alpine"]`.
3. Repeat with global `--proxy` and `--telemetry-outfile` prefixes, and server arguments using the same option names. Verify that only the prefix is consumed and all server arguments are retained.
4. Check prefix-only help, an unknown prefix and `qwen mcp --model test-model list`. Help must not write configuration, and unknown prefixes must fail before an MCP handler runs. The model prefix must report `Unknown argument: model`, exit 1 and leave the list handler uncalled.
5. With an isolated configuration containing a server named `victim`, run `qwen mcp -- --safe-mode remove victim`. It must print MCP help without removing the server. Confirm that ordinary `qwen mcp -- list` still lists servers.
6. Run `qwen mcp --deubg list`: expect the rejection on stderr, MCP usage on stdout and exit code 1, with no list operation or settings write. In a separate isolated configuration, run `qwen mcp --debug add round7-numeric node 0x10 --timeout 1500`: the saved arguments must be `["0x10"]` and the saved timeout must be the number `1500`.
7. Add a server whose arguments include `run image --args value`, then repeat with `run image --args=value img`, `--serverArgs value` and `--server-args value`. The saved arguments must retain every token and spelling. After an explicit `--`, verify that `--args`, `0x10`, `--timeout` and `1500` are all saved as literal strings. A missing executable or invalid transport must still fail without writing settings.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Historical evidence for reviewed commit `1c8ea983faf86dbaa0a958741f1c6cd76f8e937d`: the follow-up regression matrix had seven failing global-prefix cases and one passing no-prefix control before that fix. At that commit, all 157 CLI bootstrap tests passed. They cover boolean aliases and negation, string-valued prefixes, help, errors, command selection and server-argument preservation.

The independent fixture for that same historical commit launches the actual source CLI and reads the settings it writes. Before the fix, both add commands exited 0, but the prefixed command saved `["run", "alpine"]` while the control saved `["run", "-d", "alpine"]`. After the fix, all four actual-command cases pass: ordinary add, debug-prefixed add, overlapping global/server option names, and prefixed help without a settings write. Targeted ESLint, Prettier and `git diff --check` passed at that commit.

Historical round-2 commit `546de1455e62c4187288f0ce77248bf72b393f76`: all 155 CLI bootstrap tests passed, with no failures or skips. Four route-only rows were replaced by two entry-point regressions. Keeping those candidate tests and restoring only the parent dispatcher source produced 154 passes and one failure in the new separator case. Removing only the separator guard produced the same result. Removing prefix strict-option checking produced 153 passes and two failures, in the unknown-option and model-option cases. After restoring the exact candidate source, all 155 tests passed again with zero skips; its source hash matched and the working diff was clean.

Independent verification of the round-2 candidate: an independent fixture exercises the actual source CLI entry, production removal handler and file-backed OAuth store with isolated user settings and synthetic victim/sentinel records. On the parent commit, the explicit-separator command deleted victim from both settings and credentials. On the candidate, all three source-entry scenarios passed: the separator command prints help and leaves both files byte-identical; ordinary `mcp -- list` reports no configured servers, keeps the credential file unchanged and retains the existing settings-version migration; direct `mcp remove victim` still removes only victim and retains sentinel. The list control uses an empty server configuration and makes no MCP connection.

Round-3 baseline on unchanged `546de1455e62c4187288f0ce77248bf72b393f76`: adding the requested usage assertion produced one direct assertion failure. Adding `0x10` to the existing eight-row argument matrix exposed eight further assertion failures, including the no-prefix control. The [actual built CLI baseline](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43457162316) confirmed the underlying behavior: `mcp --deubg list` exited 1 with no usage, and `mcp --debug add round7-numeric node 0x10` exited 0 but persisted `["16"]`. The empty-server list control passed. The error case left settings and synthetic OAuth files byte-identical.

That round revealed a second parser issue, not just missing coverage of the prefix guard. Round 3 declared the variadic server arguments as strings and added an independent check of `0x10` and a numeric timeout. The Round-4 correction below replaces that named positional to preserve literal option-like server arguments as well. The prefix guard remains in place.

Round-3 commit `40978fcaae8aed6cbc67bc4c11e46b099a4450bd`: all **195 tests** passed (155 CLI bootstrap tests and 40 MCP add-command tests), with no failures or skipped cases. Removing only the new help call made the selected usage assertion fail. Removing only the prefix numeric guard produced 7 failing prefix rows and 1 passing no-prefix control. Removing only the real add builder's string-array declaration made its existing stdio test fail on `0x10` versus `16`, while the entry-point mock was left intact. Restoring both exact production files then passed all 10 selected regressions. Their hashes and the full tracked diff matched the candidate; other tests were filtered during these targeted checks.

All three actual bundle cases passed: the typo reports the error, prints MCP usage, exits 1 and leaves settings and synthetic OAuth files unchanged; numeric add saves `["0x10"]` with timeout stored as the number `1500`; the ordinary empty-server list succeeds. The numeric case adds `--timeout 1500` to the baseline invocation as a compatibility check. Its `0x10` input is unchanged, as are the complete argument vectors for the typo and list controls.

### Literal server argument follow-up

Round-4 commit `9c48bdcd106ee04f792dfa754866d00bb8fc19df` preserves the unconsumed positional tail without a second named-positional parse, then appends the explicit-separator tail. Merely renaming the variadic positional would move the collision to `--serverArgs` and `--server-args`; both forms are retained as regression controls. Required command arguments and declared MCP option choices still reject invalid input, and `--timeout 1500` is still stored as a number.

The [independent parser fixture and reports](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/tree/4db06a3d873d45bd244a23290c3cb3a47eec136b/.github/validation/round8-independent) use the real command and parser configuration with locked dependencies. On unchanged `40978fca`, the two reported `--args` forms and numeric text after `--` fail directly, while six controls pass. The same nine cases pass on `9c48bdcd`, with production and tracked files unchanged. These parser results are separate from the actual settings-writing CLI checks below.

On historical commit `9c48bdcd`, all **201 tests** passed (155 CLI bootstrap tests and 46 MCP add-command tests), with zero failures or skips. Keeping the new tests while restoring only the parent add-command production source produced three direct assertion failures and five passing controls. Restoring the exact candidate passed all eight selected regressions; the other 193 tests were filtered during these targeted checks. Production bytes, test hashes and the full tracked diff were verified restored.

All **13 actual bundle cases** passed through the real CLI entry, parser, handler and settings writer. The nine add cases retain literal flags, numeric spellings and empty argument lists, while the timeout option remains an integer. The unknown-prefix, missing-command, invalid-transport and empty-server list controls preserve settings byte-for-byte; every case preserves the synthetic OAuth file. Full argv, output and before/after settings are retained in the [immutable raw reports and diagnostic evidence](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/tree/97d42243ec3e27085627e3d7fdfdcc56cf9fdfa9/.github/validation/round8-exact/17120/evidence).

### Build validation

[Round-4 hosted validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43565846363/job/132359403842) passed for historical commit `9c48bdcd106ee04f792dfa754866d00bb8fc19df` on Linux with Node.js 22.23.4, pnpm 11.24.0 and frozen dependencies. The standard full workspace build, full workspace/integration typecheck, three-file ESLint with zero warnings, Prettier and production CLI bundle passed. The suites use the repository's unmodified CLI Vitest configuration and prerequisite guard. The actual-command fixtures use temporary settings and runtime directories, preserve the HOME environment variable and do not launch a configured MCP server.


[Round-3 hosted validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43461624568) passed for exact commit `40978fcaae8aed6cbc67bc4c11e46b099a4450bd` on Linux with Node.js 22.23.4, pnpm 11.24.0 and frozen dependencies. The standard full workspace build, full workspace/integration typecheck, four-file ESLint with zero warnings, Prettier and CLI bundle build passed. Both test suites ran with the repository's unmodified CLI Vitest configuration and prerequisite guard. An earlier type/parser preflight used the exact extracted production builder and locked yargs declarations; it is separate from the full test and actual-CLI results above.


Historical [hosted validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43402624111) passed for exact commit `1c8ea983faf86dbaa0a958741f1c6cd76f8e937d` on Linux with Node.js 22 and frozen pnpm dependencies. The standard `npm run build` and full workspace/integration `npm run typecheck` both passed, followed by all **157 CLI bootstrap tests** (1 file, 0 failures or skips). This is fork validation; the upstream PR workflow still requires maintainer authorization.

[Round-2 hosted validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43419847799) for exact commit `546de1455e62c4187288f0ce77248bf72b393f76`: passed on Linux with Node.js 22.23.4, pnpm 11.24.0 and frozen dependencies. The standard full workspace build, full workspace/integration typecheck, targeted ESLint with zero warnings, Prettier and bundle build all passed. The standard CLI package setup ran all 155 tests successfully. All three isolated command scenarios also passed against the candidate bundle: the explicit-separator form printed help and kept both settings and synthetic OAuth files byte-identical, the empty-server list control dispatched normally, and direct removal deleted only victim while retaining sentinel.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not run |
| Windows | Not run |
| Linux | Historical `1c8ea983`: 157 bootstrap tests and four actual CLI cases passed; historical `546de145`: 155 bootstrap tests and three source/bundle scenarios passed. Historical `40978fca`: 195 tests and three actual bundle cases passed. Historical `9c48bdcd`: 201 tests and 13 actual bundle cases passed. Historical `0011890a`: 57 isolated command tests and 24 candidate source-fast-path cases passed. Current `a3918536`: three additional real-entry validation regressions await upstream CI. |

### Environment

Historical local verification used Node.js 24.22.1, Vitest 3.2.7, frozen workspace dependencies, the TypeScript CLI entry point and isolated temporary user settings. Round-2 verification environment: Node.js 24.22.1, locked workspace dependencies, tsx ESM registration of the actual TypeScript CLI entry, isolated temporary user settings and synthetic OAuth records for local source-entry verification. Hosted verification used Node.js 22.23.4 and pnpm 11.24.0 with frozen dependencies.

## Risk & Scope

- The additional parser is limited to registered global options before the MCP subcommand. The existing MCP parser still owns command options and server arguments.
- No live MCP server or model-provider connection is required for these configuration and dispatch tests.
- No settings migration or new public flag is introduced.

## Linked Issues

Refs #8835, `mcp-fast-path-ignores-flags-before-subcommand` in comment 6569621892.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

MCP 管理命令现在接受位于 `mcp` 与子命令之间的已注册全局选项，并保留专用 MCP 解析器。新增解析只处理首个命令词之前的前缀，剩余参数完整交给原 MCP 命令解析器。

例如，`qwen mcp --debug add srv docker run -d alpine` 会添加预期服务器，并在保存的参数中保留 `-d`。只有选项或帮助的前缀会显示 MCP 帮助，不修改设置。显式分隔符保留原有语义：`qwen mcp -- list` 会执行列表操作，而 `qwen mcp -- --safe-mode remove victim` 会显示帮助，不执行删除。`--model` 等默认命令选项在这一前缀中仍会被拒绝。位于 `mcp` 之前的全局选项沿用既有分发方式。

后续补强还在全局前缀被拒绝时输出 MCP 用法，并保留未消费的服务端参数字面形式，包括 `--args value`、`--args=value` 和 `0x10`。yargs 会当作未声明选项消费的歧义服务端参数，在 `--` 前会被拒绝且不写配置；放到 `--` 后则原样保留。分隔符前的 `--timeout` 等 MCP 数字选项保持 number 类型。

## 为什么需要

原快速路径可能把带前缀的命令当作父级帮助，成功退出却没有执行操作。将整个调用改走完整解析器虽然修复了分发，却会让根级别名吞掉服务端参数：Docker 的 `-d` 被当成 CLI debug 选项，保存时丢失。

仅解析前缀可以同时解决两种问题。管理命令为兼容性接受此位置的已注册非帮助全局选项，但会忽略这些选项及其值，包括 `--proxy`、`--insecure` 和 `--telemetry-*`。文档也明确了这一边界。分隔符补强还避免将明确标记为位置参数的 token 重新解释成全局选项，把帮助调用变成删除操作。

## 最新评审跟进（`a391853684a5c4db9f8829c53da0083086621a9b`）

普通 `mcp add` 参数错误现在向 stderr 输出原因、向 stdout 输出 add 用法，然后抛出 `AlreadyReportedError`。显式抛出继续保证在读取或写入设置前中止；既有顶层处理器识别此错误，以 1 退出且不追加内部错误横幅或堆栈。严格选项校验和服务端参数字面保留行为保持不变。

新增三项使用真实 add 命令并经过 `runCliEntry(['mcp', ...])` 的入口回归：缺少可执行程序、非法 transport，以及 debug 前缀下的歧义服务端参数。断言错误信息、用法、已报告错误的退出码标记和无设置读写。新增测试尚未完成运行验证；[当前提交上游 CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43665647732)已排队。下文历史测试数量仅属于对应的旧提交。

## 评审测试计划

### 验证方法

1. 执行 `qwen mcp --debug list`，确认进入列表操作，而不是显示父级帮助。
2. 使用隔离用户配置执行 `qwen mcp --debug add --scope user srv docker run -d alpine`。检查保存结果：可执行程序应为 `docker`，参数应为 `["run", "-d", "alpine"]`。
3. 使用全局 `--proxy`、`--telemetry-outfile` 前缀，并在服务端参数中使用同名选项。确认仅消费前缀，服务端参数全部保留。
4. 检查只有前缀的帮助、未知前缀和 `qwen mcp --model test-model list`。帮助不得写配置，未知前缀必须在执行 MCP 处理器前报错。model 前缀必须报告 `Unknown argument: model`、以 1 退出且不调用列表处理器。
5. 在含有 `victim` 服务器的隔离配置中执行 `qwen mcp -- --safe-mode remove victim`。它必须显示 MCP 帮助，且不删除服务器。确认普通 `qwen mcp -- list` 仍能列出服务器。
6. 执行 `qwen mcp --deubg list`：stderr 应报告拒绝原因，stdout 应显示 MCP 用法，退出码为 1，不执行列表操作、不写设置。另用隔离配置执行 `qwen mcp --debug add round7-numeric node 0x10 --timeout 1500`：保存的参数必须是 `["0x10"]`，timeout 必须是数字 `1500`。
7. 添加参数为 `run image --args value` 的服务器，再分别使用 `run image --args=value img`、`--serverArgs value` 与 `--server-args value` 重复。保存结果必须保留每个 token 及其字面形式。显式 `--` 之后的 `--args`、`0x10`、`--timeout` 和 `1500` 应全部作为字符串保存。缺少可执行程序或传入无效 transport 时仍须失败，且不写设置。

### 前后证据

以下为已评审提交 `1c8ea983faf86dbaa0a958741f1c6cd76f8e937d` 的历史证据：该次修复前，回归矩阵的七个全局前缀用例失败，无前缀对照通过。在该提交上，157 项 CLI 启动测试全部通过，覆盖布尔别名、否定形式、字符串值前缀、帮助、错误、命令选择及服务端参数保真。

同一历史提交的独立夹具启动真实源码 CLI 并读取写入的配置。修复前，两条添加命令均以 0 退出，但带前缀的命令保存为 `["run", "alpine"]`，对照则保存为 `["run", "-d", "alpine"]`。修复后，普通添加、debug 前缀添加、全局与服务端同名选项、前缀帮助不写配置四种实际命令情况全部通过。该提交的定向 ESLint、Prettier 及 `git diff --check` 通过。

历史第二轮提交 `546de1455e62c4187288f0ce77248bf72b393f76`：155 项 CLI 启动测试全部通过，0 失败、0 跳过。四项仅检查路由的用例替换为两项入口回归。保留候选测试、仅恢复父提交的分发源码后，154 项通过、新增分隔符用例 1 项失败；仅移除分隔符守卫也得到相同结果。移除前缀严格选项检查后，153 项通过，未知选项与 model 选项两项失败。恢复精确候选源码后再次 155 项全部通过、0 跳过，源码哈希一致且工作区差异为空。

在历史提交 `9c48bdcd` 上，**201 项测试全部通过**（155 项 CLI 启动测试、46 项 MCP add 命令测试），0 失败、0 跳过。保留新增测试、仅恢复父提交的 add 命令生产源码后，产生三项直接断言失败，五项对照通过。恢复精确候选后，八项选中回归全部通过；定向检查期间其余 193 项测试被筛选排除。生产文件字节、测试哈希及完整 tracked diff 均确认恢复一致。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): settle stale public-child recovery as terminal instead of retrying forever
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A stale public-child recovery is now classified as a durable, structural decline instead of a retryable error. When the Hosted Harness can no longer open a Session's persisted shape at all — a public-child Session captured under the shell workspace topology now served by a Harness without public child agents — the connector raises the existing typed terminal decline with a new dedicated reason, and the coordinator abandons the recovery on the first drive, cancellation included: the Turn settles FAILED as `managed_runtime_recovery_blocked` without the reconcile/park detour, and the terminal row leaves both recovery scans permanently, surviving service restarts. On the hosted side, a saved approval continuation whose public-child profile no longer matches the active topology raises a typed error that the load routes map onto the existing terminal decline wire code, so it flows into the same terminal branch through the connector's existing coded mapping. The replaceable-harness design doc records the new reason in both languages.

## Why it's needed

Fixes #17260. After the shell → external-files topology migration, a leftover `CANCELLING` public-child Turn fell into an infinite recovery loop: the unsupported-Session check threw a plain runtime exception, the coordinator treated it as transient and retried once a minute indefinitely (observed 685+ consecutive failures), and every restart's recovery sweep re-offered the same Turn. Even routing it through the existing journal-state decline path would not have helped: a CANCELLING Turn keeps a budget-exempt cancel-retry lane there, and every settlement route re-opens the same unloadable Session through the same connector and meets the same refusal. Only a first-drive terminal abandonment closes the loop. The same stale record also made the hosted side report the profile mismatch as a retriable refusal, restarting the loop from the other end.

FAILED (not CANCELLED) is deliberate: the cancel was never observed by any Harness, so writing CANCELLED would forge a settlement. The existing command settlement for `managed_runtime_recovery_blocked` already parks unconfirmed inputs and cancels for reconciliation from the retained journal instead of redelivery, which is exactly the honest end state for an abandoned recovery.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the focused Java regression set from `packages/managed-agent-server`: `mvn -Dtest='RecoverySettlementTest,QwenHostedHarnessConnectorTest,HarnessCoordinatorTest' test checkstyle:check`. Expect 332 passing tests. The new cases pin: a public-child CANCELLING Turn under a Harness without public child agents settles FAILED (`managed_runtime_recovery_blocked`) on the first drive with no retry, no park, no cancel reconcile and no lease release; the same on a RUNNING recovery drive; and the connector surfaces the typed decline from the cancellation takeover, the plain recovery load and the ordinary load without sending any load request.
- Run the hosted continuation regression from `packages/cli`: `npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-approval-continuation.test.ts`. Expect 79 passing tests. The new cases pin that a saved public-child continuation under a non-shell profile (including `hosted-workspace-external-files/1`) rejects with the typed terminal error, while the same continuation on its own shell topology still restores.
- Behaviorally: with a shell-era public-child Session holding a CANCELLING Turn against an external-files Harness, the first recovery drive after this change writes the terminal row and the once-a-minute retry log stops; a service restart no longer re-offers the Turn.

Local evidence: the two commands above plus `npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts -t 'decline'` (4 passing), `hosted-approval-fallback` / `hosted-command-step-hook-recovery` / `hosted-runtime-recovery` (103 passing), and Prettier on every touched TS/Markdown file — all green. Full `mvn verify` (SpotBugs), the MySQL and Hosted/fault profiles, and the full CLI suite are left to CI; the change adds no SQL or schema and reuses the existing terminal-write path.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — control-plane recovery classification; no TUI surface.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21 + Maven (focused verification-module runs against H2-backed unit fixtures); Node/Vitest for the hosted continuation suite. No live deployment was exercised.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a Turn abandoned this way settles FAILED rather than waiting for a future Harness that might restore public-child support; that is the intended trade — the shape mismatch is durable and the prior behavior never terminated. Journal-state declines (`await_action`, `shell_in_flight`, …) keep their existing settlement lanes unchanged; only the new structural reason takes the first-drive terminal branch.
- Not validated / out of scope: full `mvn verify` with SpotBugs, MySQL integration and real-process Hosted/fault profiles (CI owns them); the cleanup-debt retry coordinator keeps its existing bounded backoff for the same Sessions and is untouched.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The public wire contract is unchanged — the new reason rides the existing `hosted_turn_recovery_declined` code, and no internal topology string is hardcoded into layers that do not own it.

Design doc updated in both languages: [English](docs/design/2026-10-02-hosted-replaceable-harness.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-02-hosted-replaceable-harness.zh-CN.md) (D5 gains the eighth decline reason with identical decisions in both versions).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17260

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

陈旧的 public-child 恢复现在被归类为耐久的结构性 decline，而不是可重试错误。当 Hosted Harness 根本无法打开某个 Session 持久化的形态——在 shell workspace 拓扑下捕获的 public-child Session，如今由不具备 public child agents 的 Harness 服务——connector 会以一个新增的专用 reason 抛出既有的类型化终态 decline，coordinator 在首次 drive 即放弃恢复，取消也包括在内：Turn 以 `managed_runtime_recovery_blocked` 结算为 FAILED，不做 reconcile/park 绕行，终态行永久离开两条恢复扫描，服务重启后也不会再被扫到。hosted 侧，保存的审批续跑档案的 public-child profile 与当前拓扑不匹配时抛出类型化错误，load 路由把它映射到既有的终态 decline wire code，经 connector 既有的编码映射进入同一个终态分支。可替换 Harness 设计文档以双语记录了新 reason。

## 为什么需要

修复 #17260。shell → external-files 拓扑迁移后，遗留的 `CANCELLING` public-child Turn 陷入无限恢复循环：不支持的 Session 检查抛的是裸运行时异常，coordinator 把它当瞬态错误每分钟重试一次、永不终止（实测连续失败 685+ 次），且每次服务重启后恢复扫描都会重新投递同一个 Turn。即使把它接入既有的 journal 状态类 decline 路径也不够：CANCELLING Turn 在那里保持豁免预算的取消重试车道，而每条结算路由都会经同一个 connector 重开同一个无法打开的 Session、撞上同一个拒绝。只有首次 drive 即终态放弃才能闭合这个循环。同一条陈旧记录还让 hosted 侧把 profile 不匹配报告成可重试拒绝，从另一端重启循环。

选 FAILED（而非 CANCELLED）是刻意的：cancel 从未被任何 Harness 观察到，写 CANCELLED 会伪造结算。`managed_runtime_recovery_blocked` 既有的命令结算语义已经把未确认的 input 和 cancel 停靠为待对账、只从留存 journal 结算而不再投递——这正是被放弃恢复的诚实终态。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

- 在 `packages/managed-agent-server` 运行聚焦 Java 回归集：`mvn -Dtest='RecoverySettlementTest,QwenHostedHarnessConnectorTest,HarnessCoordinatorTest' test checkstyle:check`，预期 332 个测试通过。新增用例钉住：不具备 public child agents 的 Harness 下，public-child CANCELLING Turn 首次 drive 即结算 FAILED（`managed_runtime_recovery_blocked`），无重试、无 park、无 cancel reconcile、不释放 lease；RUNNING 恢复 drive 同型；connector 从取消接管、普通恢复 load 和常规 load 三条路径都抛出类型化 decline 且不发送任何 load 请求。
- 在 `packages/cli` 运行 hosted 续跑回归：`npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-approval-continuation.test.ts`，预期 79 个测试通过。新增用例钉住：非 shell profile（含 `hosted-workspace-external-files/1`）下保存的 public-child 续跑档案以类型化终态错误拒绝，而同一档案在自己的 shell 拓扑下仍正常恢复。
- 行为层面：一个 shell 时代 public-child Session 持有 CANCELLING Turn、对接 external-files Harness 时，本改动后的首次恢复 drive 写入终态行，每分钟一次的重试日志停止；服务重启不再重新投递该 Turn。

本地证据：上述两条命令，外加 `npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts -t 'decline'`（4 通过）、`hosted-approval-fallback` / `hosted-command-step-hook-recovery` / `hosted-runtime-recovery`（103 通过），以及所有改动 TS/Markdown 文件的 Prettier 检查——全绿。完整 `mvn verify`（SpotBugs）、MySQL 与 Hosted/fault profile、CLI 全量套件留给 CI；本改动不新增 SQL 或 schema，复用既有终态写路径。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A —— 控制面恢复分类，无 TUI 界面。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅（聚焦单测）；Windows ⚠️ 未测；Linux ⚠️ 未测。

### 环境（可选）

JDK 21 + Maven（verification 模块聚焦运行，H2 单测夹具）；hosted 续跑套件用 Node/Vitest。未做真实部署验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：以此方式放弃的 Turn 结算为 FAILED，而不是等待未来可能恢复 public-child 支持的 Harness；这是预期取舍——形态不匹配是耐久的，而旧行为永不终止。journal 状态类 decline（`await_action`、`shell_in_flight` 等）保持既有结算车道不变，只有新的结构性 reason 走首次 drive 终态分支。
- 未验证/范围外：完整 `mvn verify` 含 SpotBugs、MySQL 集成与真实进程 Hosted/fault profile（CI 负责）；cleanup 债务重试 coordinator 对同类 Session 保持既有有界 backoff，本次未改。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。公开 wire contract 不变——新 reason 复用既有 `hosted_turn_recovery_declined` code，且没有把内部拓扑字符串硬编码进不拥有它的层。

设计文档双语更新：[English](docs/design/2026-10-02-hosted-replaceable-harness.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-02-hosted-replaceable-harness.zh-CN.md)（D5 新增第八种 decline reason，两版决策一致）。

Fixes #17260
