prs.title: fix(cli): give static transcript text an explicit wrap width
prs.body:
## What this PR does

On the static transcript path, a block of text that had no width of its own was measured implicitly by the layout engine, so a line that filled the terminal could run into the reserved right margin and the terminal would then break it hard in the middle of a word. This PR states the width explicitly for the three conversation block types that were affected: ordinary paragraphs, markdown list items, and markdown blockquotes. The width is opt-in per call site, and only the conversational call sites opt in; call sites whose available width already includes their own border and padding are deliberately left alone.

This is a take-over of #15021 by agreement with its author (@PanSHIgg), who asked for the work to move forward here and will close that PR once this one is open. The paragraph half is his change, carried over as-is; the list-item and blockquote halves extend the same mechanism to two call sites that were left as follow-ups in the original PR.

## Why it's needed

The reported symptom is one or two characters landing alone in column zero after a line that reached the right edge, with the following line's indent shifted by a column. It is width-dependent and was reported on Windows at 100 columns. The root cause is that the wrapping text had no declared width, so the layout engine could hand the terminal a line one or a few cells wider than the space actually reserved for it. Giving the block its real width removes that possibility for the three affected block types.

The original PR covered paragraphs only and explicitly deferred list items and the remaining call sites. While verifying the paragraph fix in a real terminal, the same defect was observed on numbered lists and on blockquotes, so all three are fixed here rather than in three separate rounds.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The regression tests render the real transcript component inside a real static list at a fixed terminal width and assert that no rendered line is wider than the space the transcript reserves (terminal width minus the two-column margins). Each of the three block types has its own test, and each test fails on the build where its own block type is still unfixed:

| build | failing tests |
| --- | --- |
| current `main`, no fixes | paragraphs, flat list, nested list, blockquote — `5 failed` |
| + paragraph fix only | flat list, nested list |
| + list fix only | blockquote |
| + all three | none — `237 passed` across the transcript and markdown suites |

So the three defects are separated by independent signals: fixing one does not hide another. A reviewer can reproduce the first row by reverting the source changes and re-running the transcript test file.

For the live check: run the CLI in a 100-column Windows terminal with the virtualized history disabled, and ask for a long single-paragraph answer, a numbered list of two long items, and a long one-line blockquote. Before the change, words break mid-word at the right edge and the fragment lands in column zero. After the change, wrapping happens at word boundaries and the right margin stays intact.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Both frames below are the same model, the same working directory and a real 100-column Windows ConPTY; only the built bundle differs.

Before — build without the fixes:

![Before: blockquote, paragraph and list all break at the right margin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aleks-0/qwen-code/pr-assets-14075/pr-assets/14075-three-base-100col.png)

After — build with the three fixes:

![After: the same three blocks wrap at word boundaries and the right margin is intact](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aleks-0/qwen-code/pr-assets-14075/pr-assets/14075-three-fixed-100col.png)

The same frames as text, so the break points are greppable. Before — blockquote, paragraph and list all break; worst line is 100 cells against a 98-cell ceiling:

```
  ◆︎  │ История вычислительной техники начинается с механических счётных устройств — абака, счётовой
       доски и арифмометра Лейбница, — продолжается разностной и аналитической машинами Чарлза Бэбби
джа
       с первыми программами Ады Лавлейс, переходит к электромеханическим реле Конрада Цузе и лампов
ым
```

After — same three blocks, no orphan in column zero, worst content line 98:

```
  ◆︎  │ История вычислительной техники начинается с механических счётных устройств — абака, счётовой
       доски и арифмометра Лейбница, — продолжается разностной и аналитической машинами
       Чарлза Бэббиджа с первыми программами Ады Лавлейс, переходит к электромеханическим реле
```

Breaks visible before and gone after: blockquote `Бэбби`/`джа`, `лампов`/`ым`; paragraph `сформулиров`/`ано`, `вме`/`сте`; list `врод`/`е`.

Independent verification of the original paragraph work, carried over from #15021: the paragraph regression test fails on the base commit (`2 failed | 42 passed`) and passes with the fix (`44/44`), and the Windows build, typecheck, lint and bundle are green here. Credit to @holny for the earlier reproduction attempts in the issue thread.

One caveat about the pair above, stated plainly: the "before" frame was captured from the commit this branch was cut from, while the branch itself sits on a later `main` after a merge. The comparison therefore shows the product before and after the three fixes plus unrelated upstream movement. The per-path unit tests, not the screenshots, are what attribute the fix to these changes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests via the package's own vitest runner. Live frames from a real ConPTY session driven through a pseudo-terminal harness with the terminal buffer captured headlessly; the CLI was built and bundled locally on Windows.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an explicitly declared width clips instead of overflowing if a call site opts in while passing an available width that already accounts for its own border and padding. That is why the opt-in is per call site and is enabled only on the conversational paths, which pass the width the block may actually use.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Linux. Also not validated: terminals that render ambiguous-width characters as two cells. The fix restores the reserved two-column right margin, which absorbs that drift on lines with no ambiguous glyphs, but a boundary line carrying several of them can still exceed the terminal width by more than the margin; that residual is unchanged by this PR and is tracked in the issue.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No public options or settings are added or changed.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14075

Take-over of #15021 by agreement with its author; the paragraph change and the verification above are carried over from it. The remaining caveat noted under Risk & Scope is carried over as well, so the closing keyword reflects the reported symptom being addressed on the reported platform, not a claim that ambiguous-width terminal behaviour was measured.

QwenCode QwenLLM

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

在静态会话（static transcript）渲染路径上，没有自身宽度的文本块会被布局引擎隐式测量，因此占满终端宽度的行可能侵占预留的右边距，随后由终端在单词中间强制断行。本 PR 为受影响的三类会话内容块显式声明宽度：普通段落、markdown 有序/无序列表项，以及 markdown 引用块。该宽度按调用点逐个开启，只在会话类调用点启用；那些可用宽度本身已包含自身边框与内边距的调用点有意保持不动。

这是与 #15021 作者（@PanSHIgg）协商后对该 PR 的接手（take-over）。作者已同意在此推进，并在本 PR 开出后关闭原 PR。段落部分原样沿用其改动；列表项与引用块两部分把同一机制扩展到原 PR 中留作后续项的两个调用点。

## 为什么需要

报告的症状是：某行顶到终端右边缘后，有一两个字符单独落在第 0 列，下一行的缩进也随之错位。该问题与宽度相关，报告环境为 Windows、100 列。根因是换行文本未声明宽度，布局引擎可能交给终端比实际可用空间宽一格或数格的行。为这三类内容块声明真实宽度即可消除该可能。

原 PR 只覆盖段落，并明确把列表项及其余调用点留作后续。在真实终端中验证段落修复时，同样的缺陷在有序列表和引用块上也被观察到，因此三者一并在此修复，而不是分三轮。

## 评审验证方案

### 如何验证

回归测试在固定终端宽度下把真实会话组件渲染进真实的 static 列表，并断言任何渲染行的宽度都不超过会话预留的空间（终端宽度减去两列边距）。三类内容块各有自己的测试，并且每个测试都在“该类型尚未修复”的构建上失败：

| 构建 | 失败的测试 |
| --- | --- |
| 当前 `main`，无任何修复 | 段落、扁平列表、嵌套列表、引用块 — `5 failed` |
| 仅段落修复 | 扁平列表、嵌套列表 |
| 仅列表修复 | 引用块 |
| 三项全部 | 无 — 会话与 markdown 两个测试套件共 `237 passed` |

因此三个缺陷由彼此独立的信号区分：修复其中一个不会掩盖另一个。评审者可以回退源码改动后重跑该测试文件来复现第一行。

实机验证：在 100 列 Windows 终端中关闭虚拟化历史运行 CLI，要求模型给出一个长段落、一个含两条长条目的有序列表和一行长引用。修改前，单词在右边缘被截断，碎片落在第 0 列；修改后按词边界换行，右边距保持完整。

### 前后对比证据

以下两帧来自同一模型、同一工作目录、真实 100 列 Windows ConPTY，唯一差别是构建产物。文件：`14075-three-base-100col.png`、`14075-three-fixed-100col.png`。

修改前 — 引用块、段落、列表均断裂；最宽行 100 格，上限为 98 格（见英文正文代码块）。

修改后 — 同样三块内容，第 0 列无孤立碎片，最宽内容行 98 格。

修改前可见、修改后消失的断裂：引用块 `Бэбби`/`джа`、`лампов`/`ым`；段落 `сформулиров`/`ано`、`вме`/`сте`；列表 `врод`/`е`。

来自 #15021 的独立验证结论一并保留：段落回归测试在基线提交上失败（`2 failed | 42 passed`），加上修复后通过（`44/44`）；本分支在 Windows 上的构建、类型检查、lint 与打包均为绿。感谢 @holny 在 issue 讨论中的早期复现尝试。

关于上述对比的一个坦率说明：“修改前”那一帧取自本分支切出时的提交，而分支本身在合并后已位于更新的 `main`。因此该对比展示的是“三项修复加上无关上游变更”前后的产品状态。真正把修复归因于本次改动的是按路径拆分的单元测试，而不是截图。

### 测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 运行环境（可选）

单元测试使用各包自带的 vitest。实机截图由伪终端脚本驱动真实 ConPTY 会话并无头抓取终端缓冲得到；CLI 在 Windows 本地构建并打包。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：若某个调用点在可用宽度已包含自身边框与内边距的情况下开启该开关，显式宽度会造成裁切而不是溢出。因此该开关按调用点启用，且只在会话类路径启用，这些路径传入的正是内容块真正可使用的宽度。
- 未验证／范围之外：macOS 与 Linux。同样未验证：把 ambiguous-width 字符按两格渲染的终端。本修复恢复了预留的两列右边距，在无 ambiguous 字符的行上足以吸收该偏差；但若边界行含有多个此类字符，仍可能超出终端宽度并超过该边距，这一残余问题本 PR 不改变，并在 issue 中继续跟踪。
- 破坏性变更／迁移说明：无。未新增或修改任何公开选项或设置。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14075

与 #15021 作者协商后的接手 PR；段落改动与上述验证结论均由其继承。Risk & Scope 中提到的残余说明同样保留，因此关闭关键字表示“在报告平台上已处理所报告的症状”，并不声称已测量 ambiguous-width 终端行为。

prs.title: fix(web-shell): preserve withheld memory content as read-only
prs.body:
### Latest review follow-up

Commit `494dd938735bed640d98367ed160e66e58419705` addresses R2-1: the empty-content placeholder now also requires that the selected scope has no file. An existing, completely read zero-byte file shows blank content and remains editable. Switching to a missing User file still offers the placeholder and creation path.

The new regression failed with the previous production source and passes with the fix. [Exact-candidate validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43564806465/job/132356184077) passed the standard full workspace build, workspace/integration type checks, production bundle, targeted ESLint/Prettier, and all 16 memory panel/hook tests with frozen dependencies. Earlier revision evidence below remains historical.

### 最新评审跟进

提交 `494dd938735bed640d98367ed160e66e58419705` 处理 R2-1：仅在当前 scope 确实没有文件时显示空文件列表占位文案。已完整读取的 0 字节文件显示为空白并保留编辑能力；切换到缺失的 User 文件时，仍显示原有占位及创建入口。

新增回归在旧生产源码上失败，修复后通过。[精确候选验证](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43564806465/job/132356184077) 已通过冻结依赖安装、标准完整构建、workspace/集成类型检查、生产 bundle、定向风格检查及全部 16 项 Memory 面板/hook 测试。以下较早提交的验证记录保留为历史证据。

---

## What this PR does

Keeps memory content read-only when the daemon explicitly reports that a complete, safely replaceable snapshot is unavailable. BOM and invalid UTF-8 reads now retain the existing `truncated: true` marker even at or below the 1 MiB content limit, and Web Shell preserves that marker without retrying through the generic file API. The English and Chinese status text now describes unavailable complete text instead of attributing every withheld snapshot to size truncation. An existing file with withheld text also keeps its path and read-only explanation without displaying the contradictory “No memory files found” placeholder; missing files retain the creation path. The public `truncated` comments and collector documentation now include BOM/non-UTF-8 withholding.

## Why it's needed

A small workspace memory file with a BOM could previously reach Web Shell with neither content nor a marker. The compatibility fallback could then return decoded text without the original encoding bytes, allowing a replacement save to alter the file. The encoding branches were using only the size-based truncation result, so the marker disappeared for files at or below the limit. This restores the withheld-content contract already described in item 2 of #13207 and applies it to the fallback distinction discussed in item 5.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open workspace memory files containing a UTF-8 BOM, a UTF-16 BOM, or invalid UTF-8, both below the content limit and at exactly 1 MiB. The content response should omit text and retain the read-only marker; opening the file must leave its bytes unchanged.
2. Confirm that explicitly withheld workspace and global content never triggers a generic file read, Edit remains disabled, and no replacement write is offered. The status should explain that complete text is unavailable and editing is disabled, without also claiming that no memory file exists. Select a missing User file and confirm its no-files placeholder and creation control still appear.
3. Confirm that complete BOM-free UTF-8 at exactly 1 MiB remains available, an empty complete file remains editable, and an oversized valid UTF-8 file retains its read-only prefix.
4. Confirm that legacy daemon responses without content support still use the existing workspace fallback. A file that changes during a read stays read-only; selecting its tab again retries the read.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The encoding regressions were first run against the original PR production source at `488bd970`, then against the earlier follow-up tree at `43f448d7`. Those results are preserved here as historical evidence:

| Check | Original PR source `488bd970` | Encoding follow-up `43f448d7` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Real-file memory HTTP route suite | 28 passed, 7 failed: withheld encoding responses lacked the marker | 35 passed |
| Web Shell memory hook and rendered panel suites | 14 passed, 1 failed: withheld content was described as truncated | 15 passed |

The route cases cover UTF-8 BOM, UTF-16 BOM, and invalid UTF-8 at 32 bytes and 1,048,576 bytes, plus the existing global UTF-16 case. The normal UTF-8 boundary, bounded prefix, torn read, and same-size rewrite controls pass. The client cases explicitly assert that the generic read is not called for a marked response and that the panel never calls the replacement write.

### Current follow-up evidence

The added rendered-panel assertion first failed on `43f448d7`: the file path and read-only explanation appeared together with “No memory files found” (**1 failed / 7 passed** in the panel suite). After the display fix, the panel and hook suites passed **15 tests**: 8 panel cases and 7 hook cases. The same case confirms that editing and replacement writes remain blocked, then switches to a missing User file and verifies that the no-files placeholder and creation control return. Nonempty read-only prefixes remain visible.

Both public `truncated` type comments and the collector documentation now describe capped content, a read invalidated by a concurrent write, and BOM/non-UTF-8 withholding. Retrying unchanged invalid encoding bytes cannot repair that encoding; the existing retry behavior for a concurrent change is retained.

### Build validation

On the current follow-up tree, all 15 Web Shell hook/panel tests, targeted ESLint, Prettier, `git diff --check`, and the complete Web Shell TypeScript check passed. Earlier local full repository attempts did not complete: the build was killed during CLI TypeScript compilation with status 137, and the full typecheck exhausted its heap with exit 134. These were checks of the earlier encoding-fix head.

[Hosted validation for exact commit `43f448d7`](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43369894828) passed on Linux with Node.js 22.23.4 and the frozen pnpm 11.24.0 lockfile. The standard `npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` both passed, as did all 35 memory HTTP route tests and all 15 Web Shell hook/panel tests. This historical fork run validates `43f448d7`; upstream PR workflows at that head required maintainer approval. The earlier published commit was `ba5f9e8dbbbf25299a6db5873011b02599ef41cc`. Validation for that prior revision:

[Hosted validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43402624111) passed for exact commit `ba5f9e8dbbbf25299a6db5873011b02599ef41cc` on Linux with Node.js 22 and frozen pnpm dependencies. The standard `npm run build` and full workspace/integration `npm run typecheck` both passed, followed by all **15 Web Shell memory-panel and hook tests** (2 files, 0 failures or skips). This is fork validation; the upstream PR workflow still requires maintainer authorization.

### Tested on

| Platform | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Linux | Current follow-up: 15 client tests, lint, formatting and Web Shell typecheck passed. Historical `43f448d7`: hosted full build/typecheck and 50 focused tests passed |
| macOS | Not run |
| Windows | Not run |

### Environment

Local checks used Node.js 24.22.1; hosted checks used Node.js 22.23.4 on Linux. Both used pnpm 11.24.0 with the frozen repository lockfile, Vitest 3.2.7, and jsdom for rendered client tests. Verification used real temporary files and the HTTP route, plus rendered component tests; no manual browser session was used.

## Risk & Scope

The existing marker continues to cover partial content and unsafe snapshots, including torn reads. Complete strings, complete empty files, and the legacy fallback retain their current behavior. Unmarked responses remain on the compatibility path; distinguishing every per-file error from an older daemon still belongs to the broader follow-up in #13207. This change does not introduce a new capability or wire field.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13207, specifically the existing withheld-content contract in item 2 and the marked fallback case in item 5.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

当 daemon 明确表示无法提供可安全用于整文件替换的完整快照时，Memory 内容保持只读。BOM 和无效 UTF-8 文件即使小于或等于 1 MiB，也会保留既有的 `truncated: true` 标记；Web Shell 收到该标记后不会再通过通用文件接口重读。中英文提示均改为说明完整文本不可用，避免把所有 withheld 情形都描述为大小截断。既有文件的内容被保留不返回时，面板保留路径和只读原因，不再同时显示“未找到记忆文件”的矛盾提示；真正缺失的文件仍可创建。公开 `truncated` 字段注释和收集器文档也同步说明 BOM / 非 UTF-8 的情形。

## 为什么需要

此前，带 BOM 的小型工作区 Memory 文件可能只返回元数据，既没有内容，也没有只读标记。兼容回退随后可能返回已丢失原始编码字节的解码文本，使替换保存改变文件。根因是两个编码分支沿用了仅按文件大小计算的截断值，导致小于或等于上限的文件在序列化时丢掉标记。本次恢复 #13207 第 2 项已经描述的 withheld-content 契约，并落实第 5 项中对明确标记响应的回退区分。

## 评审测试计划

### 验证方法

1. 打开带 UTF-8 BOM、UTF-16 BOM 或无效 UTF-8 的工作区 Memory 文件，分别覆盖小文件和恰好 1 MiB 的边界。响应应省略文本并保留只读标记，打开操作不得改变原始文件字节。
2. 确认带明确标记的工作区及全局内容不会触发通用文件读取，Edit 不可用，也不会提供替换保存。提示应说明完整文本不可用、编辑已禁用，不应同时声称文件不存在。选择真正缺失的 User 文件后，缺失提示和创建入口仍应出现。
3. 确认恰好 1 MiB 的完整无 BOM UTF-8、完整空文件仍能正常读取；超限有效 UTF-8 内容继续提供只读前缀。
4. 确认不支持内联内容的旧 daemon 仍可使用原有工作区回退。读取期间发生变化的文件保持只读，再次选择对应页签可以重试读取。

### 前后证据

编码相关回归先在原 PR 生产代码 `488bd970` 上运行，再验证前一轮提交 `43f448d7` 对应的源码树。以下保留该阶段的历史证据：

| 检查 | 原 PR 源码 `488bd970` | 编码修复 `43f448d7` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 真实文件 Memory HTTP 路由测试 | 28 通过、7 失败：被 withheld 的编码响应缺少标记 | 35 通过 |
| Web Shell hook 与渲染面板测试 | 14 通过、1 失败：提示将 withheld 内容称为截断 | 15 通过 |

HTTP 用例覆盖 32 字节和 1,048,576 字节两种大小下的 UTF-8 BOM、UTF-16 BOM、无效 UTF-8，以及原有的全局 UTF-16 场景。正常 UTF-8 边界、有界前缀、torn read、同大小改写对照均通过。客户端用例明确断言带标记响应不调用通用读取，且面板不发起替换写入。

### 本轮跟进证据

新增的渲染面板断言先在 `43f448d7` 上失败：文件路径和只读原因与“未找到记忆文件”同时出现，面板测试为 **1 项失败、7 项通过**。修复提示后，面板和 hook 共 **15 项测试通过**，其中面板 8 项、hook 7 项。同一用例确认编辑和替换写入仍被禁止，再切换至真正缺失的 User 文件，验证缺失提示及创建入口恢复；非空的只读内容前缀仍正常显示。

两处公开 `truncated` 类型注释和收集器文档现在均涵盖内容上限、并发写入使读取快照失效，以及 BOM / 非 UTF-8 内容被保留不返回的情况。对未改变的无效编码字节重复读取不能修复编码；并发变化场景原有的重试行为继续保留。

### 构建验证

当前跟进源码树的 15 项 Web Shell hook / 面板测试、针对改动的 ESLint、Prettier、`git diff --check` 和完整 Web Shell TypeScript 检查均通过。此前针对编码修复 head 的本地全仓尝试未完成：构建在 CLI TypeScript 编译阶段以 137 被终止，全仓类型检查因堆耗尽以 134 退出。

针对精确提交 `43f448d7` 的[托管验证](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43369894828)已在 Linux、Node.js 22.23.4 和冻结锁文件的 pnpm 11.24.0 环境中通过。标准 `npm run build`、`npm run typecheck` 均成功，35 项 Memory HTTP 路由测试和 15 项 Web Shell hook/面板测试全部通过。该历史 fork 验证对应 `43f448d7`，当时该 head 的上游 PR 工作流需要维护者批准。此前发布提交为 `ba5f9e8dbbbf25299a6db5873011b02599ef41cc`。该历史提交的全仓验证：

针对精确提交 `ba5f9e8dbbbf25299a6db5873011b02599ef41cc` 的[托管验证](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43402624111)已通过，环境为 Linux、Node.js 22 和冻结锁文件的 pnpm 依赖。标准 `npm run build`、全工作区及集成代码的 `npm run typecheck` 均通过，随后 **15 项 Web Shell 记忆面板及 hook 测试**全部通过（2 个文件，0 失败、0 跳过）。这是 fork 验证；上游 PR 工作流仍需维护者授权。

### 测试平台

| 平台 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| Linux | 当前跟进：15 项客户端测试、lint、格式及 Web Shell 类型检查通过。历史 `43f448d7`：托管全仓构建、类型检查及 50 项针对性测试通过 |

## 风险与范围

既有标记继续涵盖部分内容和不安全快照，包括 torn read。完整文本、完整空文件及旧 daemon 回退保留原有行为。无标记响应仍沿用兼容路径；进一步区分旧 daemon 与各种文件错误仍由 #13207 的后续设计处理。本次没有新增 capability 或 wire 字段。

prs.title: fix(cli): hide root-restricted workspace settings
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The terminal settings dialog now omits root settings stripped from project scope when Workspace is selected. The Advisor Session Call Limit remains available in User scope, where it can take effect.

## Why it's needed

The settings picker already filters restricted nested settings, but omitted the separate list of restricted root settings. It consequently offered a workspace-level Advisor Session Call Limit even though configuration loading discards that value, making a successful-looking edit ineffective.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open the terminal settings dialog in Workspace scope and confirm that Advisor Session Call Limit is absent.
2. Switch to User scope and confirm that the setting remains available.
3. Check that unrestricted workspace settings and callers that do not request scope filtering retain their entries.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The independent fixture uses the real settings schema and dialog-key consumer. Before the fix, Workspace scope leaked `advisorMaxUses`. After the fix, the workspace result contains no restricted root keys while the user result still includes the Advisor setting. All 139 settings-utility/dialog tests pass. The root-key fixture additionally checks that unrestricted `visionModel` survives; a filter that removes every root key fails all four parametrized controls at that assertion. Targeted ESLint and Prettier pass.

### Build validation

[Hosted validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43565212403/job/132357445068) checked the exact current commit `0b0d0b7813dda555be00146b35c34d9549531055` on Linux with Node.js 22 and frozen workspace dependencies. The complete `npm run build`, all-workspace/integration `npm run typecheck`, `npm run bundle`, targeted ESLint, and Prettier checks passed. This run passed all 139 tests across `settingsUtils.test.ts` (70) and `SettingsDialog.test.tsx` (69).

Upstream PR workflows on this head are currently `action_required`, awaiting a maintainer's approval of fork CI. The linked run provides validation for this exact commit.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not run |
| Windows | Not run |
| Linux | Package tests and actual schema/consumer fixture passed |

### Environment

Local fixtures: Node.js 24.22.1, Vitest 3.2.7, frozen workspace dependencies.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: terminal settings dialogs at Workspace scope show fewer entries because the omitted values cannot affect project configuration.
- Not validated / out of scope: live terminal screenshots. Both Ink and OpenTUI dialogs share this filtered key list; daemon callers that do not request filtering retain their behavior.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the configuration policy itself is unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Refs #8835, `dialog-offers-root-restricted-setting` in comment 6569621892.

prs.title: fix(acp): skip unusable transcript refreshes during active loads
prs.body:
## Upstream synchronization — 2026-11-15

Current head: `80cadc06e4914a97d7954be4201cf132906d717b`. Merged upstream main `8fee98a13172`, including the malformed-proxy isolation tracked in #17176 and the fail-fast executable's lowercase-proxy isolation merged in #17240. [CI for the synchronized head](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43666346880) has been triggered; its result is separate from the historical validation below.

The original five-file PR patch retains the same paths and added/removed lines. `bridgeClient.ts`, `session-control-plane.ts`, and `bridge.test.ts` also incorporate upstream changes; complete forward/reverse patch checks verified that both the PR changes and upstream content are retained. The document and active-load regression file blobs are unchanged. The eight-scenario ACP runtime report remains bound to `7c16962f` and has not been rerun on the synchronized head. All earlier hosted results retain their explicitly named commit scope.

本次同步保留原补丁并吸收上游公共 CI 修复及 bridge 文件中的其他上游变更。8 场景 ACP 运行报告仍属于 `7c16962f`，其他历史验证保留各自注明的提交范围，没有将旧结果记作新提交的重跑结果。

## What this PR does

Returns the existing live replay when a paged session load encounters an active foreground, background, or Goal turn, or a pending interaction. The eligibility check runs before every persisted-page read, including retries and traversal through empty pages. The post-read check also accounts for Goal activity, including a Goal turn that starts before publishing any journal event, while retaining the session identity, replay epoch and projection checks.

## Why it's needed

An active session already has the replay that the client needs. Previously, each paged load still waited for up to two persisted transcript reads whose results were discarded because the turn was active. Two concurrent loads therefore issued four unnecessary reads and could remain blocked on storage or child-process latency. A turn that began during a read could also cause further unusable reads.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Keep a foreground prompt open, publish a visible live response, and issue two concurrent paged loads. Both should return the live replay without requesting persisted transcript pages.
2. Repeat with an admitted background-notification turn and with a Goal turn. The same behavior should hold even though no foreground prompt is active.
3. Start from an idle session and hold its first transcript-page reply. Start a foreground, background, or Goal turn before releasing that reply. The load should return live replay without retrying or following an empty page's cursor. Also start a Goal turn without publishing a journal event: the stale persisted reply must still be ignored in favor of live replay.
4. Finish the work and load the idle session again. Persisted-page refresh should still occur and supply the fresh persisted content.
5. Start a transcript read while idle, then begin a prompt and issue a second load. The active load must return live replay without another transcript RPC. Fail the transport and confirm the pending load, prompt and resume reject, client IDs are cleared, and terminal telemetry is emitted.
6. Start a Goal turn and queue a user message while it is active. End the turn with a valid, empty or overlong reason. In all three cases, the undrained message should leave the mid-turn queue, enter pending prompts and be sent once; a malformed reason must still be rejected as a completion event.

The initial six regression cases failed on the unchanged base and passed with the first patch; that initial validation also passed 69 focused bridge tests, including 63 existing refresh-related tests, and the ACP bridge workspace build/typecheck. The follow-up adds four Goal cases and repairs the existing transport-failure fixture so its first transcript read begins while idle, retaining its failure, cleanup and telemetry assertions.

### Evidence (Before & After)

An independent script invokes the real bridge API through the repository's in-memory ACP channel, with deferred transcript replies and no model or network dependency.

| Checkpoint | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Two concurrent paged loads while the foreground prompt remains active | Two reads pending; four reads after both first replies are released | Both return live content with zero transcript RPCs |
| Persisted content returned for those active loads | None; both eventually use the live replay | None; live replay is immediately available without those reads |
| Idle-session control | Persisted refresh is supported | One transcript RPC and persisted content returned |

The before-script's 150 ms observation interval is an artificial fixture gate, not a production latency benchmark. The after-script confirms the loads finish while the prompt is still active and before any transcript reply is released.

### Follow-up evidence

| Check | Prior PR head `a0032ab8` | Follow-up |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Goal activity before a load or beginning during a pending page read, including no new journal event | All four added Goal cases failed; six foreground/background controls passed | All ten active-replay cases passed |
| Existing transport-failure regression | Failed because it waited for a transcript read after the prompt was already active | Passed with the initial read started while idle; the subsequent active load adds no transcript RPC and the rejection/cleanup assertions remain |
| Guard-removal check | — | Removing the pre-read activity guard makes the updated transport regression fail; restoring the guard passes |

### Earlier Goal guard validation

During this follow-up, the complete ACP bridge suite passed **66 files / 2,958 tests**. After the final equivalent boolean-expression adjustment for TypeScript flow narrowing, all **11 focused regressions** and the complete ACP bridge `tsc --noEmit` check passed on the final tree. An independent rerun of those 11 cases also passed. Targeted ESLint, Prettier and `git diff --check` passed.

The earlier Goal-guard commit is `718f28d29315025328864c44b0db7a10b17ab0fc`. A local package build during this follow-up exhausted its 2 GiB heap while building the referenced Core project (exit 134). Full repository validation for this exact commit:

[Hosted validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43402624111) passed for exact commit `718f28d29315025328864c44b0db7a10b17ab0fc` on Linux with Node.js 22 and frozen pnpm dependencies. The standard `npm run build` and full workspace/integration `npm run typecheck` both passed, followed by the **complete ACP bridge suite: 66 files and 2,958 tests, all passing, with no failures or skips**. This validation of `718f28d2` resolved the local build-memory validation limit described above. It is fork validation of `718f28d2`; upstream CI for the synchronized head is linked above.

### Earlier Goal terminal validation

After resolving and verifying ownership of the session, an end-turn notification explicitly marked as Goal now clears the Goal activity latch before validating the remaining terminal payload. A malformed reason still prevents the completion event from being dispatched. The existing active-replay guards and non-Goal event behavior are retained.

The added real-bridge regression starts a Goal turn and first confirms live replay with zero transcript RPCs. It then sends a Goal terminal with an empty reason and confirms that the next paged load issues one transcript RPC, returns the persisted page in compacted replay, and preserves the indication that older history remains. Restoring the original terminal handler makes only this new regression fail at the transcript-read assertion; restoring the fix passes.

[Exact-commit hosted validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43413364320) passed for `65d05b504e17005451a38c2a7fcfe80121fa3c10` on Linux with Node.js 22.23.4 and frozen pnpm 11.24.0 dependencies: full `npm run build`, full workspace/integration `npm run typecheck`, `npm run bundle`, targeted Prettier/ESLint, the original-handler counterfactual and restored regression, and the complete ACP bridge suite (**66 files / 2,959 tests, all passed**). Local focused verification passed 177 tests. This is fork validation of the named historical commit; upstream CI for the synchronized head is linked above.

### Goal terminal queue follow-up

The Goal terminal also settles undrained user messages immediately after clearing the activity latch and before validating the remaining terminal payload. An empty or overlong reason can no longer leave a previously accepted message stranded in an idle session. Invalid completion events are still dropped, and session ownership checks and non-Goal behavior are preserved.

The existing real-bridge queue regression now covers valid, empty and 129-character reasons. It confirms admission during the active Goal, no premature prompt dispatch, promotion of the queued message into pending prompts, exactly one agent prompt call, and an empty queue afterward. The controlled reply is released and the bridge shuts down in `finally`, including on assertion failure. On the unchanged `65d05b50` production source, the two malformed-reason cases failed directly while the valid control passed. The original independent two-case bridge fixture also reproduced the empty-reason failure and now passes both cases.

Hosted counterfactuals retained the committed tests: restoring the parent production source gave one passing valid control and two direct assertion failures for empty and oversized reasons. Removing the queue-settlement call, or placing it before the activity-latch clear, each produced three direct assertion failures. Each targeted selection filtered out the other 1,065 tests; these were not full-suite reruns. After exact source restoration, all three selected cases passed and the source diff was clean.

[Exact-commit hosted validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43427676231) for `7c16962f5ed04d61eff25accadc105e18be6cb34`: standard `npm run build`, full workspace/integration `npm run typecheck`, `npm run bundle`, targeted Prettier/ESLint and the counterfactual checks all passed on Linux with Node.js 22.23.4 and frozen pnpm 11.24.0 dependencies. The complete ACP bridge suite passed **66 files / 2,961 tests, with zero failures or skips**. This is fork validation of the named historical commit; upstream CI for the synchronized head is linked above. The `65d05b50` results above remain historical validation of the preceding latch fix.

### Runtime observation on previously approved commit 7c16962f — 2026-11-14

Completed a separate-process ACP runtime observation on commit `7c16962f5ed04d61eff25accadc105e18be6cb34` at 15:46:56 UTC: **8/8 scenarios completed, runner exit 0, all eight child processes shut down cleanly**. [Report and reproduction commands](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/blob/68f2ad65ac69afd39efa58b9883636481e45a961/.github/validation/pr17106-runtime-7c16962f/README.md), [structured results](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/blob/68f2ad65ac69afd39efa58b9883636481e45a961/.github/validation/pr17106-runtime-7c16962f/runtime-results.json), and [process output](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/blob/68f2ad65ac69afd39efa58b9883636481e45a961/.github/validation/pr17106-runtime-7c16962f/observation.log) are preserved on a separate evidence branch; that observation did not change the product source at `7c16962f`.

The runner executed the production bridge from `7c16962f`, session control plane, BridgeClient, and spawn factory with real stdio ACP JSON-RPC to separate controlled peer processes. Foreground, admitted background, and Goal activity each allowed two concurrent paged loads to return live replay with **0 transcript RPCs**; the subsequent idle control made **1 transcript RPC** and returned persisted content. An in-flight Goal start without a journal event discarded the stale page without retry. A foreground start during an empty page with an older cursor returned live replay without a cursor follow-up. Valid, empty, and overlong Goal terminal reasons each promoted the queued prompt exactly once, with Goal completion-event counts **1/0/0**.

The report includes source/dependency hashes, raw wire traces, bridge events, negative/idle controls, and the first fixture-shutdown correction. An independent read-only check matched the 909 source hashes and checked all eight traces against the results. This was a Linux x64 / Node.js 24.22.1 production bridge/transport run against a **controlled ACP peer**; it does not claim a packaged Qwen CLI, authenticated model, full daemon HTTP server, or browser run. The hosted build/typecheck and 2,961-test evidence for `7c16962f` remain separate.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested |

### Environment

Local targeted verification used Node.js v24.22.1 and Vitest 3.2.7. The hosted environment and complete suite for `7c16962f` are recorded in the Goal terminal queue follow-up above. Independent bridge API reproduction plus focused unit regressions; no live daemon HTTP server, browser or model run is claimed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: active loads use the existing bounded live replay and its existing truncation metadata. Idle sessions retain persisted refresh, and pagination-anchor backfills remain a separate operation.
- Not validated / out of scope: this addresses Defect A's discarded active-session reads in #16368. It does not introduce cancellation of an already-running transcript RPC or coalesce independent idle refreshes. Defect B's event-ring retention was addressed separately by #16413. Initial full monorepo build/typecheck attempts exited 137 in the local environment. Historical local limits and subsequent exact-commit hosted validation are recorded above; those attempts are historical, and the synchronized head's CI is linked above.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no wire fields or API signatures change.

## Linked Issues

Refs #16368, Defect A.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

分页加载会话时，如果前台、后台、Goal 回合或待处理交互仍然活跃，就直接返回已有的实时回放。资格检查会在每一次持久化分页读取之前执行，包括重试及空页游标遍历。读取后的检查也覆盖 Goal 活动，包括尚未发布任何 journal 事件就开始的 Goal 回合；原有的会话身份、回放 epoch 与投影状态检查继续保留。

## 为什么需要

活动会话已经拥有客户端需要的回放。此前，每次分页加载仍会等待最多两次持久化记录读取，随后又因为回合活跃而丢弃读取结果。两次并发加载因此会发出四次无用读取，并受存储或子进程延迟阻塞。在读取过程中开始的新回合也可能继续触发无法使用的读取。

## 审阅者验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 保持一个前台 prompt 未结束，发布可见的实时响应，再发起两次并发分页加载。两次加载都应直接返回实时回放，不请求持久化记录页。
2. 分别改用已接纳的后台通知回合和 Goal 回合重复验证。即使没有活动前台 prompt，也应保持相同行为。
3. 从空闲会话开始，暂时阻塞第一次历史分页回复，在释放回复前启动前台、后台或 Goal 回合。加载应返回实时回放，不再重试，也不继续读取空页的后续游标。另需验证 Goal 启动后尚未发布 journal 事件的情况：旧的持久化回复仍不得被采纳。
4. 结束活动工作，再次加载空闲会话。此时仍应读取持久化分页并返回最新持久化内容。
5. 在空闲时启动历史读取，再开始 prompt 并发起第二次加载。活动加载应直接返回实时回放，不增加历史 RPC。随后令传输失败，确认待完成的 load、prompt、resume 均被拒绝，客户端 ID 被清理，并发出终止遥测事件。
6. 启动 Goal 回合，并在活动期间排入一条用户消息。分别以有效、空字符串和过长的 reason 结束回合。三种情况下，未被消费的消息都应离开回合中队列、进入待执行 prompt 并发送一次；格式错误的 reason 仍不得发布为完成事件。

初版六项回归测试在未修改基线上全部失败，应用首个补丁后全部通过；初版验证还通过了 69 项定向 bridge 测试（含 63 项既有刷新相关测试）及 ACP bridge 工作区构建、类型检查。本轮增加四项 Goal 用例，并修正既有传输失败用例的时序：第一次历史读取在空闲时启动，原有失败传播、清理和遥测断言继续保留。

### 修改前后证据

独立脚本通过仓库现有的内存 ACP 通道调用真实 bridge API，使用可控的延迟历史分页回复，不依赖模型或网络。

| 检查点 | 修改前 | 修改后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前台 prompt 保持活跃时，两次并发分页加载 | 两次读取等待；释放各自第一页后总计四次读取 | 两次直接返回实时内容，历史 RPC 为零 |
| 上述活动加载是否返回持久化内容 | 不返回；最终均使用实时回放 | 不返回；无需这些读取即可获得实时回放 |
| 空闲会话对照 | 支持持久化刷新 | 发出一次历史 RPC 并返回持久化内容 |

修改前脚本的 150 ms 观察窗口是人为控制的测试等待，不是生产环境延迟基准。修改后脚本确认：prompt 仍活跃、尚未释放任何历史分页回复时，两次加载已经完成。

### 本轮跟进证据

| 检查 | 前一 PR head `a0032ab8` | 跟进后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 加载前已活跃的 Goal，或在分页读取中启动的 Goal，包括没有新 journal 事件的情况 | 四项新增 Goal 用例全部失败；六项前台/后台对照通过 | 十项活动回放用例全部通过 |
| 既有传输失败回归 | prompt 已活跃后仍等待历史读取，导致失败 | 改为空闲时启动首次读取后通过；随后活动加载不增加历史 RPC，拒绝和清理断言保留 |
| 去除保护的对照 | — | 临时去除读取前活动检查后，更新的传输回归失败；恢复检查后通过 |

### 此前 Goal 活动保护的验证

本轮完整 ACP bridge 测试通过 **66 个文件、2,958 项测试**。随后为适配 TypeScript 控制流收窄，仅调整了等价的布尔表达式写法；最终源码树的 **11 项定向回归**和完整 ACP bridge `tsc --noEmit` 均通过，另一次独立复跑的 11 项用例也通过。针对改动的 ESLint、Prettier 和 `git diff --check` 均通过。

此前 Goal 活动保护的提交为 `718f28d29315025328864c44b0db7a10b17ab0fc`。当时一次本地包构建在编译所引用的 Core 项目时耗尽 2 GiB 堆并以 134 退出。该此前提交的全仓验证：

针对精确提交 `718f28d29315025328864c44b0db7a10b17ab0fc` 的[托管验证](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43402624111)已通过，环境为 Linux、Node.js 22 和冻结锁文件的 pnpm 依赖。标准 `npm run build`、全工作区及集成代码的 `npm run typecheck` 均通过，随后 **ACP bridge 全套 66 个文件、2,958 项测试全部通过，0 失败、0 跳过**。提交 `718f28d2` 的验证补齐了上文由本地构建内存限制留下的验证缺口。这是该历史提交的 fork 验证；同步后的新提交 CI 见文首链接。

### 此前 Goal 结束通知修复的验证

结束通知先解析会话并确认归属；对于明确标记为 Goal 的通知，现在会先清除 Goal 活跃标记，再校验其余结束载荷。无效的 reason 仍会阻止发布完成事件。原有活动回放保护及非 Goal 事件的行为继续保留。

新增真实 bridge 回归先启动 Goal 回合，确认活动期间直接返回实时回放且历史 RPC 为零；随后发送空 reason 的 Goal 结束通知，确认下一次分页加载发出一次历史 RPC、在压缩回放中返回持久化页，并保留存在更早历史的标记。临时恢复旧结束处理器后，只有新增用例在历史读取次数断言处失败；恢复修复后通过。

精确提交 `65d05b504e17005451a38c2a7fcfe80121fa3c10` 的[托管验证](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43413364320)已通过，环境为 Linux、Node.js 22.23.4 和冻结锁文件的 pnpm 11.24.0 依赖：全仓 `npm run build`、全工作区及集成代码的 `npm run typecheck`、`npm run bundle`、定向 Prettier/ESLint、旧处理器反向对照及恢复后的回归，以及完整 ACP bridge 套件（**66 个文件、2,959 项测试全部通过**）。本地定向验证另通过 177 项测试。这是所注明历史提交的 fork 验证；同步后的新提交 CI 见文首链接。

### Goal 结束通知的队列后续修复

Goal 结束通知现在还会在清除活动标记之后、校验其余结束载荷之前，结算未被消费的用户消息。空或过长的 reason 不再让已经接纳的消息滞留在对外显示空闲的会话中。格式错误的完成事件仍被丢弃，会话归属检查及非 Goal 行为保持不变。

既有真实 bridge 队列回归现在覆盖有效、空及 129 字符的 reason。测试确认消息在 Goal 活动期间被接纳、不会提前发送 prompt，结束后提升进入待执行 prompt，实际 agent 仅收到一次调用，随后队列为空。受控回复在 `finally` 中释放并关闭 bridge，断言失败时也能清理。在未改动的 `65d05b50` 生产源码上，两项无效 reason 用例均直接断言失败，有效值对照通过。原独立两项 bridge 夹具也复现了空 reason 的失败，修复后两项均通过。

托管反向验证保留了已提交的回归测试：恢复父提交生产源码后，有效值对照通过，空 reason 与过长 reason 两项直接断言失败。移除队列结算调用，或把调用放在清除活动标记之前，均产生三项直接断言失败。各次定向筛选均过滤其余 1,065 项测试，并非每次重跑全套。恢复精确源码后，选中的三项全部通过，源码差异检查干净

精确提交 `7c16962f5ed04d61eff25accadc105e18be6cb34` 的[托管验证](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43427676231)：在 Linux、Node.js 22.23.4 和冻结锁文件的 pnpm 11.24.0 环境中，标准 `npm run build`、全工作区及集成代码的 `npm run typecheck`、`npm run bundle`、定向 Prettier/ESLint 和反向验证全部通过。完整 ACP bridge 套件通过 **66 个文件、2,961 项测试，0 失败、0 跳过**。这是所注明历史提交的 fork 验证；同步后的新提交 CI 见文首链接。上面的 `65d05b50` 结果明确保留为此前活动标记修复的历史验证。

### 已批准提交的实际运行观察 — 2026-11-14

已于 15:46:56 UTC 对提交 `7c16962f5ed04d61eff25accadc105e18be6cb34` 完成独立进程 ACP 运行观察：**8/8 场景完成、执行器退出码 0、8 个子进程均正常关闭**。[完整报告与复现命令](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/blob/68f2ad65ac69afd39efa58b9883636481e45a961/.github/validation/pr17106-runtime-7c16962f/README.md)、[结构化结果](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/blob/68f2ad65ac69afd39efa58b9883636481e45a961/.github/validation/pr17106-runtime-7c16962f/runtime-results.json)和[进程输出](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/blob/68f2ad65ac69afd39efa58b9883636481e45a961/.github/validation/pr17106-runtime-7c16962f/observation.log)已保存在独立证据分支；该次观察没有修改 `7c16962f` 的产品源码。

执行器运行该提交的真实 bridge、session control plane、BridgeClient 和 spawn factory，通过实际 stdio ACP JSON-RPC 与独立的受控对端进程通信。前台、已接纳后台及 Goal 活动期间，两次并发分页加载均返回实时回放，**transcript RPC 为 0 次**；随后空闲对照均调用 **1 次 transcript RPC** 并返回持久化内容。在读取中启动且未产生 journal 事件的 Goal 会使旧页失效，不再重试；空页带旧游标时启动前台提示，加载返回实时回放且不继续读取游标。有效、空字符串及超长 Goal 终止原因均只派发一次排队提示，对应 Goal 完成事件数为 **1/0/0**。

报告包含源文件与依赖哈希、原始协议记录、bridge 事件、负向及空闲对照，也保留首次夹具关闭错误及修正记录。独立只读复核核对了 909 个源码哈希以及全部 8 份协议记录与结果。环境为 Linux x64 / Node.js 24.22.1，范围是生产 bridge/传输层与**受控 ACP 对端**的真实进程运行；未将其表述为打包 Qwen CLI、已认证模型、完整 daemon HTTP 服务或浏览器运行。已有的同 head 托管构建、类型检查和 2,961 项测试证据仍单独保留。

| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境

本地定向验证使用 Node.js v24.22.1、Vitest 3.2.7；提交 `7c16962f` 的托管环境和完整套件结果见上面的 Goal 结束通知队列后续修复。验证包括独立 bridge API 复现和定向单元回归；未声称执行了真实 daemon HTTP 服务、浏览器或模型测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：活动加载使用现有、有界的实时回放及其截断元数据。空闲会话仍会刷新持久化记录，分页锚点回填仍是独立操作。

- 破坏性变更或迁移：不改变协议字段或 API 签名。

prs.title: feat: make each surface's resolved agent-loop path visible
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the agent loop a surface actually runs observable. `/about` and `/bug` gain an "Agent Loop" line naming the current surface and the loop path it resolves to (`legacy`, `shared`, or `kernel`), and every surface now writes a uniform `[LOOP] <surface> <path>` entry to the debug log where it reads the loop switch — including the legacy path, which previously logged nothing. The path is derived from the same per-surface switches the surface itself reads, so the reported path cannot drift from the path taken. The interactive surface is determined from the execution mode and the renderer of record; the Settings dialog, which has no execution mode, simply omits the line.

## Why it's needed

This is block B slice 3 of the event-bus loop rollout (#17045). The per-surface switches (slices 1–2, merged) decide which loop a surface runs, but a run never said which loop it took. An operator filing a bug could not tell whether the session ran the legacy loop, the shared loop, or the event-bus kernel, and the legacy path left no debug-log trace at all. A uniform, per-surface path marker plus a read-only diagnostic line makes a run's loop provable from the debug log and from `/about` / `/bug`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the headless surface against a mock or real model with the loop switches set three ways and confirm the debug log carries exactly one `[LOOP] headless <path>` entry per turn matching the resolved path: both switches off → `legacy`; `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_UNIFIED_AGENT_LOOP=1` → `shared`; both `=1` → `kernel`. Run `/about` non-interactively and confirm the `Agent Loop: headless: <path>` line appears, and that the Settings dialog Status tab omits it. The new integration test `integration-tests/cli/agent-loop-visibility.test.ts` asserts all three paths and that the marker wording does not reuse the substrings the parity suites count for arm identity.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-user-visible beyond the new diagnostic line. Before: the legacy path logged nothing and `/about`/`/bug` did not name the loop. After (real-env, mock model): `[LOOP] headless legacy` / `[LOOP] headless shared` / `[LOOP] headless kernel` (one per turn) and `Agent Loop: headless: legacy` in `/about`. Mutation witness: removing the headless entry marker turns all 4 visibility integration tests red; restoring it (byte-identical) returns them to green.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local build + bundle (`node dist/cli.js`) against the zero-dependency mock OpenAI server; unit + integration suites via vitest.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the marker is debug-log only and the `/about`/`/bug` line is read-only diagnostics; no switch resolution rules or defaults change. The ink surface reads its switch per model round, so its marker is per round there (once per turn on the other surfaces). The marker wording is deliberately distinct from the parity suites' counted markers so arm-identity counts are unaffected (verified in the shared-arm debug log).
- Not validated / out of scope: flipping any surface default (later rollout slices); the true/false whole-value env spellings and nightly current-leg pin remain with #17048.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design document: [English](../docs/design/2026-11-14-loop-visibility.md) · [简体中文](../docs/design/2026-11-14-loop-visibility.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

References #17045 (block B, slice 3). Slices 1–2 merged as #17050 / #17055; slice 4 delivered by #17172.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

让各入口实际运行的 agent loop 可被观察。`/about` 与 `/bug` 新增一行「Agent Loop」，写明当前入口及其解析到的 loop 路径（`legacy`、`shared` 或 `kernel`）；每个入口现在在读取 loop 开关处向 debug 日志写入统一的 `[LOOP] <surface> <path>` 标记——包括此前什么都不记的 legacy 路径。路径由入口自身所读的同一对按入口开关推导，因此所报路径不会与实际所走路径漂移。交互入口由执行模式与实际渲染器判定；没有执行模式的设置对话框则省略该行。

## 为什么需要

这是 event-bus loop 灰度（#17045）B 块切片 3。按入口开关（切片 1–2，已合入）决定某入口跑哪条 loop，但一次运行从不明示自己走了哪条 loop。操作者提 bug 时无法判断会话跑的是 legacy、shared 还是内核，且 legacy 路径在 debug 日志中毫无痕迹。统一的按入口路径标记加只读诊断行，使一次运行的 loop 可从 debug 日志与 `/about` / `/bug` 证明。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

将 loop 开关设为三种状态，对 mock 或真实模型跑 headless 入口，确认 debug 日志每轮次恰有一条 `[LOOP] headless <path>` 且与解析路径一致：两开关皆关 → `legacy`；`QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_UNIFIED_AGENT_LOOP=1` → `shared`；两者皆 `=1` → `kernel`。非交互跑 `/about`，确认出现 `Agent Loop: headless: <path>` 行，且设置对话框 Status 页省略该行。新集成测试 `integration-tests/cli/agent-loop-visibility.test.ts` 断言三条路径，并断言标记措辞不复用对拍套件用于臂身份计数的子串。

### 证据（前后对比）

除新诊断行外无用户可见变化。之前：legacy 路径什么都不记，`/about`/`/bug` 不报 loop。之后（真实环境、mock 模型）：`[LOOP] headless legacy` / `[LOOP] headless shared` / `[LOOP] headless kernel`（每轮次一条），`/about` 出现 `Agent Loop: headless: legacy`。变异见证：移除 headless 入口标记使 4 条可见性集成测试全红；字节级还原后恢复全绿。

### 测试平台

Linux ✅（本地验证）；macOS / Windows ⚠️ 未测。

### 环境

本地 build + bundle（`node dist/cli.js`）对零依赖 mock OpenAI server；vitest 单测 + 集成套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：标记仅 debug 日志，`/about`/`/bug` 行为只读诊断；不改开关解析规则或默认值。ink 入口每模型轮读取开关，故其标记在 ink 为每轮一次（其余入口每轮次一次）。标记措辞刻意区别于对拍套件所计数的标记，臂身份计数不受影响（已在 shared 臂 debug 日志核对）。
- 未验证/范围外：翻转任何入口默认值（后续灰度切片）；true/false 整值 env 拼写与 nightly current 腿 pin 仍归 #17048。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。

设计文档：[英文](../docs/design/2026-11-14-loop-visibility.md) · [简体中文](../docs/design/2026-11-14-loop-visibility.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

prs.title: fix(web-shell): cap concurrent session SSE streams and resubscribe via Last-Event-ID
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Caps the number of concurrent persistent SSE event streams per browser context at 4 (one per split-view pane), so 5+ panes no longer saturate the browser's per-origin HTTP/1.1 connection pool. A subscription beyond the budget no longer opens a 5th/6th persistent stream: it waits its turn, does a serialized catch-up cycle (replay from the last delivered event via `Last-Event-ID`, up to the daemon's `replay_complete` boundary, on a short-lived connection that is cancelled afterwards), and once a slot frees up — a pane closes, or the focused pane evicts the least-recently active background pane — it takes the live slot and resumes from the furthest event id its catch-up delivered.
The implementation is a small budget registry (`SseBudgetRegistry`, a module singleton = one instance per JS context) added to the SDK daemon transport layer (`packages/sdk-typescript/src/daemon/SseBudget.ts`), integrated into `RestSseTransport.subscribeEvents` (acquire on open, touch per live frame, release on close, focus-aware LRU eviction that aborts the evicted request with an explicit `AbortError: preempted` so the evicted consumer's existing reconnect loop picks it back up), plus a one-line focus hook in the web-shell split view (`SplitView.tsx` reports the focused pane to the registry on focus capture).

## Why it's needed

Each split-view pane holds a persistent `GET /session/:id/events` SSE connection, and the daemon only speaks HTTP/1.1 — so every pane consumes one slot of the browser's per-origin connection pool (6 in WebKit, the engine behind Qwen Code Desktop on macOS). With 5 panes the pool saturates and the engine starts aborting the panes' fetches: the UI shows "Connection lost: Fetch is aborted" and panes flap on reconnect (QwenLM/qwen-code#13908). Capping live streams at 4 leaves headroom in the pool and turns the excess panes from permanent pool consumers into short catch-up connections that close right after the replay boundary.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Behavior (SDK unit + behavioral tests, node environment): `cd packages/sdk-typescript && npx vitest run test/unit/SseBudget.test.ts test/unit/RestSseTransport.sseBudget.test.ts` — 22 tests: slot accounting, focus LRU eviction (`AbortError: preempted`), catch-up cycle serialization, cursor handling, the `replay_complete` boundary, `DaemonHttpError` parity with the live path, and end-to-end against a fake daemon: 5 panes → exactly 4 open live connections + 1 temporary catch-up connection closed after the boundary; 6 panes → 5 open total (below the 6-connection pool); the focused pane evicts the LRU background pane (its connection closes and its generator completes cleanly); a promoted pane reconnects live from the furthest catch-up cursor (`Last-Event-ID: 12`); a failing catch-up throws `DaemonHttpError` and frees the cycle for the next pane.
- Negative control: against the pre-fix transport the 4 budget behavior tests fail on assertions (5+ open connections, no eviction, no catch-up) while the error-parity test still passes — the tests measure the fix, not the harness.
- Full SDK suite + typecheck + lint, in Docker (node:22-bookworm, one-shot container): `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` + `npm run build` + `npx vitest run --pool=forks` (packages/sdk-typescript) + `npx tsc --noEmit` + `npx eslint --max-warnings 0` + `npx prettier --check` on the changed files — all green (numbers under Environment).
- Web-shell: the SplitView focus hook — `client/components/SplitView.test.tsx` in Docker (jsdom).
- Live check (same algorithm, already shipped as an installer patch REQ-A27 on the 0.25.1 live bundle): 4–6 split-view panes in Desktop with active sessions — 0 "Connection lost: Fetch is aborted" (verified 2026-10-15 on macOS; see the issue thread).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change; the user-visible effect is the absence of "Connection lost" flaps in a 5+ pane split view, covered by the live check above and by the issue thread.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

- macOS: SDK suite (69 tests) on the macOS host (node v26.5.0); the budget logic live-verified in a 4–6 pane split view on the 0.25.1 patched bundle (0 "Connection lost", 2026-10-15).
- Linux: Docker node:22-bookworm — build + full SDK vitest + tsc + eslint + prettier, and web-shell SplitView vitest (jsdom).
- Windows: deferred by decision 2026-11-07 — the UTM Win11 VM is not recreated (host disk); the diff is platform-independent (pure TS transport + one focus call, node/jsdom tests, no platform-specific code) and covered by the CI lanes; the local Windows run is deferred.

### Environment

macOS 26.6.2 (Apple Silicon); node v26.5.0 (host tests) / node 22 (Docker gates); pnpm via corepack. Docker gate run (one-shot node:22-bookworm container): install/build green; vitest packages/sdk-typescript: 62 files, 2379 passed (+1 skipped); tsc --noEmit: 0 errors; eslint --max-warnings 0: clean; prettier --check on the 8 changed files: clean; web-shell SplitView vitest: 58 passed (1 file).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an evicted pane is briefly interrupted (its live stream is aborted with `AbortError: preempted`) and must reconnect — for the focused pane this is the intended trade (the user is watching the focused pane), and the consumer's existing reconnect loop + `Last-Event-ID` resume makes the catch-up idempotent; the eviction reason is a `DOMException`, so the existing abort handling path is reused rather than a new failure mode introduced.
- Not validated / out of scope: no Windows runner (⚠️ row above); the budget is per JS context (per webview) — a multi-webview window is not capped globally (v1 limitation, documented in the code); no change to daemon-side replay/epoch semantics (reused as-is); HTTP/2 support is out of scope for this fix.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: one documented behavior change — an already-aborted caller signal now completes the subscription generator before any network request (previously the connect fetch was still attempted with the aborted signal); the existing "signal abort prevents iteration" test now asserts the new behavior (0 fetches).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13908

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

将每个浏览器上下文中并发的持久 SSE 事件流数量限制为 4（每个 split-view 面板一条），使 5 个及以上面板不再占满浏览器按 origin 划分的 HTTP/1.1 连接池。超出预算的订阅不再打开第 5/6 条持久流：它排队等待，执行一次串行化的追赶周期（通过 `Last-Event-ID` 从最后一条已交付事件开始重放，直到守护进程的 `replay_complete` 边界，使用随后即被取消的短连接）；一旦有槽位释放——某个面板关闭，或获得焦点的面板逐出最近最久未活动的后台面板——它就接管实时槽位，并从其追赶周期所达到的最远事件 id 继续。
实现是加入 SDK 守护进程传输层的一个小型预算注册表（`SseBudgetRegistry`，模块单例 = 每个 JS 上下文一个实例）（`packages/sdk-typescript/src/daemon/SseBudget.ts`），集成进 `RestSseTransport.subscribeEvents`（打开时获取、每条实时帧 touch、关闭时释放、基于焦点感知的 LRU 逐出——以显式的 `AbortError: preempted` 中止被逐出的请求，使被逐出消费者的既有重连循环将其接回），外加 web-shell split view 中一行焦点钩子（`SplitView.tsx` 在焦点捕获时向注册表报告当前焦点面板）。

## Why it's needed

每个 split-view 面板都持有一条持久的 `GET /session/:id/events` SSE 连接，而守护进程只说 HTTP/1.1——因此每个面板都会占用浏览器按 origin 划分的连接池（WebKit 为 6，即 macOS 上 Qwen Code Desktop 背后的引擎）中的一个槽位。当有 5 个面板时连接池被占满，引擎开始中止各面板的 fetch：UI 显示 "Connection lost: Fetch is aborted"，面板在重连中抖动（QwenLM/qwen-code#13908）。把实时流限制在 4 条为连接池留出余量，并把超出的面板从永久占用连接池的连接变为短促的追赶连接——它们在重放边界后立即关闭。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- 行为（SDK 单元 + 行为测试，node 环境）：`cd packages/sdk-typescript && npx vitest run test/unit/SseBudget.test.ts test/unit/RestSseTransport.sseBudget.test.ts`——22 条测试：槽位计数、焦点 LRU 逐出（`AbortError: preempted`）、追赶周期串行化、游标处理、`replay_complete` 边界、与实时路径一致的 `DaemonHttpError`，以及针对伪守护进程的端到端测试：5 个面板 → 恰好 4 条打开的实时连接 + 1 条在边界后关闭的临时追赶连接；6 个面板 → 总共 5 条打开（低于 6 连接的池上限）；焦点面板逐出最近最久未活动的后台面板（其连接关闭、其生成器干净结束）；被提升的面板从其追赶游标的最远处（`Last-Event-ID: 12`）重新建立实时连接；失败的追赶抛出 `DaemonHttpError` 并为下一个面板释放周期。
- 负面控制：在修复前的传输实现上，4 条预算行为测试在断言上失败（5+ 条打开连接、无逐出、无追赶），而错误一致性测试仍然通过——测试度量的是修复本身，而非测试框架。
- 完整 SDK 套件 + 类型检查 + lint，在 Docker 中（node:22-bookworm，一次性容器）：`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` + `npm run build` + `npx vitest run --pool=forks`（packages/sdk-typescript）+ `npx tsc --noEmit` + `npx eslint --max-warnings 0` + 对变更文件 `npx prettier --check`——全部绿色（数字见 Environment）。
- Web-shell：SplitView 焦点钩子——Docker 中的 `client/components/SplitView.test.tsx`（jsdom）。
- 实时检查（同一算法，已作为安装器补丁 REQ-A27 随 0.25.1 live bundle 交付）：Desktop 中 4–6 个 split-view 面板、会话活跃——0 次 "Connection lost: Fetch is aborted"（2026-10-15 在 macOS 上验证；见 issue 讨论串）。

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A——非 UI 变更；用户可见的效果是 5+ 面板 split view 中 "Connection lost" 抖动消失，由上述实时检查及 issue 讨论串覆盖。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

- macOS：SDK 套件（69 条测试）在 macOS 主机上运行（node v26.5.0）；预算逻辑已在 0.25.1 打补丁的 bundle 上以 4–6 面板 split view 实时验证（0 次 "Connection lost"，2026-10-15）。
- Linux：Docker node:22-bookworm——build + 完整 SDK vitest + tsc + eslint + prettier，以及 web-shell SplitView vitest（jsdom）。
- Windows：2026-11-07 决定暂缓——UTM Win11 虚拟机不再重建（宿主机磁盘不足）；该 diff 平台无关（纯 TS 传输 + 一行焦点调用，node/jsdom 测试，无平台特定代码），由 CI lanes 覆盖；本地 Windows 验证暂缓。

### Environment

macOS 26.6.2（Apple Silicon）；node v26.5.0（主机测试）/ node 22（Docker 门禁）；pnpm 经 corepack。Docker 门禁运行（一次性 node:22-bookworm 容器）：install/build 绿色；vitest packages/sdk-typescript：62 个文件，2379 通过（+1 跳过）；tsc --noEmit：0 错误；eslint --max-warnings 0：干净；对 8 个变更文件 prettier --check：干净；web-shell SplitView vitest：58 通过（1 个文件）。

## Risk & Scope

- 主要风险或权衡：被逐出的面板会被短暂打断（其实时流以 `AbortError: preempted` 中止）并需重新连接——对焦点面板而言这是预期权衡（用户正在看焦点面板），且消费者既有的重连循环 + `Last-Event-ID` 续传使追赶幂等；逐出原因是一个 `DOMException`，因此复用的是既有的中止处理路径，而非引入新的失败模式。

- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：一处已文档化的行为变化——已中止的调用方信号现在会在任何网络请求之前结束订阅生成器（此前仍会尝试带中止信号的 connect fetch）；既有的 "signal abort prevents iteration" 测试现在断言新行为（0 次 fetch）。

prs.title: fix(cli): ignore unchanged JSON todo snapshots
prs.body:
## What this PR does

JSON task snapshots explicitly marked `unchanged: true` now preserve the terminal's existing task snapshot and do not revive tasks from a previous user turn. This matches the existing behavior for object results. Both encodings now pass through one shared shape/unchanged check, so the two rules cannot drift independently.

## Why it's needed

The sticky task consumer accepts both object and JSON task-list displays. A controlled, valid MCP response with a structured task-list result reaches the JSON path through the existing MCP tool execution and terminal display mapping. The object path already ignores an unchanged result; the JSON path previously treated it as a new snapshot.

This is a compatibility fix for that reachable result shape. The earlier ACP attribution has been removed: native TodoWrite success emits a plan update, which does not establish the claimed raw-output path. No live third-party server incident has been identified.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Return a structured task-list result from the controlled MCP client boundary, using either empty content or a matching compatibility JSON text block. Execute the real MCP tool invocation and terminal display mapper.
2. Start with a visible task snapshot. An unchanged result must preserve it both while pending and after committing to history.
3. Start a new user turn, then deliver an unchanged result from the prior task list. It must not revive that list.
4. Return a changed snapshot and confirm that pending and committed results still follow the existing visibility rules. Equivalent object-result controls must continue to pass.
5. Follow a valid task snapshot with a successful tool result whose `resultDisplay` is the JSON text `'null'`. `getStickyTodos` must preserve the earlier snapshot without throwing.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The added regression uses the real MCP invocation to create the JSON display and the real UI mapper and sticky-task consumer to handle it. The completed-call handoff between invocation and mapper is constructed in the test; it does not run the full scheduler or a network session.

Using the before-fix consumer from base `84b5b53f1738ef154bca3b3bd8bb40f4f3378510`, the same two suites produce **27 passed / 9 failed**: six new MCP no-op cases and three existing JSON guard cases fail, while both changed MCP controls pass. With the PR fix, **36/36 pass**: 28 task-snapshot tests and eight MCP integration cases. Targeted ESLint, Prettier, and the diff check pass.

The added settings-reference sentence has been removed because it described behavior already present for built-in object results.

### Shared-decoder follow-up

Review follow-up `37dc396f` parses JSON when needed, then applies one record/shape/unchanged check to both encodings. An unchanged snapshot still returns no update; an empty changed list remains a clearing snapshot. All existing **36/36** regressions pass locally, including both changed MCP controls. No test expectation or protocol fixture was changed for this refactor.

The additional test in `f9703610` sends the JSON text `'null'` through `getStickyTodos` after a valid snapshot. Removing only `|| candidate === null` makes this exact test fail with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'type')` (28 passed / 1 failed); restoring the guard passes all 29 task-snapshot tests. Production code is unchanged by this follow-up.

### Build validation

[Hosted validation of exact follow-up `f9703610261f8dba04f9602464a7f9681df93af8`](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43407475186/job/131825252323) passed the standard `npm run build`, full workspace/integration `npm run typecheck`, and **37/37 tests** (29 task-snapshot tests and eight MCP integration cases, 0 skipped). Targeted ESLint and Prettier passed. The same job verifies the guard-removal failure and restored source described above. Local focused tests, lint, formatting and `git diff --check` also pass.

The earlier before/after and shared-decoder results remain tied to their stated commits. This is independent fork validation; upstream PR workflows require maintainer authorization.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not run |
| Windows | Not run |
| Linux | Hosted full build/typecheck and 37/37 focused cases passed; null-guard mutation and restored-source checks passed; local lint and formatting passed |

### Environment

Local validation used Node.js 24.22.1; hosted validation used Node.js 22.23.4 on Linux. Both used Vitest 3.2.7 and pnpm 11.24.0 with frozen workspace dependencies.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: JSON results explicitly marked unchanged no longer replace the selected task snapshot, matching the object branch.
- Evidence boundary: the MCP protocol response is controlled. No captured third-party server response, live model conversation, full scheduler execution, or terminal screenshot is claimed.
- Scope: this change covers the terminal sticky-task consumer. ACP transcript replay and the OpenTUI event adapter are separate consumers and are not changed here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #8835, `todo-snapshot-string-branch-misses-unchanged-guard` in comment 5755846454. That report is the source of the consistency finding, not evidence of an observed production incident.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

明确标记为 `unchanged: true` 的 JSON 任务快照现在会保留终端已有任务快照，也不会恢复上一个用户回合的旧任务，与既有对象结果的行为一致。两种编码现在共用同一处形状和 unchanged 检查，避免规则分别维护造成差异。

## 为什么需要

固定任务消费者接受对象和 JSON 两种任务列表结果。受控的合法 MCP 结构化任务列表响应，会经过现有 MCP 工具执行及终端显示映射进入 JSON 路径。对象路径已经忽略未变化结果，但 JSON 路径此前会把它当作新快照。

这是针对该可达结果形状的兼容性修复。已移除原先的 ACP 归因：原生 TodoWrite 成功时发送的是 plan 更新，无法据此证明原先声称的 raw-output 链路。目前没有识别到真实第三方服务器上的线上事件。

## 评审测试计划

### 验证方法

1. 在受控 MCP 客户端边界返回结构化任务列表，分别使用空 content 和匹配的兼容 JSON 文本块，执行真实 MCP 工具调用及终端显示映射。
2. 从已有可见任务快照开始，确认未变化结果在待完成和提交到历史记录后均保留原快照。
3. 开始新用户回合，再传入旧任务列表的未变化结果，确认旧列表不重新出现。
4. 返回实际变化的快照，确认待完成和已提交结果仍遵循原有显示规则。等价对象结果的控制用例应继续通过。
5. 在有效任务快照之后放入成功工具结果，令其 `resultDisplay` 为 JSON 文本 `'null'`。`getStickyTodos` 应保留先前快照且不抛异常。

### 前后证据

新增回归通过真实 MCP 工具调用生成 JSON 显示内容，再调用真实 UI 映射和固定任务消费者。调用结束到 UI 映射之间的 completed-call 交接由测试构造，并未运行完整调度器或网络会话。

将消费者恢复到修复前基线 `84b5b53f1738ef154bca3b3bd8bb40f4f3378510`，相同两组测试得到 **27 项通过 / 9 项失败**：新增的六个 MCP 未变化场景及既有的三个 JSON 守卫场景失败，两个实际变化的 MCP 控制用例通过。使用本 PR 修复后，**36/36 通过**，包含 28 个任务快照测试和八个 MCP 集成用例。定向 ESLint、Prettier 和 diff 检查通过。

已撤回设置参考文档中新增的泛化句子，因为该行为此前已适用于内置工具的对象结果。

### 共享解析跟进

审阅跟进 `37dc396f` 仅在需要时解析 JSON，然后让两种编码共用记录、形状和 unchanged 检查。未变化快照仍表示不更新，实际变化的空列表仍表示清空。本地既有 **36/36** 项回归全部通过，包括两个变化的 MCP 控制用例；本次重构没有修改测试预期或协议夹具。

`f9703610` 新增的用例在有效快照之后，将 JSON 文本 `'null'` 送入 `getStickyTodos`。仅删除 `|| candidate === null` 时，该用例因 `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'type')` 失败（28 项通过 / 1 项失败）；恢复守卫后，29 项任务快照测试全部通过。本次跟进没有修改生产代码。

### 构建验证

针对精确跟进提交 `f9703610261f8dba04f9602464a7f9681df93af8` 的[托管验证](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43407475186/job/131825252323)已通过标准 `npm run build`、全工作区及集成代码的 `npm run typecheck`，以及 **37/37 项测试**（29 项任务快照测试和八项 MCP 集成用例，0 跳过）。定向 ESLint 和 Prettier 通过。同一任务也验证了上述删除守卫时的失败及源码恢复。本地针对性测试、lint、格式及 `git diff --check` 均通过。

原有前后对照和共享解析器结果继续对应其明确列出的提交。这是 fork 中的独立验证；上游 PR 工作流需要维护者授权。

### 环境

本地验证使用 Node.js 24.22.1；托管验证使用 Linux 上的 Node.js 22.23.4。两者均使用 Vitest 3.2.7、pnpm 11.24.0，以及冻结的 workspace 依赖。

## 风险与范围

## What this PR does

Adds `/memory show` to print the combined memory content the session carries, closing the blind spot where a user tuning memory (editing QWEN.md, `/remember`, `/forget`, `/dream`) had no way to verify what the model actually receives without an external-editor roundtrip. prs.title: fix(cli): preserve surfaced task selection across reordering
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Auto-surfaced approvals and explicitly selected tasks retain their identity when registry updates reorder the background-task list. In particular, a workflow approval that opens the list automatically stays selected when another task starts or finishes. Opening from the footer, keyboard navigation, and explicit selection record the task identity. Removing that task falls back near its last displayed row after reordering.

## Why it's needed

The list previously remembered only a row number. Starting a newer run or completing an existing run can reorder the registry snapshot, moving another task into that row. The user could therefore land on an unrelated agent or workflow instead of the approval that opened the list.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Park a workflow approval so that the background-task list opens on its workflow.
2. Start a newer workflow, then finish another run that sorts above the selected workflow. The same approval's workflow should remain selected as its row moves.
3. Navigate with Up/Down and select a row explicitly. Later registry updates should preserve that chosen task.
4. After a reorder moves the selected task, remove it and confirm that fallback clamps its last displayed row to the current list.
5. Open the list from the footer without navigating, start a newer task, and confirm that the original task stays selected.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The independent fixture uses the real provider and registry-subscription hook. Before the fix, inserting a newer run changed the selected task from the waiting workflow to an agent; completing another run changed it to a different workflow. An unchanged-order control passed. After the fix, all three cases pass without changing the fixture: the selected workflow moves from index 1 to 2, or 2 to 1, while retaining its identity. Current-head validation passes 12 provider, 20 view-hook, and 95 dialog cases (127 total). The two added footer-open and reorder-then-removal regressions fail with the previous provider implementation. Added coverage also checks that cancellation dispatch targets the selected workflow after reordering, navigation changes the identity, and removing a selected task preserves the existing in-range fallback. Targeted ESLint and Prettier pass.

### Build validation

[Hosted validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43565212403/job/132357445305) checked the exact current commit `ab73dbfe797d745d43ae7aa2d73192fc28931398` on Linux with Node.js 22 and frozen workspace dependencies. The complete `npm run build`, all-workspace/integration `npm run typecheck`, `npm run bundle`, targeted ESLint, and Prettier checks passed. This run passed all 127 provider (12), view-hook (20), and dialog (95) tests.

Upstream PR workflows on this head are currently `action_required`, awaiting a maintainer's approval of fork CI. The linked run provides validation for this exact commit.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not run |
| Windows | Not run |
| Linux | 127 provider, view-hook and dialog tests; independent actual provider/hook fixture passed |

### Environment

Local fixtures: Node.js 24.22.1, Vitest 3.2.7, jsdom/Ink fixtures and registry callbacks. No model or external provider is needed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an explicitly chosen task remains selected as its row moves, instead of keeping the same numerical row.
- Not validated / out of scope: live model/terminal E2E and the other #16444 follow-ups. The dismissed-approval reopening issue tracked by #17060 is separate.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; consumers continue to receive a valid row index. Approval handling and the auto-open keyboard acknowledgement remain unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Refs #16444, R1-6 only.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

注册表更新导致后台任务列表重排时，自动显示的审批项及显式选中的任务会保持选中。尤其是工作流审批自动打开列表后，其他任务启动或完成不会把选择移到别的任务。从入口 pill 打开列表、键盘导航及显式选择都会记录任务身份。任务移除后，会回退到它在重排后最后显示的位置附近。

## 为什么需要

## 评审测试计划

### 验证方法

| Linux | 127 项 provider、视图 hook、对话框测试及独立真实 provider、hook 夹具通过 |

### 环境

本地夹具：Node.js 24.22.1、Vitest 3.2.7，jsdom、Ink 夹具及注册表回调。无需模型或外部供应商。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：显式选中的任务在行位置变化时仍保持选中，而不是保留固定数字行号。
- 未验证或范围之外：真实模型、终端端到端验证，以及 #16444 的其他后续问题。#17060 跟踪的已关闭审批列表重开问题独立处理。

prs.title: fix(sdk): release settled WebSocket probe deadlines
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Clears the actual WebSocket negotiation deadline when the probe settles. Successful connections and rejected probes now release their timeout immediately; a stalled probe still reaches the same deadline and falls back to the next transport.

## Why it's needed

The negotiation code created two timers but retained only the no-op timer's handle. The timer used by the race remained scheduled after a successful connection or an early rejection. This leaves a Node.js timer alive until the probe deadline, even if a short-lived SDK caller has already disposed its transport.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Negotiate with a daemon advertising WebSocket and ACP HTTP, and let the WebSocket probe succeed immediately. Confirm WebSocket is selected and no probe timer remains.
2. Reject the WebSocket probe before its deadline. Confirm it is disposed, ACP HTTP is selected, and no probe timer remains.
3. Leave the WebSocket probe pending. Confirm negotiation remains pending before the deadline, then disposes the probe and selects ACP HTTP at the deadline.

All 18 focused negotiation tests pass, including the three new success, rejection, and timeout cases. The SDK build, both SDK type-check configurations, ESLint, and formatting checks pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

An independent source-level reproduction calls the public negotiation function while tracking native Node.js timer handles and controlling the WebSocket probe response. The same script was run before and after the fix.

| Observation after successful probe | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Selected transport | acp-ws | acp-ws |
| Outstanding deadline timers | 1 | 0 |

The timing tests separately verify that a stalled probe still falls back at its configured deadline. The native-handle probe measures the retained resource directly; it does not claim an end-to-end process-exit benchmark.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested |

### Environment

Node.js v24.22.1 and Vitest 3.2.7. Source-level SDK reproduction with native timers, plus deterministic deadline tests with fake timers.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: deadline ownership changes, so tests cover both early settlement paths and actual expiry. The configured timeout and fallback order are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: no browser WebSocket integration or process-exit timing benchmark. Full monorepo checks previously exited 137 in this environment; the affected SDK checks passed.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no API changes or migration.

## Linked Issues

Refs #8835, specifically [negotiate-ws-probe-timer-leak](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/8835#issuecomment-6569621892).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

在 WebSocket 协商探测结束时清理真正控制截止时间的计时器。连接成功或探测提前失败时立即释放计时器；探测一直未完成时，仍在原定截止时间回退至下一种传输。

## 为什么需要

原实现创建了两个计时器，却只保留了空回调计时器的句柄。真正参与竞争的计时器在成功连接或提前失败后仍然排队执行。因此，即使短生命周期的 SDK 调用方已释放传输，Node.js 计时器也会一直存活到探测截止时间。

## 审阅者验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 与声明支持 WebSocket 和 ACP HTTP 的服务端协商，让 WebSocket 探测立即成功。确认选择 WebSocket，且没有遗留探测计时器。
2. 让 WebSocket 探测在截止时间前失败。确认释放该传输、选择 ACP HTTP，且没有遗留探测计时器。
3. 让 WebSocket 探测保持未完成。确认截止时间前协商仍未完成，到期时释放探测传输并选择 ACP HTTP。

18 项定向协商测试全部通过，包含新增的成功、失败与超时三种情况。SDK 构建、两套 SDK 类型检查、ESLint 和格式检查均通过。

### 修改前后证据

独立的源码级复现调用公开协商函数，跟踪原生 Node.js 计时器句柄，并控制 WebSocket 探测响应。修改前后使用同一个脚本。

| 探测成功后的观察 | 修改前 | 修改后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 选择的传输 | acp-ws | acp-ws |
| 遗留截止计时器数 | 1 | 0 |

另外的时序测试验证，未完成的探测仍然在配置的截止时间回退。原生句柄探测直接测量遗留资源，没有将它宣称为端到端进程退出性能测试。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境

Node.js v24.22.1、Vitest 3.2.7。源码级 SDK 复现使用原生计时器，确定性的截止时间测试使用模拟计时器。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：变更了截止计时器的持有和释放，因此测试同时覆盖两条提前结束路径以及真正到期的情况。配置的超时时长和回退顺序不变。
- 未验证或范围外：未执行浏览器 WebSocket 集成测试或进程退出耗时基准。此前全仓检查在当前环境以 137 退出；受影响 SDK 的检查通过。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：无 API 变更，无需迁移。

## 关联问题

关联 #8835 中的 [negotiate-ws-probe-timer-leak](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/8835#issuecomment-6569621892) 条目。

prs.title: docs(design): record speculation PR 6b decision to keep its own tool step
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR records the decision for speculation's PR 6b (#17045): speculation keeps its own tool step and its own speculative loop; only its model round runs on the shared loop, as PR 6a (#17029) already landed. It is a bilingual decision record under `docs/design/`, with no code change and no setting. It also records that speculation's unit parity suite is its integration gate.

## Why it's needed

#17045 asks speculation's PR 6b to put the tool step and the run on the shared loop, or record a decision to keep its own. Speculation's tool step is built around running read-only work ahead of the user: it executes tools directly (bypassing `CoreToolScheduler`), writes to a copy-on-write overlay, bails back to the normal flow at a boundary gate, and never records committed tool calls. The shared `runToolBatch` cannot express that without either polluting `packages/core` with speculation-specific behavior or weakening the speculative model. This is the same shape as the Hosted Harness evaluation (#17248): the model round is shared, the specialized tool step stays.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

This is a docs-only decision record. Confirm both language versions exist and are synchronized, and that the cited lines match `main` at `5f5035772b54`: direct execution `speculation.ts:456-517`, permission-deferred bail `:410-414`, overlay redirect `:446-454`, boundary gate `:433-454`, guard denial `:497-509`, finalize-without-record `:605`, and the shared batch's recording `agent-loop.ts:671`. Confirm speculation has no integration scenario today and that its unit parity suite compares the shared round off and on. Formatting: `npx prettier --check docs/design/2026-11-15-speculation-tool-step.md docs/design/2026-11-15-speculation-tool-step.zh-CN.md` passes.

N/A (docs only).

- Not validated / out of scope: any code change; speculation's default flip and legacy removal remain the gated steps of #17045.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.
