prs.title: test(cli): cover the shared batch host inputs on cron and notification turns
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds one integration case per session kind to the automatic-turn suite: a cron turn in a live-tool session, and a background-notification turn in a read-only Agent Host session. Both drive the real shared tool batch and the real scheduler through the automatic route, under both the procedural loop and the event-bus kernel, and assert that the two host inputs reach the scheduler — the live-tool trust and the read-only refusal.

No production code changes.

## Why it's needed

#17218 moved live-tool and read-only Agent Host sessions onto the shared tool batch, and made the automatic turn's batch unconditional along with the prompt's. Every case for those two kinds drove `session.prompt`, though, while the cron and notification cases all ran plain sessions — so on the automatic route neither host input was asserted anywhere.

That gap matters more on this route than on a prompt. A cron or notification turn runs with nobody watching: a host built without the live trust would send a trusted live call into the interactive approval flow, and one built without the refusal would emit a permission prompt instead of refusing. Either way the turn stalls on an answer that never comes, and no gate would go red. This was raised as R1-3 on #17218 and deferred there to keep that diff from growing in its fifth round; this is the follow-up it was deferred to.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Each case must fail if the host stops carrying the field it depends on. I confirmed all three mutations locally:

1. Drop `isTrustedLiveTool` from the batch host → the cron case fails with `expected [ 'capture_screen_context' ] to not include 'capture_screen_context'`: the trusted live call went through `isToolEnabled` instead of running.
2. Drop `readOnlyRefusalMessage` from the batch host → the notification case fails with `expected "spy" to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times`: a `session/request_permission` left a read-only Agent Host session.
3. Set the automatic turn's `sharedToolBatch` back to `false` → both cases fail with `expected "spy" to be called at least once`: the turn ran ACP's own tool step rather than the shared batch.

What the cases assert beyond the mutations: the cron turn's rounds are typed `Cron` then `ToolResult`, the live tool executes over the daemon channel exactly once with zero permission requests, and its response is carried into the next round; the notification turn's rounds are typed `Notification` then `ToolResult`, the approval-needing read never executes, zero permission requests leave the session, and the model-visible result is the refusal text carrying the real tool name.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (test-only; no user-visible change).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit-level only, in a worktree off `main` at `038b60e30`:

- `packages/cli` `Session.test.ts` + `acp-tool-batch.test.ts`: **1549/1549 pass**.
- The two new cases: **2/2 each** (the enclosing suite is a `describe.each([false, true])` kernel matrix).
- The whole `cron and background-notification turns` block: **24/24 pass**.
- ESLint and Prettier clean on the changed file.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none to product behavior — the diff is one test file, +232 lines, no production change. The cases use `mockImplementationOnce` rather than a persistent implementation because that spy is never reset between tests, so a persistent one would leak the real batch into later cases.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows and Linux locally (CI covers them); the full workspace suites and `integration-tests/`, which this diff does not touch. The cases assert the host inputs reach the scheduler, not a full-stack daemon round-trip — the fake daemon `extMethod` boundary is the same one the prompt-route cases use.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17218 (finding R1-3). Part of #17045.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

给自动轮次套件各补一条集成用例：live 工具会话的 cron 轮，以及只读 Agent Host 会话的后台通知轮。两条都在过程式 loop 与 event-bus 内核两种设置下，经自动轮次路径驱动真实的共享工具批与真实调度器，断言两个宿主输入确实到达调度器——live 工具信任与只读拒绝文案。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A（仅测试改动，无用户可见变化）。

### 测试平台

| :--------: | :----: |

| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 环境（可选）

仅单元级，在基于 `main`（`038b60e30`）的 worktree 中：

- `packages/cli` 的 `Session.test.ts` + `acp-tool-batch.test.ts`：**1549/1549 通过**。
- 两条新用例：**各 2/2**（所在套件是 `describe.each([false, true])` 的双内核矩阵）。
- 整个 `cron and background-notification turns` 区块：**24/24 通过**。
- 改动文件的 ESLint 与 Prettier 均干净。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险 / 取舍：对产品行为无风险——diff 只有一个测试文件、+232 行，无生产改动。两条用例用 `mockImplementationOnce` 而非持久实现，因为该 spy 在用例之间从不 reset，持久实现会把真实批泄漏给后续用例。
- 未验证 / 不在范围：本地的 Windows 与 Linux（由 CI 覆盖）；完整工作区套件与 `integration-tests/`，本 diff 未触及。用例断言的是宿主输入到达调度器，而不是全栈 daemon 往返——fake daemon `extMethod` 边界与 prompt 路径的用例一致。

prs.title: fix(sdk): keep the capabilities deadline through body reads
prs.body:
## Current head after the CI base refresh

Current head is `5297e2750a1103005bdde9587b7cdba048a31747`, which merges upstream `8fee98a1` and the landed proxy-environment fixture fixes. All three PR files retain their reviewed `58069518` blobs. In particular, `negotiateTransport.ts` is still `f6d86af0439107f65e346a5a0940db0e05eb62e0`, matching the candidate blob recorded by the runtime report below.

The existing six-scenario native-fetch run and original-source control remain bound to `58069518`. Other upstream daemon files changed in the merge, so the report is evidence for the unchanged fix, not a new execution of the whole dependency tree at `5297e275`. [The new upstream CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43665149929) does not execute that saved real-fetch harness. Maintainer acceptance of the existing report after the refresh, or a fresh targeted runtime run, remains the closeout step.

当前提交为 `5297e275`。三个 PR 文件与已验证的 `58069518` 完全相同；真实 fetch 报告仍对应历史提交，不能视为整个新依赖树已经重跑。新 CI 已触发，closeout 仍需维护者接受既有报告，或在新提交上重新执行定向真实运行。

---

## What this PR does

Keeps the configured capabilities-probe deadline active until the response body has been consumed. A stalled JSON body aborts the probe and selects the REST fallback. A complete response still selects its advertised transport, and the timer is released after success or parsing failure.

## Why it's needed

The SDK previously cleared the deadline as soon as response headers arrived. A daemon or proxy that sent a successful header and only part of the JSON body could therefore keep transport negotiation pending indefinitely, even with a short configured timeout. Integrations could not finish connecting until the connection was closed externally.

## Runtime closeout verification at `58069518`

A fresh run recorded on **2026-11-14 at 15:40 UTC** verifies exact head `58069518e9971bae2c989e1c99bd3e24f18b2221`. The [reproducible runtime report and script](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/tree/5c8524cfa655f1d518790a0139cec8a70d8fda6f/.github/validation/pr17103-runtime-20261114) and [raw event record](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/blob/5c8524cfa655f1d518790a0139cec8a70d8fda6f/.github/validation/pr17103-runtime-20261114/report.json) are pinned to an immutable evidence commit. The source checkout was unchanged during that recorded run; the PR has since received the base refresh described above.

This run imports the actual SDK implementation and real REST/ACP-HTTP transport classes through tsx, connects to a real loopback HTTP server, and forwards requests to native Node fetch. The observing wrapper records headers and abort events without replacing the Response or consuming its body. Six candidate scenarios and one unfixed-source control passed their runtime assertions:

| Scenario | Actual observation |
| --- | --- |
| 100 ms budget; headers arrive but JSON body stays open | Headers at 5.8 ms; abort at 101.2 ms; REST selected at 103.4 ms, before harness cleanup. |
| Default budget; JSON body stays open | Still pending at 4805.7 ms; abort at 5015.5 ms; REST selected at 5042.4 ms. |
| Unfixed source from base `84b5b53f`, same 100 ms stalled-body case | Still pending and not aborted after the 450 ms observation window; only the subsequent forced server disconnect released it to REST. |

Complete and deliberately delayed complete bodies selected the advertised ACP-HTTP transport. Malformed finite JSON and a request whose response headers never arrived selected REST. Success and parse-failure controls remained unaborted after their original deadlines. The raw events distinguish negotiation completion from explicit harness teardown; wall-clock observations include setup and lazy imports and do not assert exact timer scheduling.

The source checkout SHA and production blob were verified before and after the run, with no tracked source changes. This is actual SDK negotiation against controlled HTTP responses, not a daemon/model or WebSocket-handshake run. It adds runtime observations to the separately recorded build/unit-test evidence below.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Serve a complete capabilities JSON response from a loopback HTTP server and negotiate with a 100 ms probe timeout. Confirm that the advertised transport is selected.
2. Send HTTP 200 headers and a partial JSON body, then leave the response open. Confirm that negotiation returns REST without waiting for the server to disconnect.
3. Deliver a complete response just before the deadline and confirm that the selected transport is preserved. Confirm that malformed JSON also falls back without leaving its timeout armed.
4. Omit the timeout option and stall the response body. Confirm that the probe is still active at 4,999 ms and aborts to REST at 5,000 ms.
5. With a 100 ms timeout, accept the request without sending response headers. Confirm that the probe is still active at 99 ms and aborts to REST at 100 ms.

Initial production-fix validation passed all 18 focused transport-negotiation tests. The stalled-body regression failed against the unchanged base (17 passed, 1 failed) and passed with the fix. The SDK workspace build, SDK type checks, focused ESLint, Prettier check and whitespace check also passed.

### Initial hosted validation

The [dedicated validation run](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43367617998) checked out the initial production-fix commit `43a07dcde307751ab76f14cd177c8badcd83a91d` on Linux with Node.js 22.23.4 and pnpm 11.24.0. The SDK and its workspace dependencies build, SDK typecheck, all **64 SDK test files / 2,433 tests**, full monorepo `npm run build`, and full `npm run typecheck` passed. The workflow verifies the checkout SHA before running these commands.

### Earlier timeout-boundary validation

The earlier test-only follow-up made the existing default-timeout and custom-timeout tests assert the actual abort boundary and REST fallback. That revision contained 18 tests. Changing the default to 30 seconds or arming the timer only after fetch resolves each produces exactly one assertion failure; neither failure relies on a test timeout. Each fixture releases its stalled request or body in `finally` and disposes the transport. Production code is unchanged by this follow-up.

The [earlier exact-candidate run](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43409796022) checked out `640a94fa53f690bafea90ec4e7d30dfe542a661a` on Linux with Node.js 22.23.4, pnpm 11.24.0 and the SDK's Vitest 1.6.1. Full monorepo build and typecheck, targeted ESLint and Prettier, both counterfactual assertions, the restored **18/18** focused tests, and the complete **64 SDK files / 2,433 tests** plus the public API type fence all passed. The workflow verifies the exact SHA and that this follow-up changes only the test file.

### Current fixture follow-up validation

The five timeout scenarios now share one file-local fixture for request setup, signal capture, response control and cleanup. Their differences remain explicit: the delayed-completion case leaves body-abort wiring disabled, completes at 99 ms and remains unaborted after a further 100 ms; malformed JSON is closed as a finite body; and the headers-phase case keeps the response promise pending. The original 18 tests remain, with one additional fixture contract that reads the configured first chunk and headers through a real response and verifies that abort rejects a pending body read.

The [exact-candidate validation run](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43425199611) tested `58069518e9971bae2c989e1c99bd3e24f18b2221` on Linux with Node.js 22.23.4, pnpm 11.24.0 and SDK Vitest 1.6.1. Standard full monorepo build and typecheck, the public API type fence, targeted ESLint and Prettier, the complete **64 SDK files / 2,434 tests**, and **19/19 focused tests** passed. Both test runs had no skipped tests.

The four counterfactual checks produced the expected assertion failures:

- Removing the fixture's abort listener failed its one selected contract test; the other 18 tests were filtered out.
- Changing the default timeout to 30 seconds failed the default-boundary test: 18 passed, 1 failed.
- Starting the timer only after headers arrived failed the headers-phase boundary test: 18 passed, 1 failed.
- Removing deadline cleanup failed the delayed-completion and malformed-JSON cases: 17 passed, 2 failed.

These failures came from assertions, not test timeouts. The source and test files were restored byte-for-byte, the focused suite passed **19/19** again, and the checkout had no tracked changes. This follow-up changes only the test fixture and its coverage; production code is unchanged.

The [earlier upstream CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43426964517) failed in the two shared proxy-environment fixtures. Those fixes are included in the base refresh; [CI for the new head](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43665149929) is separate from this historical runtime report.

### Evidence (Before & After)

An independent source-level SDK reproduction used the same real loopback HTTP server and native Node fetch before and after, with a 100 ms probe timeout and a separate 450 ms observation window:

| Response | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Complete JSON body | REST | REST |
| Partial body kept open | Still pending after 450 ms | REST before the observation window ends |
| Server disconnected afterward | REST | Already settled |

The automated tests additionally verify that a complete delayed response advertising ACP HTTP selects ACP HTTP and does not later receive a stray abort.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested |

### Environment

Local environment (original report): Node.js v24.22.1, pnpm 11.24.0 and Vitest 3.2.7. Hosted validation: Node.js v22.23.4, pnpm 11.24.0 and the SDK package's Vitest 1.6.1. The real HTTP reproduction invokes the public SDK implementation directly; no provider credentials or live model are required.

### Fetch implementation requirement

The deadline relies on the configured fetch honoring AbortSignal for both the request and response-body consumption. This is provided by the default fetch; injected fetch implementations must preserve that behavior.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a capabilities body that finishes after the configured deadline now falls back to REST, matching the intended probe budget. Custom fetch implementations must honor the supplied abort signal.
- Validation scope: the hosted Linux run now includes the complete SDK suite and full monorepo build/typecheck. macOS and Windows remain outside this validation. WebSocket-handshake timer ownership is a separate finding in #8835.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no API shape changes or migration.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17053.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

让能力探测的配置超时一直覆盖到响应正文读取完成。JSON 正文停滞时，探测会中止并选择 REST 回退；完整响应仍会选择其声明的传输方式，成功或解析失败后都会释放计时器。

## 为什么需要

SDK 之前在收到响应头后就清除了超时计时器。如果 daemon 或代理发出成功响应头后只发送部分 JSON 正文，即使配置了很短的超时，传输协商也可能一直等待。集成方必须等到外部关闭连接后才能完成连接流程。

## 历史提交 `58069518` 的实际运行核验

**2026-11-14 15:40 UTC** 的新运行验证了精确提交 `58069518e9971bae2c989e1c99bd3e24f18b2221`。可复跑脚本、完整报告和基线源码保存在[不可变证据提交](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/tree/5c8524cfa655f1d518790a0139cec8a70d8fda6f/.github/validation/pr17103-runtime-20261114)，逐事件时间记录见[原始 JSON](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/blob/5c8524cfa655f1d518790a0139cec8a70d8fda6f/.github/validation/pr17103-runtime-20261114/report.json)；该次运行期间源码保持不变。本 PR 此后已合入下述上游基线更新。

运行直接装载实际 SDK 实现及真实 REST/ACP-HTTP transport，通过真实回环 HTTP 服务和 Node 原生 fetch 观察行为。记录包装仅转发请求并记录响应头、AbortSignal，不替换或预先消费响应。六个候选场景及一个未修源码对照的运行断言全部通过：100 ms 预算下，响应头在 5.8 ms 到达，正文保持打开，101.2 ms 中止并在 103.4 ms 回退 REST，先于夹具清理；默认预算在 4805.7 ms 仍等待，5015.5 ms 中止，5042.4 ms 回退。相同 100 ms 情况的未修基线在 450 ms 观察窗口结束后仍未中止、未返回，直到随后主动断开服务端连接才回退。

完整及延迟完整正文选择 ACP HTTP；无效有限 JSON 与不发送响应头的情况回退 REST。成功和解析失败的控制越过原截止时间后没有迟来的中止。运行前后均校验了 head、源码 blob 和 tracked diff。此报告覆盖实际 SDK 协商与受控 HTTP 响应，不代表 daemon/model、WebSocket 握手或新的全仓构建；真实时钟读数包含初始化和懒加载开销。

## 审阅者验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 使用本地回环 HTTP 服务返回完整的能力 JSON，并将探测超时设为 100 ms。确认能够选择响应声明的传输方式。
2. 发送 HTTP 200 响应头及部分 JSON 正文，保持连接打开。确认协商会返回 REST，无须等待服务端断开连接。
3. 在截止时间前返回完整正文，确认保留选定的传输方式；同时确认无效 JSON 会回退且不会留下仍然生效的超时计时器。
4. 不指定超时选项并让响应正文停滞，确认探测在 4,999 ms 时仍未中止，在 5,000 ms 时中止并返回 REST。
5. 配置 100 ms 超时，接收请求但一直不发送响应头，确认探测在 99 ms 时仍未中止，在 100 ms 时中止并返回 REST。

初始生产修复的定向传输协商测试 18 项全部通过。正文停滞回归测试在未修改的基线上失败（17 项通过、1 项失败），应用修复后通过。SDK 工作区构建、SDK 类型检查、定向 ESLint、Prettier 格式检查及空白检查也均通过。

### 初始托管验证

[独立验证运行](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43367617998)在 Linux、Node.js 22.23.4 和 pnpm 11.24.0 上检出初始生产修复提交 `43a07dcde307751ab76f14cd177c8badcd83a91d`。SDK 及其工作区依赖构建、SDK 类型检查、**64 个 SDK 测试文件 / 2,433 项测试**、完整仓库 `npm run build` 和 `npm run typecheck` 均通过。工作流在执行命令前校验了检出的提交 SHA。

### 此前的超时边界验证

此前的测试补强让已有的默认超时和自定义超时用例断言实际中止边界及 REST 回退；该版本共 18 项测试。把默认值改为 30 秒，或把计时器移到 fetch 返回之后启动，都会各自触发一个明确的断言失败，并非依靠测试自身超时。每个 fixture 都会在 `finally` 中结束停滞的请求或正文，并释放传输实例。本次补强未修改生产代码。

[此前的准确候选验证](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43409796022)在 Linux、Node.js 22.23.4、pnpm 11.24.0 和 SDK 的 Vitest 1.6.1 上检出 `640a94fa53f690bafea90ec4e7d30dfe542a661a`。全仓构建与类型检查、定向 ESLint 和 Prettier、两项反向断言、恢复后的 **18/18** 定向测试，以及完整 **64 个 SDK 测试文件 / 2,433 项测试**和公开 API 类型约束全部通过。工作流校验了准确 SHA，并确认本次补强只改动测试文件。

### 提交 `58069518` 的 fixture 整理验证

五个超时场景现在共用一个文件内 fixture，统一请求设置、信号捕获、响应控制及清理，同时明确保留场景差异：延迟完成用例关闭正文的中止联动，在 99 ms 时完成，再推进 100 ms 后信号仍未中止；无效 JSON 被关闭为有限正文；响应头阶段的用例则保持响应 promise 未完成。原有 18 项测试全部保留，另加一项 fixture 行为约束，通过真实响应读取配置的首个数据块和响应头，并验证中止会使等待中的正文读取被拒绝。

[准确候选验证运行](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43425199611)在 Linux、Node.js 22.23.4、pnpm 11.24.0 和 SDK 的 Vitest 1.6.1 上验证了 `58069518e9971bae2c989e1c99bd3e24f18b2221`。标准全仓构建与类型检查、公开 API 类型约束、定向 ESLint 和 Prettier、完整 **64 个 SDK 测试文件 / 2,434 项测试**及 **19/19** 定向测试全部通过；两组测试均无跳过项。

四项反向检查产生了预期的断言失败：

- 删除 fixture 的中止监听后，唯一被选中的行为测试失败，其余 18 项因筛选而未执行。
- 将默认超时改为 30 秒后，默认边界用例失败：18 项通过、1 项失败。

这些失败均来自断言，而非测试自身超时。源码与测试文件随后逐字恢复，定向测试再次 **19/19** 通过，检出目录无已跟踪文件改动。本次后续修改只整理测试 fixture 及其覆盖，未修改生产代码。

该历史提交的[上游 CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43426964517)失败于两项共用代理环境测试；上游已修复这两项 fixture，本次基线更新已带入修复。[新提交的 CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43665149929)与以上历史运行报告分开记录。

| 部分正文且保持连接打开 | 450 ms 后仍等待 | 观察窗口结束前返回 REST |
| 随后关闭服务端连接 | REST | 已经结束 |

自动化测试还验证了：延迟但完整的 ACP HTTP 能力响应仍选择 ACP HTTP，之后不会收到遗留计时器触发的中止。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): read inherited extension configuration at its committed state
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the committed-state contract for Managed Session resources agree with what the publisher actually writes, and lets the child result relay see a child that failed before it ever acquired a Runtime.

Pinning a child agent to an installed extension package copies the parent's active extension configuration into the child Session — the configuration bundle, every contributions manifest, and every part. That publication writes the `PUBLISHED` state and reuses the parent's resource ids. Which kinds may rest at `PUBLISHED`, and how many bytes that verdict covers for each, is now decided in one place: the publisher's kind gate, the journal transaction reader, the extension record reader and the owner read all consult the same predicate. The record reader keeps only a coarse SQL filter and leaves the verdict to that shared predicate, because the kind column is `VARBINARY` and a whitelist restated in SQL is a second copy waiting to drift from the first.

The relay's binding step now reads the child's Turn when no Runtime binding is visible. A proven pre-admission terminal failure settles through the ordinary give-up chain carrying the child's own error code, instead of retrying the binding forever. A live Turn, and a child with no Turn yet, keep waiting exactly as before.

## Why it's needed

Fixes #17261. A content-only (`external-files`) suite turn that delegates to a packaged child agent launched successfully and then produced no output at all until the parent Turn hit its deadline, ending as `hosted_turn_deadline_exceeded`. The launch itself was durable — the child run, its tool definition and input, and the approval continuation all committed — and nothing followed them: no child message, no tool result, no usage record, with the public event stream stopping at `turn.started`. A turn in the same Session invoking only the in-process `skill` tool completed normally, so the regression was confined to the child-agent lane.

Two defects compounded.

First, every reader of a committed resource only admitted `PUBLISHED` as a terminal state for the two Agent-definition kinds (#17207), while the per-kind byte table returns zero for the extension-package kinds. The child's very first read of its own inherited bundle was therefore answered as a corrupt resource. Because the inheritance reuses the source resource id, a second create or load verified the row that was already there and failed the same way, so no retry could self-heal either.

Second, that read runs before the child acquires a Runtime, so the child never binds. The coordinator does settle such a Turn as an undispatched terminal failure, but the relay's binding step threw a retry for as long as no binding existed, and the watching step — the only one that reads the child's Turn — is unreachable from there. A decided failure stayed invisible behind hours of backoff while the parent's own 30-minute deadline expired first. That is why the symptom was a silent hang rather than a diagnosable error.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. On a content-only topology, have an expert suite delegate a turn to a child agent pinned from an installed extension package (no shell). Expect the child to produce output and complete within the deadline; the parent turn should no longer end as `hosted_turn_deadline_exceeded`.
2. Launch the same child twice in a row, so the second launch meets the inherited resource rows that already exist. Expect the second launch to succeed as well, with no corrupt-resource error.
3. Force the child's Session load to fail before it acquires a Runtime. Expect the parent to receive a diagnosable failure before its deadline, with the child's real error code on the relay row's `last_error`, rather than retries continuing until the parent times out.
4. Regression surface: turns invoking only the in-process `skill` tool, ordinary snapshot children, and tool-result resource reads and collection should all behave exactly as before.

Local verification (commands and results, run from `packages/managed-agent-server` on JDK 21):

```
mvn -o -Pmysql-integration -Dmysql.integration.forks=1 \
  -Dmysql.url='jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:33061/managed_agent_test?createDatabaseIfNotExist=true&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false' \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=runtime-broker \
  -Dit.test='ManagedInheritedExtensionConfigurationMySqlIT,ManagedPublishedAgentConfigurationMySqlIT,ManagedExtensionConfigurationMySqlIT,ManagedExtensionCreationMySqlIT,SessionResourceCollectionMySqlIT,ChildResultRelayLockMySqlIT,ManagedNativeJournalSnapshotsMySqlIT' \
  -Dtest='ManagedInheritedExtensionConfigurationTest,ManagedPublishedAgentConfigurationTest,ChildResultRelayTest,ManagedStoreDecompositionTest' \
  -DfailIfNoTests=false verify checkstyle:check
```

`BUILD SUCCESS` — H2 unit tests **132/132**, real MySQL integration tests **129/129**, Checkstyle clean across all 43 modules. A separate test-report comment below carries the per-class breakdown, the sentinel evidence, and the explicit list of gates left to CI.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for screenshots: this is a control-plane and persistence change with no UI surface, so there is no screen to capture. The behavioral evidence is the event stream and the failure code.

- Before: the public event stream stops at `turn.started` — no output delta, no tool call, no completion — and the parent turn ends as `hosted_turn_deadline_exceeded`. The child's inherited-bundle read is answered `managed_session_resource_corrupt` (HTTP 500).
- After: the inherited bundle, manifests and parts read back as bytes through all three readers, so the child runs and completes. Where a child genuinely fails before dispatch, the parent is told `creation_failed` with the child's own error code well before its deadline.

Both halves are pinned by sentinels that were empirically checked rather than assumed: removing the whitelist arm reproduces the original `Missing committed MCP resource.` failure on H2 and on MySQL, and removing the relay guard turns exactly the two new settlement cases red while the other 118 stay green. Both were restored and re-verified green afterwards.

Real end-to-end acceptance on a hosted environment — a content-only suite child completing against a real Runtime and an installed extension package — is **not** part of this local verification and is left to the Hosted profiles in CI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21 (`openjdk@21` 21.0.12.1), Maven 3.10.0. Real MySQL **8.4.11** as a task-owned disposable instance (its own datadir and socket, port 33061, no Docker, no existing service touched), configured to match the CI `mysql-integration` leg and verified live: `max_allowed_packet=134217728`, `innodb_use_native_aio=0`, `log_bin=0`. The database was recreated empty before each run.

To keep the result free of unrelated concurrent work on the same machine, verification ran in a dedicated git worktree containing only this change, with Core and CLI JavaScript rebuilt inside it — a stale `dist` in another checkout makes the native-media cases fail with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for reasons unrelated to this PR. The integration tests were confirmed to really use MySQL rather than silently falling back to H2: the driver is `com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver`, and the run created 47 tables with real rows in `ma_resource`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this widens which rows a committed-resource read accepts, so the boundary matters more than the happy path. The exemption stays bounded by kind, schema version and each kind's own byte ceiling, and empty bytes remain legal only for the kind whose publisher may write them. Every other kind, storage mode and integrity predicate is unchanged, and the negative arms prove that rather than assert it — including that the tool-result kinds keep their own separate `PUBLISHED` allowance. Consolidating the whitelist into one predicate is what keeps the SQL reader, the transaction reader and the owner read from drifting apart again; the record reader's SQL deliberately no longer restates it.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full `mvn verify` and SpotBugs gates, the complete `mysql-integration` profile (103 IT classes; only the 7 affected ones ran locally), the `hosted-harness-mysql` and Hosted/fault profiles, and real end-to-end acceptance of a content-only child on a hosted environment. Acceptance stays pending until the required CI gates pass on this revision. The parent's own unbounded foreground wait on a child result is left as it is — this PR removes the reason it could never be answered, rather than adding a timeout.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No HTTP route or request/response shape changes, no schema change (the baseline migration is untouched), and no update needed to the surface registry or the API contract tests. The two new public members in the contracts module are an internal persistence predicate shared between the publisher and its readers; they are not part of the external API surface.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17261

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让 Managed Session 资源的「已提交状态」契约与发布器实际写入的状态保持一致，并让子结果中继能够看见在获取 Runtime 之前就失败的子 agent。

把子 agent 固定到已安装的扩展包时，会把父 session 当前生效的扩展配置复制进子 session —— 配置 bundle、每个 contributions manifest，以及每个分片。该发布动作写入的是 `PUBLISHED` 状态，并复用父侧的资源 id。现在，「哪些 kind 可以停留在 `PUBLISHED`、这个判定对每种 kind 覆盖多少字节」由一处决定：发布器的 kind 门、journal 事务读取器、扩展记录读取器和所有者读取器都查询同一个谓词。记录读取器只保留粗粒度 SQL 过滤，把判定交给这个共享谓词，因为 kind 列是 `VARBINARY`，在 SQL 里重述一遍白名单就是等着与第一份产生漂移的第二份副本。

中继的绑定步骤现在在看不见运行时绑定时会先读一次子 Turn。已证实的「派发前终态失败」会通过既有的放弃链结算，并带上子侧自己的错误码，而不是无限重试绑定。活跃的 Turn、以及还没有 Turn 的子 agent，仍然完全按原样等待。

## 为什么需要

修复 #17261。content-only（`external-files`）专家套件把一轮对话委派给打包的子 agent 时，子 agent 成功启动，但直到父 Turn 撞上 deadline 都不产出任何输出，最终以 `hosted_turn_deadline_exceeded` 收场。启动本身是持久的 —— 子 run、它的工具定义与输入、审批续跑都已提交 —— 而此后什么都没有：没有子消息、没有工具结果、没有用量记录，公开事件流停在 `turn.started`。同一 session 里只调用进程内 `skill` 工具的轮次一切正常，所以问题只出现在子 agent 这条通道上。

两个缺陷叠加。

第一，所有读取已提交资源的路径都只对两种 agent 定义 kind 承认 `PUBLISHED` 是终态（#17207），而按 kind 取字节上限的那张表对扩展包 kind 返回零。于是子 agent 读取自己那份继承 bundle 的第一个请求就被判为资源损坏。又因为继承复用源资源 id，第二次创建或加载会去校验已经存在的那一行，同样失败，所以连重试都无法自愈。

第二，那次读取发生在子 agent 获取 Runtime 之前，所以子 agent 根本不会产生绑定。协调器确实会把这样的 Turn 判为未派发的终态失败，但中继的绑定步骤只要绑定不存在就抛重试，而唯一会去读子 Turn 的观察步骤从那里根本到不了。一个已经有结论的失败因此被藏在数小时的退避之后，而父侧自己的 30 分钟 deadline 先到期。这就是为什么症状是静默挂死，而不是一个可诊断的错误。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在 content-only 拓扑下，让专家套件把一轮委派给从已安装扩展包固定的子 agent（无 shell）。预期子 agent 在 deadline 内产出并完成；父轮不再以 `hosted_turn_deadline_exceeded` 结束。
2. 连续启动同一个子 agent 两次，让第二次启动遇到已经存在的继承资源行。预期第二次同样成功，不出现资源损坏类错误。
3. 强制让子 session 的 Session 加载在获取 Runtime 之前失败。预期父侧在自己的 deadline 之前收到可诊断的失败，中继行的 `last_error` 带上子侧真实错误码，而不是持续重试到父超时。
4. 回归面：只调用进程内 `skill` 工具的轮次、普通 snapshot 子 agent、以及工具结果类资源的读取与回收，行为都应完全不变。

本地验证（命令与结果，在 `packages/managed-agent-server` 下用 JDK 21 运行）：

```
mvn -o -Pmysql-integration -Dmysql.integration.forks=1 \
  -Dmysql.url='jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:33061/managed_agent_test?createDatabaseIfNotExist=true&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false' \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=runtime-broker \
  -Dit.test='ManagedInheritedExtensionConfigurationMySqlIT,ManagedPublishedAgentConfigurationMySqlIT,ManagedExtensionConfigurationMySqlIT,ManagedExtensionCreationMySqlIT,SessionResourceCollectionMySqlIT,ChildResultRelayLockMySqlIT,ManagedNativeJournalSnapshotsMySqlIT' \
  -Dtest='ManagedInheritedExtensionConfigurationTest,ManagedPublishedAgentConfigurationTest,ChildResultRelayTest,ManagedStoreDecompositionTest' \
  -DfailIfNoTests=false verify checkstyle:check
```

`BUILD SUCCESS` —— H2 单测 **132/132**，真实 MySQL 集成测试 **129/129**，43 个模块 Checkstyle 全部干净。下方单独的测试报告评论给出按测试类的明细、哨兵证据，以及明确留给 CI 的门禁清单。

### 证据（Before & After）

截图不适用：这是控制面与持久层改动，没有 UI 面，因此没有可截取的界面。行为层面的证据是事件流与失败码。

- Before：公开事件流停在 `turn.started` —— 没有输出增量、没有工具调用、没有完成事件 —— 父轮以 `hosted_turn_deadline_exceeded` 结束。子侧读取继承 bundle 被回以 `managed_session_resource_corrupt`（HTTP 500）。
- After：继承的 bundle、manifest 与分片都能通过三个读取器读回字节，子 agent 因此正常运行并完成。若子 agent 确实在派发前失败，父侧会在自己的 deadline 之前很久就被告知 `creation_failed`，并带上子侧自己的错误码。

两半修复都由经过实证检验（而非仅凭断言）的哨兵钉住：移除白名单臂会在 H2 与 MySQL 上复现原始的 `Missing committed MCP resource.` 失败；移除中继守卫会精确让两条新增结算用例转红，其余 118 条保持绿。两处随后均已还原并复跑全绿。

真实托管环境上的端到端验收 —— content-only 套件子 agent 对着真实 Runtime 与已安装扩展包跑通 —— **不属于**本次本地验证，留给 CI 的 Hosted profiles。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 环境（可选）

JDK 21（`openjdk@21` 21.0.12.1）、Maven 3.10.0。真实 MySQL **8.4.11**，任务专属的一次性实例（独立 datadir 与 socket，端口 33061，未使用 Docker，未触碰任何既有服务），配置与 CI 的 `mysql-integration` 分支对齐并已实测确认：`max_allowed_packet=134217728`、`innodb_use_native_aio=0`、`log_bin=0`。每轮运行前都重建空库。

为了让结论不受同机上无关的并发工作干扰，验证在一个只含本次改动的专用 git worktree 中进行，并在其中重新构建 Core 与 CLI 的 JavaScript 产物 —— 另一个 checkout 里陈旧的 `dist` 会让 native media 类用例因 `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` 失败，原因与本 PR 无关。已确认集成测试真的落在 MySQL 上而非静默回落 H2：驱动为 `com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver`，运行中实际建了 47 张表并在 `ma_resource` 落了真实行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：本次放宽的是「读取已提交资源时接受哪些行」，所以边界比正常路径更重要。豁免仍严格按 kind、schema 版本和每种 kind 自己的字节上界收紧，空字节只对发布器确实可能写入空内容的那种 kind 合法。其他所有 kind、存储模式与完整性谓词均未改变，负向臂对此是证明而非断言 —— 包括工具结果类 kind 仍保留它们各自独立的 `PUBLISHED` 允许范围。把白名单收敛到单一谓词，正是让 SQL 读取器、事务读取器与所有者读取器不会再次彼此漂移的做法；记录读取器的 SQL 已刻意不再重述它。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：全量 `mvn verify` 与 SpotBugs 门禁、完整 `mysql-integration` profile（共 103 个 IT 类，本地只跑了受影响的 7 个）、`hosted-harness-mysql` 与 Hosted/fault profiles，以及 content-only 子 agent 在真实托管环境上的端到端验收。在所需 CI 门禁于本 revision 上通过之前，验收状态为 pending。父侧前台等待子结果本身没有上界这一点保持原样 —— 本 PR 移除的是它永远得不到答复的原因，而不是加一个超时。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。没有 HTTP 路由或请求/响应形状变更，没有 schema 变更（基线迁移文件未改），surface registry 与 API 契约测试也无需更新。契约模块新增的两个 public 成员是发布器与其读取器之间共享的内部持久层判定，不属于对外 API 面。

## 关联 Issue

prs.title: test(managed-runtime): derive the fence-compaction epoch count from the journal entry size
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the `FileManagedSessionInbox` fence-compaction test derive its epoch count from one measured journal entry instead of looping a fixed 1024 times, and adds a mid-loop checkpoint that witnesses the second journal compaction. Each epoch is one `fsync`'d journal append (`appendFile(..., { flush: true })`); the loop's only job is to push the journal past the 64 KiB compaction threshold. The derivation is sized to cross the threshold twice (`2 × threshold × 1.25 / entryBytes`, floored at 64), and the checkpoint pins that a second compaction actually rewrote the snapshot: at 60% of the loop line 0 must already be the first compaction's snapshot, and the final line 0 must differ from it.

## Why it's needed

On a fast disk 1024 appends finish in ~5s; on the fleet's container storage a single fsync costs tens of milliseconds, so the loop alone outlasted the flat 60s budget — run 42997545207 failed three attempts with pure timeouts (`Test timed out in 60000ms`), no assertion ever ran. The failing head (`eaa870e7`) predates the host-aware budget entirely — the test passed a literal `}, 60_000);` with no `isSlowTestHost` import, so there was no doubled ceiling that could have applied (the slow-host floor landed later). A fixed epoch count also over-shoots: the loop only needs to cross the compaction boundary, and a first-crossing-only count would leave the "compact again once a snapshot exists" branch without its only witness in this package (review finding on the first version of this change).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/managed-session-inbox.test.ts` — the changed test ends with an `inbox.snapshot` header, lands under the compaction size bound, rejects the fence one epoch behind the last as stale, finishes on the last fence, and the final snapshot line differs from the 60%-checkpoint line (the second-compaction witness). For the witness property: make `compactIfNeeded()` a no-op once a snapshot exists — the checkpoint assertion goes red.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅    |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the derived loop performs ~2× the threshold in durable appends to keep the second-compaction witness (133 fsync'd appends and a 1.69s median on the final head, vs the base's 1027 appends / 8.00s); a single-crossing derivation would be faster but would drop that coverage.
- Not validated / out of scope: the loaded-runner scheduling itself was not reproduced locally; the CI failure's timing is taken from run 42997545207's logs.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.
- Design documents: N/A.

## Linked Issues

Closes #16937

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

本 PR 将 FileManagedSessionInbox 的 fence 压缩测试从固定 1024 次循环改为按实测日志条目大小推导 epoch 数（按跨过 64 KiB 压缩阈值两次定容，下限 64），并加中途检查点见证第二次压缩：循环 60% 处第 0 行必须已是首次压缩的快照，终态第 0 行必须与之不同——该差异只能来自第二次压缩重写快照。

动机：快盘上 1024 次追加约 5 秒，但机群容器盘单次 fsync 数十毫秒，循环本身就超了 60 秒平顶预算（run 42997545207 三次纯超时、无断言执行）；且包测试运行在不透传 RUNNER_NAME 的工作流容器里，慢机双倍预算从未生效。固定次数还会过度射击——只需跨过压缩边界，且仅跨一次会令"快照已存在时再次压缩"分支失去全包唯一见证（首版改动的评审发现）。

验证：16/16；检查点断言在把 compactIfNeeded 改为快照后空操作的变异下变红。风险面：仅测试文件；为保第二次压缩见证保留了约两倍阈值的追加量（本地约 3.1 秒 vs 基线中位约 5.9 秒）。关闭 #16937。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): retain buffered shell output after process exit
prs.body:
## Current head and runtime closeout

Current head: `3722827552adfab1499a68283c54cb3dd56da637`. This merges upstream `8fee98a1`, including the already-landed proxy-environment fixture fixes, into the reviewed `11ce55a1` head. The three PR files — the shell execution service, its tests, and the shell documentation — retain exactly the same Git blobs as `11ce55a1`. The original PR patch was also checked against the refreshed base with exact-context application.

The [maintainer's runtime verification on `11ce55a1`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17112#issuecomment-6877797574) reports **27/27 scripted assertions**, **190/190 shell tests**, and **1,483 downstream tests** passing. Its real Linux subprocess A/B probe measured zero empty outputs in 400 concurrent head calls, retained the post-exit write and split UTF-8 character, checked the 200 ms / 1000 ms bounds, and exercised cancellation and exit-status controls. All six targeted mutations were detected. The report also includes [runtime evidence images](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/assets/pr17112-validation/pr17112/01-real-process-ab.png).

That is an existing, attributed runtime report for the unchanged PR source files; it is not a new runtime execution at `37228275`. [CI for the refreshed head](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43665434382) is running. Maintainer acceptance of the existing runtime evidence after this base refresh remains the closeout decision.

---

## What this PR does

Keeps collecting buffered non-PTY shell output until the child closes its output pipes. Process exit is recorded immediately, but the result is settled on close or a bounded drain timeout. Foreground buffered commands use a 200 ms post-exit bound; streaming and managed raw-capture callers retain their existing 1000 ms bound. Background promotion also detaches the service's stdout/stderr end listeners while preserving listeners installed by the caller.

## Why it's needed

A child can exit before Node delivers its final stdout and stderr data events. The buffered path previously resolved on exit and removed its data listeners, so a successful command could return empty or incomplete output. This is observable with concurrent short-lived commands, without a model, terminal emulator, or background child.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run short commands through the non-PTY buffered execution path, first serially and then with eight concurrent calls. Every successful command should retain its output.
2. Deliver an exit event before the final stdout and stderr chunks, including a UTF-8 character split across chunks. The result should wait for close and contain the complete decoded output exactly once. With fake timers, emitting close must settle the result without advancing the clock.
3. Let a descendant retain stdout or stderr after its parent exits. Buffered calls should settle at the 200 ms bound; the existing streaming bound should remain 1000 ms. A held stderr alone must not set the held-stdout flag.
4. Check cancellation, a signal exit, and a nonzero exit code. Their status information and captured output should still reach the caller.
5. Promote a running buffered command to the background. Only the caller's stdout/stderr end listeners should remain, and they should still receive the end events.

All 188 shell execution tests pass on follow-up `44dd7567`. The original three drain regressions fail against the unchanged base. Core workspace build and typecheck, targeted ESLint, Prettier, and `git diff --check` pass. The core build/typecheck used a 4 GiB Node heap; the environment's default 2 GiB heap was insufficient for the initial build attempt.

### Evidence (Before & After)

An independent reproduction calls the real execution service and spawns real Linux processes, without mocking process events.

| Check | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 400 `date` calls, eight at a time | 27 successful exits returned empty output | Zero empty outputs or errors |
| 40 serial calls and 40 delayed-output controls | Zero empty outputs | Zero empty outputs |
| Parent exits while a descendant writes after 50 ms | Returned early and lost the later write | Retained the later write and returned when the pipe closed |
| Descendant holds a buffered stdout pipe | Returned immediately without a drain | Returned in about 204 ms with held-stdout metadata |
| Descendant holds only buffered stderr | Returned immediately without a drain | Returned in about 206 ms without the held-stdout flag |

Six additional real-process controls passed: buffered and streaming versions of SIGTERM termination, AbortController cancellation, and an exit code of 7. Streaming inherited-pipe controls retained their roughly one-second bound. These timings describe the reproduction environment, not a throughput benchmark; the original loss is a scheduling race.

### Review follow-up (S1 / S2)

The existing close regression now uses fake timers and checks settlement after close without advancing time. The correct previous head passes this assertion; temporarily removing the close handler's settlement call makes that assertion fail immediately with zero settlement callbacks, so the drain timeout cannot hide the missing close path.

The promotion regression now preserves external end listeners while checking that the service's listeners are removed. With the strengthened tests on previous head `518a3444`, 187 tests passed and this ownership assertion failed because an anonymous end listener remained. After naming and detaching the two service end listeners, all 188 tests pass. The mutation used to verify S1 is not part of the submitted code.

### Latest review follow-up

Follow-up `11ce55a1` clarifies that the held-stdout flag belongs to the execution service and is not exposed by the shell tool. Both comments now name the 200 ms buffered and 1000 ms streaming/raw-capture bounds. The fallback tests reuse the existing finish helper, and two new fake-clock cases assert no settlement at 999 ms and settlement at 1000 ms for streaming and a no-op raw-capture sink. Temporarily forcing the mode selector to 200 ms makes both 999 ms assertions fail. Production behavior is unchanged by this follow-up.

All **190/190** shell execution tests pass locally. [Hosted validation of exact commit `11ce55a1`](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43396539767/job/131788715575) passes the standard full-workspace build and typecheck and the same 190 tests with retries disabled. This is fork validation; upstream workflow approval remains a maintainer action. Targeted lint, formatting and diff checks also pass.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| macOS | Not run |
| Windows | Not run |
| Linux | Real-process reproduction and focused checks passed |

### Environment

Local Node.js 24.22.1; hosted Node.js 22.23.4. Vitest 3.2.7, pnpm 11.24.0 with frozen dependencies, Linux child_process execution. PTY behavior is unchanged.

## Risk & Scope

- Main tradeoff: a foreground command whose descendant holds a pipe can now wait up to 200 ms after the parent exits. Ordinary commands finish as soon as their pipes close. Output arriving after that bound is still outside the result. This proposes the shorter foreground bound discussed in the issue while preserving the established streaming/raw-capture bound.
- Downstream callers checked: foreground and managed shell tools, sandbox execution and its Landlock probe, commit-analysis Git commands, the autofix runner, prompt shell expansion, Ink/OpenTUI shell mode, and the sandbox CLI. They retain the same result shape, exit status, and cancellation contract; buffered callers receive later output before settlement. PTY-only resize/input consumers are unaffected.
- Not validated / out of scope: live Windows/macOS execution and a full interactive TUI session. Earlier local full-monorepo build/typecheck attempts exited 137; the latest exact-commit hosted full build/typecheck passed. No new background-process tracking or process-group probing is introduced.
- Breaking changes / migration: no public signature or wire-format changes. The existing optional held-stdout metadata can now also describe a buffered result.

## Linked Issues

Refs #17093.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

非 PTY 的缓冲式 shell 执行会继续收集输出，直到子进程的输出管道关闭。进程退出时立即记录状态，但在管道关闭或排空等待到期时才返回结果。前台缓冲调用采用退出后 200 ms 的上限；流式输出和托管原始输出捕获继续使用已有的 1000 ms 上限。提升到后台时，也会移除服务自身的 stdout/stderr end 监听，同时保留调用方安装的监听。

## 为什么需要

子进程退出可能早于 Node 派发最后的 stdout、stderr 数据事件。此前缓冲路径在退出事件中立即返回并移除数据监听器，导致成功命令返回空内容或不完整内容。并发执行短命令即可观察到该问题，不需要模型、终端模拟器或后台子进程。

## 审阅者验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 通过非 PTY 缓冲执行路径运行短命令，先串行，再按八路并发运行。每次成功执行都应保留输出。
2. 先发送退出事件，再发送 stdout 和 stderr 的最后数据块，包括跨数据块的 UTF-8 字符。结果应等待管道关闭，并且只输出一次完整解码内容。使用假时钟时，发送 close 后不推进时间，结果也必须已经结算。
3. 让后代进程在父进程退出后继续持有 stdout 或 stderr。缓冲调用应在 200 ms 上限返回；流式调用仍保持 1000 ms 上限。仅 stderr 被持有时不得误报 stdout 被持有。
4. 验证取消、信号退出和非零退出码，确认状态及已捕获输出仍正确返回。
5. 将运行中的缓冲命令提升到后台。stdout/stderr 上应只保留调用方的 end 监听，并且仍能接收 end 事件。

后续提交 `44dd7567` 的 188 项 shell 执行测试全部通过；原始三项排空回归在未改动的基线上失败。Core 工作区构建和类型检查、定向 ESLint、Prettier 及 `git diff --check` 均通过。Core 构建和类型检查使用 4 GiB Node 堆；环境默认的 2 GiB 堆不足以完成首次构建。

### 修改前后证据

独立复现直接调用真实执行服务并启动真实 Linux 进程，没有模拟进程事件。

| 检查 | 修改前 | 修改后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 400 次 date 调用，八路并发 | 27 次成功退出却返回空输出 | 空输出和错误均为零 |
| 40 次串行调用及 40 次延迟输出对照 | 空输出为零 | 空输出为零 |
| 父进程退出后，后代进程等待 50 ms 写入 | 提前返回，丢失稍后的输出 | 保留稍后的输出，管道关闭后返回 |
| 后代进程保持缓冲调用的 stdout 打开 | 立即返回，未等待排空 | 约 204 ms 返回，并携带 stdout 被持有标记 |
| 后代进程仅保持缓冲调用的 stderr 打开 | 立即返回，未等待排空 | 约 206 ms 返回，不携带 stdout 被持有标记 |

另外六项真实进程对照也通过：缓冲和流式路径分别验证 SIGTERM 退出、AbortController 取消以及退出码 7。流式继承管道对照继续保持约一秒上限。这些耗时只是复现环境中的观察值，并非吞吐性能基准；原问题是调度竞态。

### 审阅跟进（S1 / S2）

既有 close 回归改用假时钟，并在 close 后不推进时间就断言结果已结算。正确的原 head 能通过该断言；临时删除 close handler 的结算调用后，新断言立即失败，结算回调为零次，因此排空超时无法掩盖 close 路径缺失。

提升后台的回归保留外部 end 监听，同时检查服务自身的监听已移除。将加强后的测试用于原 head `518a3444` 时，187 项通过，该所有权断言因残留匿名 end 监听而失败。两个服务 end 监听改为具名引用并在移交时摘除后，188 项全部通过。用于验证 S1 的临时变异未包含在提交代码中。

### 最新审阅跟进

提交 `11ce55a1` 说明 stdout 被持有标记属于执行服务，不是 shell 工具的对外结果字段。两处注释都明确区分缓冲式 200 ms 与流式/原始捕获 1000 ms 上限。fallback 测试复用既有 finish 辅助函数，新增两项假时钟用例，分别对流式和无操作原始捕获 sink 断言 999 ms 时未结算、1000 ms 时结算。临时将模式选择器统一改为 200 ms 后，两项 999 ms 断言均失败。本次跟进没有改变生产行为。

本地 **190/190** 项 shell 执行测试通过。针对精确提交 `11ce55a1` 的[托管验证](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/43396539767/job/131788715575)通过标准全工作区构建、类型检查及相同 190 项测试，未使用重试。这是 fork 验证，上游工作流审批仍由维护者处理。定向 lint、格式与 diff 检查也通过。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :--- | :--- |
| macOS | 未运行 |
| Windows | 未运行 |
| Linux | 真实进程复现及定向检查通过 |

### 环境

本地 Node.js 24.22.1，托管 Node.js 22.23.4；Vitest 3.2.7，pnpm 11.24.0 冻结依赖，Linux child_process 执行。PTY 行为不变。

## 风险与范围

- 主要取舍：如果后代进程持续持有管道，前台命令现在可能在父进程退出后等待最多 200 ms。普通命令会在管道关闭时立即返回，超过该上限才到达的输出仍不在结果中。本次提出 issue 所讨论的较短前台上限，同时保留既有的流式及原始输出捕获上限。
- 已检查的下游调用方：前台及托管 shell 工具、沙箱执行及 Landlock 探测、提交分析中的 Git 命令、自动修复运行器、prompt shell 展开、Ink/OpenTUI shell 模式和沙箱 CLI。结果结构、退出状态及取消约定保持一致，缓冲调用会在返回前收齐较晚到达的输出。只使用 PTY 尺寸或输入接口的调用方不受影响。
- 未验证或范围外：真实 Windows/macOS 执行和完整交互式 TUI 会话。此前本地全仓构建及类型检查以 137 退出；最新精确提交的托管全仓构建及类型检查已通过。不引入新的后台进程跟踪或进程组探测。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：没有公开签名或协议格式变更；已有的可选 stdout 被持有标记现在也可能出现在缓冲结果中。

## 关联问题

关联 #17093。

</details>

prs.title: fix(session): reattach explicit resume after project move
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When `qwen --resume <full-uuid>` cannot find a session in the current project, the CLI now performs a bounded lookup across Qwen-managed project directories. If it finds exactly one valid session whose recorded project directory no longer exists, an interactive prompt shows the old and new paths and lets the user reattach it.

On confirmation, Qwen Code preserves the session UUID and complete transcript, rewrites structured project paths, and relocates the transcript together with its runtime, worktree, PR, and prompt-ledger sidecars. Target files are staged and published atomically; failures roll back without overwriting existing artifacts. A sanitized-path collision is handled in place.

The fallback refuses without mutation when the UUID is duplicated, the old directory still exists, a writer is active, the transcript is invalid, the scan is incomplete, the target conflicts, or the invocation is non-interactive. `--continue`, the picker, title lookup, archived sessions, and project-level `tmp/<hash>` data keep their existing behavior.

## Why it's needed

Session storage and transcript ownership are both derived from the absolute project path. Renaming or moving a project therefore makes its saved sessions unreachable even when the user knows the exact UUID. This addresses both gates identified in #12553 while keeping normal project-scoped lookup unchanged.

[ChatAnchor](https://github.com/ascendho/ChatAnchor) is prior art for the same class of path-coupled session recovery problem and motivated the report. This PR is a native Qwen Code implementation and has no ChatAnchor dependency or storage-format coupling.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Use an isolated `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR` and create a project with a saved session.
2. Record the session UUID, exit Qwen Code, and rename or move the project directory.
3. From the new directory, run `qwen --resume <uuid>`.
4. Confirm that the CLI displays both paths and defaults to No.
5. Answer Yes and confirm that the same session opens with its prior history.
6. Repeat with `-p`, a duplicate UUID, an existing old directory, and a live writer; each must refuse without moving files.

Automated coverage includes unique relocation with all sidecars, sanitized-path collision/in-place repair, duplicate UUIDs, existing source paths, active writers, invalid transcripts, target conflicts, confirmation decline, and non-interactive refusal.

Commands run locally:

```text
pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core exec vitest run src/services/sessionService.relink.test.ts src/services/sessionService.test.ts src/services/sessionService.corruption.test.ts
# 335 passed

pnpm --filter ./packages/cli exec vitest run src/llm.test.tsx src/utils/session-relink.test.ts
# 107 passed

pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core typecheck
pnpm --dir packages/cli typecheck
pnpm exec eslint packages/core/src/services/sessionService.ts packages/core/src/services/sessionService.relink.test.ts packages/cli/src/llm.tsx packages/cli/src/utils/session-relink.ts packages/cli/src/utils/session-relink.test.ts
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before:

```text
No saved session found with ID 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222.
```

After:

```text
? Session 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222 was saved for the missing project directory "/private/tmp/.../old-project". Reattach it to "/private/tmp/.../moved-project"? (y/N)
Reattached session 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222 to /private/tmp/.../moved-project (previously /private/tmp/.../old-project).
```

The manual smoke test then entered the normal resumed-session startup flow. A separate headless run produced the expected interactive-confirmation guidance and left the source untouched.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 25.9.0, pnpm 11.24.0, isolated local `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`, synthetic transcript with no private conversation data.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an explicit UUID miss now scans up to 5,000 Qwen-managed project directories; the normal lookup path does not scan.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows/Linux manual TUI testing, automatic recovery without a known UUID, copied projects, archived sessions, cross-machine portability, and migration of project-level temporary/checkpoint data.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Reattachment requires an explicit UUID and interactive confirmation.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12553

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

当 `qwen --resume <完整 UUID>` 无法在当前项目中找到会话时，CLI 现在会在 Qwen 管理的项目目录中执行有数量上限的查找。如果只找到一个有效会话，且会话记录的旧项目目录已经不存在，CLI 会显示旧路径与新路径，并让用户交互确认是否重新关联。

确认后，Qwen Code 会保留会话 UUID 和完整 transcript，更新结构化项目路径，并将 transcript 与 runtime、worktree、PR、prompt ledger sidecar 一起迁移。目标文件会先写入 staging 文件，再原子发布；发生失败时回滚，且不会覆盖已有产物。旧路径和新路径清洗后落入同一存储目录的情况会在原位置完成修复。

出现 UUID 重复、旧目录仍存在、存在活跃写入者、transcript 无效、扫描不完整、目标冲突或非交互调用时，回退流程会拒绝操作且不修改文件。`--continue`、会话选择器、标题查找、归档会话和项目级 `tmp/<hash>` 数据保持原有行为。

## 为什么需要它

会话存储位置和 transcript 归属都由项目绝对路径派生。项目目录改名或移动后，即使用户知道完整 UUID，也无法访问原会话。本 PR 同时处理 #12553 中确认的两道路径校验，并保持正常的项目范围查找不变。

[ChatAnchor](https://github.com/ascendho/ChatAnchor) 是同类“路径绑定导致会话失联”问题的先行实现，也是提交该问题的动机。本 PR 是 Qwen Code 的原生实现，不依赖 ChatAnchor，也不耦合其存储格式。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

1. 使用隔离的 `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`，在一个项目中创建并保存会话。
2. 记录会话 UUID，退出 Qwen Code，然后改名或移动项目目录。
3. 在新目录运行 `qwen --resume <uuid>`。
4. 确认 CLI 显示旧路径和新路径，并默认选择 No。
5. 选择 Yes，确认同一会话及其历史能够打开。
6. 分别使用 `-p`、重复 UUID、仍存在的旧目录和活跃写入者重试；每种情况都应拒绝且不移动文件。

自动化测试覆盖：唯一匹配及全部 sidecar 迁移、清洗路径冲突时的原位置修复、重复 UUID、旧目录仍存在、活跃写入者、无效 transcript、目标冲突、取消确认和非交互拒绝。

本地运行的命令：

```text
pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core exec vitest run src/services/sessionService.relink.test.ts src/services/sessionService.test.ts src/services/sessionService.corruption.test.ts
# 335 passed

pnpm --filter ./packages/cli exec vitest run src/llm.test.tsx src/utils/session-relink.test.ts
# 107 passed

pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core typecheck
pnpm --dir packages/cli typecheck
pnpm exec eslint packages/core/src/services/sessionService.ts packages/core/src/services/sessionService.relink.test.ts packages/cli/src/llm.tsx packages/cli/src/utils/session-relink.ts packages/cli/src/utils/session-relink.test.ts
```

### 前后对比证据

修复前：

```text
No saved session found with ID 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222.
```

修复后：

```text
? Session 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222 was saved for the missing project directory "/private/tmp/.../old-project". Reattach it to "/private/tmp/.../moved-project"? (y/N)
Reattached session 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222 to /private/tmp/.../moved-project (previously /private/tmp/.../old-project).
```

手动冒烟测试随后进入正常的会话恢复启动流程。另一次 headless 测试给出需要交互确认的预期说明，并保持来源文件不变。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

Node.js 25.9.0、pnpm 11.24.0、隔离的本地 `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`，以及不含私人会话内容的合成 transcript。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：显式 UUID 未命中后，最多扫描 5,000 个 Qwen 管理的项目目录；正常查找路径不会扫描。
- 未验证或不在范围内：Windows/Linux 手动 TUI 测试、没有已知 UUID 时的自动恢复、复制项目、归档会话、跨机器可移植性，以及项目级临时/检查点数据迁移。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。重新关联必须提供显式 UUID 并进行交互确认。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #12553

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): derive image token estimates from resolution instead of the flat constant
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Context accounting now derives the token cost of an inline image from its actual resolution instead of charging every image the same flat 1600-token constant. A new header-only parser (`utils/image-dimensions.ts`, PNG/GIF/JPEG/WebP, no full decode, no dependencies) reads pixel dimensions from the base64 payload, and `estimatePartChars` charges the patch-grid formula the omni pipeline already uses — `ceil(pixels / VISUAL_PIXELS_PER_TOKEN)`, with that constant now exported from `omni/estimation.ts` as the single source of truth. Unparseable payloads (other binary kinds, truncated headers, non-image mime types) keep the configured flat estimate as fallback.

## Why it's needed

A small screenshot and a 4K diagram cost identically under the flat constant, so the auto-compaction threshold ladder and the `image_overflow` trigger both mis-size real sessions — early for text-heavy conversations with small images, late for a few large ones (#17315). OpenAI Codex derives per-image tokens from bytes and detail (`compact_remote_v2_media.rs`), which is the design precedent; qwen-code's own omni pipeline already uses resolution-aware math for media delivery, so compaction counting now reuses the same formula.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/utils/image-dimensions.test.ts src/services/compactionInputSlimming.test.ts` — synthetic headers for all four formats parse to exact dimensions; `estimatePartChars` charges 1013×4 chars for a declared 1920×1080 PNG (vs the flat 1600×4), and keeps the flat budget for unparseable/non-image payloads.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅    |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: header parsing is best-effort; exotic or corrupted images fall back to the flat estimate, which is the current behavior for everything today.
- Not validated / out of scope: audio duration tokens (no audio history in compaction inputs today); provider-specific detail levels (the patch formula is the same conservative upper bound omni uses).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — estimates shift, behavior gates stay the same shape.
- Design documents: N/A.

## Linked Issues

Closes #17315

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

本 PR 让上下文计数按图片实际分辨率而非固定 1600 token 常数计费：新增仅解析文件头的工具（PNG/GIF/JPEG/WebP，零依赖），`estimatePartChars` 对可解析的内联图片按 omni 管道既有的 patch 公式（像素数 / VISUAL_PIXELS_PER_TOKEN，常量已从 omni/estimation 导出为唯一事实源）计费；不可解析的负载保持原固定估算回退。

动机：小截图与 4K 图成本相同，自动压缩阈值阶梯与 image_overflow 触发器对真实会话双向失准（#17315）。OpenAI Codex 的按字节计费是设计先例；qwen 自家 omni 管道已有同款数学，压缩计数现复用同一公式。

验证：四格式合成头解析精确；1920×1080 PNG 计 1013×4 字符（原 1600×4）；不可解析保持扁平。风险：奇异/损坏图片回退即现状。关闭 #17315。

</details>

prs.title: test(memory): pin the flush-deadline expiry test to a zero budget
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the `MemoryManager` flush-deadline test deterministic. The test gave the flush a 1ms budget and relied on that millisecond elapsing before the detached flush body checked its deadline. On a loaded runner the body can reach the check within its starting millisecond — the slot-wait slips, the deadline has not expired yet, and the body takes the real fork path instead, which returns silently, so the `flush_deadline_expired` warning the test waits for never fires.

A zero budget expires the deadline at creation, so every scheduling interleaving finds it already expired and takes the warn path. The production behavior under test — a flush whose own deadline expired while the slot was held reports the owed turns and leaves the snapshot pending — is unchanged.

The frozen-clock test pins the inclusive deadline comparison the zero budget rests on: with the clock frozen on the flush's creation millisecond (`deadline === now`), the warning must still fire — green on head, and the single red when `>=` is flipped to `>` (verified by applying the mutation locally).

## Why it's needed

Run 43256659244 failed three identical attempts with the warn spy recording only the outer budget-race message and never the body's `flush_deadline_expired` — the signature of the body slipping past the deadline check rather than timing out under load. Local runs pass 8/8, consistent with a rare scheduling window rather than load sensitivity. Analysis in #17068.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/memory/manager.test.ts` — the changed test resolves `false` and warns with `reason: 'flush_deadline_expired'`, `owedTurns: 2`. For the inclusive-comparison pin, flip `Date.now() >= deadline` to `>` at the deadline check in `manager.ts` — the frozen-clock test is then the only red (153 tests, exactly 1 failed; the real-clock copy was removed in 20cc4558, so this is the single witness); revert and 153/153.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅    |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none — two test-scoped changes in `packages/core/src/memory/manager.test.ts`; no production code touched.
- Not validated / out of scope: the loaded-runner scheduling itself was not reproduced locally, only the failure signature and the structural condition; the flush-budget census elsewhere (37×1000ms, 8×30000ms, 1×50ms, 1×1ms fake-clocked) is untouched.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.
- Design documents: N/A.

## Linked Issues

Closes #17068

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

本 PR 将 MemoryManager 的 flush 截止时间测试改为确定性：原先 1ms 预算依赖"创建后那一毫秒时钟已前进"，加载中的 runner 上检测可在同毫秒内到达，主体滑入静默 fork 路径，测试等待的 `flush_deadline_expired` 警告永不发出（run 43256659244 三次同型失败）。零预算使截止时间在创建即过期，任何交错都命中警告路径；生产行为不变。另加冻时钟兄弟测试钉住闭区间比较（`>=` 改 `>` 后该测试为唯一红，已本地验证）。

动机与分析见 #17068。风险面：仅测试文件两处改动，无生产代码；未复现 CI 加载调度本身，只复现了失败签名与结构条件。关闭 #17068。

</details>

issues.body:
## What happened?

After using CodeWhale in GNOME Terminal and exiting, the terminal profile keeps CodeWhale’s Nord light colors instead of restoring the previous profile colors. The background becomes `#ECEFF4` and the foreground `#2E3440`, while the palette remains Solarized. The terminal looks inconsistent outside CodeWhale.

Expected: CodeWhale restores the terminal’s previous background, foreground, and palette on exit, or leaves the existing profile colors untouched.

## Steps to reproduce

1. In GNOME Terminal, use a profile with the Solarized palette and a non-Nord background/foreground (for example Solarized Dark).
2. Configure CodeWhale with `theme = "custom:nord"` and a theme file containing `surface_bg: "#ECEFF4"` and `text_body: "#2E3440"`.
3. Run `codewhale` in that GNOME Terminal profile.
4. Exit CodeWhale normally.
5. Observe that the GNOME Terminal profile background/foreground remain the CodeWhale Nord colors instead of the previous colors.

## Codewhale version

`codewhale 0.10.2 (ff466b2ed0bf)`

## Where did it happen?

- TUI (terminal interface)

## Operating system

- Linux

## How did you get Codewhale?

- npm

## Provider and model

`deepseek / deepseek-flash`

## Terminal and shell

GNOME Terminal 3.44.0 using VTE 0.68.0; `TERM=xterm-256color`; `COLORTERM=truecolor`; `/bin/bash`.

## `codewhale doctor` (optional)

Not included; no relevant failure was observed.

## Logs, screenshots, anything else (optional)

- CodeWhale theme: `~/.codewhale/themes/nord.json` defines `surface_bg: "#ECEFF4"` and `text_body: "#2E3440"`.
- GNOME Terminal profile currently reports:
  - `use-theme-colors=false`
  - `background-color=rgb(236,239,244)` (`#ECEFF4`)
  - `foreground-color=rgb(46,52,64)` (`#2E3440`)
  - palette still Solarized (`#002B36`, `#FDF6E3`, etc.)
- CodeWhale’s binary contains OSC 11 handling (`crates/palette/src/osc11.rs`), and its logs show terminal probes for `\x1b]11;?` and `\x1b]10;?`.
- OpenCode 2.2.5 was also used under the same GNOME Terminal profile and has an identical Nord light background/foreground, so the exact writer is not fully isolated. Cross-reference: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/63977
- The request is that the application setting OSC 10/11 restores the previous terminal colors on exit, or preserves the existing profile colors. A regression test for terminal color restoration would help.
- Workaround: reset the GNOME Terminal profile colors with `gsettings`.
- I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate.

## Isolation steps not yet completed

1. Test whether `printf '\033]111\007'` and `printf '\033]110\007'` restore the dynamic background/foreground.
2. Reproduce with CodeWhale alone, then OpenCode alone, to identify which process writes the profile colors.

issues.title: TUI: full-screen erase + repaint on every window focus flashes on terminals without DEC 2026 (gnome-terminal/VTE)

labels.name: area:tui
labels.description: Terminal UI behavior, rendering, or interaction

labels.name: os:linux
labels.description: Linux-specific behaviour

issues.body:
## Summary

On every window focus gain (selecting the terminal window), the TUI erases the entire screen (`CSI 2J`) and repaints it from scratch, wrapped in DEC 2026 synchronized-update markers. On terminals that do not implement DEC 2026 (gnome-terminal / VTE < 0.76), the erase lands before the repaint, producing a visible flash/glitch on every focus. The repaint is byte-identical each time — nothing on screen changed.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Run codewhale (v0.10.2) in gnome-terminal (VTE 0.68) with any theme whose background differs from the terminal's default background (e.g. a light custom theme over a dark terminal background).
2. Switch away from the window and back (focus out, focus in).
3. Observe: a brief flash of the terminal's default background over the app surface on every focus-in.

## Expected vs actual

- Expected: focusing the window causes no visible redraw.
- Actual: full-screen erase + repaint on every FocusIn; visible flicker when the terminal ignores DEC 2026.

## Evidence

Captured over a pty with terminal emulation (xterm DA answers, focus events `CSI I` / `CSI O` sent explicitly). The FocusIn frame begins:

```
ESC[<1u ESC[>1u ESC[?1007l ESC[?1000h ESC[?1002h ESC[?1003h ESC[?1015h ESC[?1006h ESC[?2004h ESC[?1004h ESC[?2026h ESC[?25l ESC[r ESC[?6l ESC[H ESC[2J ESC[36;46H ESC[1;1H ...
```

i.e. mode re-setup (mouse tracking, bracketed paste, focus reporting), `?2026h` (begin synchronized update), cursor home, `2J` erase, then a full repaint, ending with `?2026l`.

Measurements (120x40 cells):

- Idle output: 0 bytes (diff-based rendering — nothing redraws while idle).
- Each FocusIn: ~6.7 KB full repaint; two consecutive FocusIn frames are **byte-identical** (redundant).
- FocusOut: 61 bytes.
- `synchronized_output = "off"` in settings removes the 2026 markers but keeps the identical erase + repaint.
- The app never issues a `DECRQM` (`CSI ?2026$p`) capability query — it emits `?2026h/l` unconditionally.

## Root cause

The focus handler unconditionally erases and fully repaints on FocusIn and relies on DEC 2026 to make it atomic. VTE ignores DEC 2026 until 0.76 (user's terminal: gnome-terminal 3.44.0 / libvte 0.68.0, Ubuntu). The erase therefore renders immediately with the terminal's default background, followed by the streamed repaint — visible as a flash. With a light theme over a dark terminal background the flash is very prominent.

## Suggested fixes

1. Detect DEC 2026 support via `DECRQM` before relying on it, and on non-supporting terminals either skip the erase or use a damage-only redraw.
2. Skip the erase entirely when nothing changed — the FocusIn repaint is redundant; diff-based rendering already achieves 0-byte idle.
3. If mode re-setup on focus is intentional (terminals may reset modes), keep it but drop `2J` and repaint only changed cells.

## Environment

- codewhale v0.10.2 (ff466b2ed0bf)
- gnome-terminal 3.44.0, libvte-2.91-0 0.68.0 (Ubuntu)
- Terminal default background: rgb(23,20,33); custom light theme background: #ECEFF4

Possibly related: #6728 (idle CPU regression).

issues.body:
### Before you start

- [x] I searched existing issues and this is not a duplicate. 我已搜索过现有 issue。 Related (closed): #7042, #5036.

### What happened? 发生了什么？

New TUI sessions in one workspace show this on every sub-agent sidebar refresh:

```
Warn Failed to clean up sub-agents: Runtime coordination was opened without its writer lock; stop and restart this Runtime process after the other session exits
```

Restarting does not help. Every new session's TUI log shows why:

```
WARN subagent: delegated store admission failed; writable state remains refused error=another Codewhale process (pid 69066) owns delegated coordination for <workspace>: Resource temporarily unavailable (os error 35)
WARN subagent: this session cannot append to the shared coordination ledger error=Runtime coordination was opened without its writer lock; stop and restart this Runtime process after the other session exits
```

- **The named holder is wrong.** PID 69066 does not exist. No acquirer writes its PID into `subagents.v1.lock`. The file's content dates from August, so the diagnostic names a dead process.
- **The real holder** was a `codew` started six days earlier and suspended since then (`STAT T`, no TTY, parent launchd). It held two fds on `<workspace>/.codewhale/state/subagents.v1.lock`.
- **Why it blocks everything:** the workspace still had a legacy `subagents.v1.json` file and no `subagents.v3.json`. So every new session attempts the v1→v3 cutover, and the cutover requires the lock **exclusively**. One forgotten process blocks the cutover indefinitely, and every new session in the folder runs with sub-agent state read-only.

Expected: one stale process does not degrade every other session in the folder. If something does block, the message names the actual blocker and says what to do, once.

### Steps to reproduce 复现步骤

1. Use a workspace that still has `.codewhale/state/subagents.v1.json` and no `subagents.v3.json`. Start any Codewhale session there and leave it running or suspended (Ctrl+Z).
2. Start a current-build session in the same workspace.
3. Open the sub-agent sidebar. The warning repeats on each refresh where cleanup is due. The log names whatever PID is in the lock file, not the holder.

### Codewhale version 版本

codewhale 0.10.3 (d214a969012f)

### Where did it happen? 在哪里出现？

TUI (terminal interface)

### Operating system 操作系统

macOS

### How did you get Codewhale? 获取方式

Built from a git checkout

### Provider and model 提供商和模型

deepseek / deepseek-flash (does not matter)

### Terminal and shell 终端

_No response_

### codewhale doctor (optional)

_No response_

### Logs, screenshots, anything else (optional)

**Mechanism** (on `main` at `d214a9690`):

1. `ensure_subagent_store_cutover` (`crates/engine/src/tools/subagent/mod.rs:13710`) calls `CoordinationProcessLock::acquire(root, true)` (exclusive) whenever the v1 tombstone is missing. Any other live session fails it, even one holding the lock shared or sitting suspended.
2. On that failure, `with_state_path` and `require_coordination_process_lock` (`mod.rs:6070-6105`) set `coordination_snapshot_read_only = true` for the life of the process. Nothing retries when the holder leaves. `ensure_coordination_process_lock` (`mod.rs:6110`) then returns the "restart" error forever.
3. `Op::ListSubAgents` (`crates/engine/src/core/engine.rs:4110-4135`) runs cleanup on each refresh where cleanup is due and sends a user-visible error every time. The result is repeated warnings that never name the blocker.
4. The holder PID is read from the lock file's content (`mod.rs:4037-4050`), which no acquirer writes.

**Proposal: remove the workspace-wide process flock.**

The v3 store already handles its own concurrency:

- a bounded, per-operation `subagents.v3.transaction.lock` (`acquire_store_transaction`, `mod.rs:13638`);
- per-writer boot leases, `subagents.v3.writer.<boot>.lock` (`mod.rs:13910`).

`docs/architecture/delegated-coordination.md` (§ "Legacy cutover and recovery") already says two things: the retained `subagents.v1.json` directory is what stops an old publisher from overwriting state, and concurrent old binaries are not a supported coordination domain. So:

- Run the v1→v3 cutover under the transaction lock only.
- Delete `CoordinationProcessLock`, `coordination_process_lock[_required]`, `coordination_exclusive` and `coordination_snapshot_read_only`. They have 66 references in `subagent/mod.rs` and 40 in `subagent/tests.rs`.
- Decide whether the single-host policy of `codewhale serve` and the runtime API (#7042's exclusive constructor) still needs anything the store leases do not cover. Keep it only if it does, and state why.
- Keep working: #5036 (isolated worktree builders) and #7042 (several resumed sessions in one folder). Update the architecture doc in the same change.

If full removal is rejected, the minimum fix is:

- Retry store admission once the holder exits, instead of staying read-only for the life of the process.
- Report a cleanup or admission failure once, naming the real holder and the remedy, rather than on every sidebar refresh.
- Write the PID on acquire, or stop claiming to know it.

**Workaround:** end the stale process (`kill -CONT <pid>; kill <pid>` for a suspended one), then start a new session.

prs.body:
## What and why

The fallback parser's second `key=value` pass scans text already consumed as a `--argument` value. A shell command such as `--command "MODE=dev node app.js"` therefore invents an extra `MODE` tool parameter. File content containing assignments has the same problem.

Remove consumed flag arguments from the fallback key/value scan. Standalone key/value arguments still work alongside explicit flags. One regression checks both a quoted shell assignment and mixed flag/key-value input through the public parser.

## Where this came from

A focused bug found while checking current main (`5526e0590`), independently of the XML multiline repair in #7341. Prepared and tested with AI assistance (Codex).

## How I tested it

- The regression fails with the original scan because extra parameters appear.
- `scripts/dev-test.sh core tool_parser`: **test result: ok. 13 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 46 filtered out**.
- `cargo fmt --all`, `git diff --check`, and `scripts/preflight.sh --check --base 5526e0590` pass. Existing missing-tag notices and warn-only lexicon findings remain.
- No live provider request or terminal interaction is used; the engine's fallback call site uses this parser directly.

## Checklist

- [x] One focused change from current main.
- [x] Rust formatting and affected tests pass.
- [x] Feature registry/docs: N/A, preserves literal values in the existing parser.

## Where this came from

issues.title: Cron session notice says "Context overflow" after recovery compaction fails, while the cron run names the recovery failure

labels.name: clawsweeper:intake:bug
labels.description: Preliminary submission classification; full source review pending.

issues.body:
### Bug type

Behavior bug (incorrect output/state without crash)

### Beta release blocker

No

### Summary

When an isolated cron turn overflows the model's context and recovery compaction then fails, the cron session's transcript notice says "Context overflow … Try /reset (or /new) … or use a larger-context model", while the cron run record for the same run names the recovery failure.

### Steps to reproduce

1. On `main`, start an isolated Gateway with an OpenAI-compatible provider whose model has a 40000-token context window. Make the provider reject any request after a large tool result with `400 context_length_exceeded`, and fail every summarization request with `502` (`retry-after: 1`).
2. Add an isolated cron job whose prompt reads a large (120,000-byte) workspace file: `openclaw automations add "every 24h" "Read big.txt in the workspace and summarize it." --name proof --session isolated --no-deliver --json`.
3. Run it: `openclaw automations run <job-id> --wait --wait-timeout 6m --poll-interval 2s`.
4. Read the cron run: `openclaw automations runs <job-id> --limit 5 --json`. Find the cron session's key with `openclaw gateway call sessions.list --params '{"limit":50}' --json`: it is the key that ends in `:cron:<job-id>`. Read that session's transcript: `openclaw gateway call chat.history --params '{"sessionKey":"<cron-session-key>","limit":50}' --json`.

### Expected behavior

The cron session's notice names the recovery failure, the same text the cron run record shows. Since https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198841, a chat turn reports this failure the same way.

### Actual behavior

- Cron run record: `status=error`, `error="Auto-compaction could not reach the model provider after the provider rejected the prompt. Try again or run /compact."`
- Cron session transcript notice (`run-failed-before-reply`): `"⚠️ Context overflow: prompt too large for the model. Try /reset (or /new) to start a fresh session, or use a larger-context model."` Its cause is `{ provider: "mock", failoverReason: "context_overflow" }`.

The provider received 23 requests: the first turn, its rejected follow-up, and 21 summarization attempts, each answered with 502. `automations run --wait` returned after 82 seconds.

### OpenClaw version

`main` at 2928381894f

### Operating system

Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS (Linux 6.8.0 x86_64), Node v24.22.1

### Install method

issues.body:
OpenClaw 2026.11.2 (and current main) appears to apply a CLI runtime `toolsAllow` cap too late to reduce Gateway tool-construction cost in the loopback mediation path.

Reproduction context:
- isolated cron `agentTurn`
- provider: OpenRouter
- runtime tools allow-list: `["tool_describe","dispatch_action"]`
- intended use: structured Tool Search bridge only
- pre-run Gateway RSS: ~987 MiB
- peak RSS during one guarded turn: ~1.22 GiB
- host `MemAvailable` fell from ~527 MiB to ~211 MiB and the guard aborted the run
- after settling, RSS returned near baseline, but Gateway swap had risen materially (~91 MiB -> ~260 MiB)

The source path explains why the cap does not bound construction:

1. `src/agents/cli-runner/prepare-tool-policy.ts` preserves the caller cap as `runtimeToolsAllowPolicy`.
2. `src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.ts` calls `prepareCliMcpToolProjection(... runtimeToolsAllowPolicy ...)`.
3. `src/gateway/mcp-http.runtime.ts::constructMcpLoopbackTools` destructures `const { toolsAllow, ...context } = params.context`, builds `scopeOptions` from `context` without `toolsAllow`, calls `resolveGatewayScopedTools`, and only then runs `applyGrantToolsAllow` / `applyPolicyToolsAllow`.
4. `src/gateway/tool-resolution.ts::resolveGatewayScopedTools` calls `createOpenClawToolsAsync(openClawToolOptions, ...)` without a runtime allow-list/construction plan for the main OpenClaw surface; only mediated coding tools receive their own restrictive `runtimeToolAllowlist` / construction plan.

So the final visible surface is correctly restricted, but expensive core/plugin tool factory work can still happen before that restriction is applied. On small-memory Gateways this creates severe avoidable pressure.

Current `main` still has the same ordering.

Potential direction:
- propagate a construction-time allow/cap into `resolveGatewayScopedTools` / `createOpenClawToolsAsync`, or
- derive a restrictive `toolConstructionPlan` before full Gateway tool materialization, especially for Tool Search control-only surfaces,
while preserving existing final policy checks as authoritative.

This looks like a resource-safety / construction-order issue rather than a final-policy bypass.
